HushTelegram v0.0.25 has 82 patches for Telegram 13.2.1, both the Google Play build (`org.telegram.messenger`, version code 72911) and telegram.org's (`org.telegram.messenger.web`, version code 72919), so the two builds are on the same version now. It's still on Morphe patcher 2.3.0, and Morphe Manager 2.5.0 or newer is all you need. The bundle is signed from this release on, so Morphe Manager shows who signed it when you add or update the source. Most of it came from your reports, and it changes something for #7, #27, #46, #48, #52, #58, #63, #65, #66, #67, #70 and #71. Free proxies keeps the fastest public MTProto proxies in Telegram's list for you. Ghost mode can make exceptions for the chats you pick, and the message menu gains Hide for me, Delete for them and Forward as plain text. Every new switch starts off, except the two that stop a photo from going out uncropped or with the wrong caption.

New in this release

- `Free proxies`, under Chat list. Turn it on and HushTelegram downloads a public list of MTProto proxies every 6 hours, times them and keeps the 10 fastest in Telegram's proxy list. Telegram connects through the fastest and moves to another by itself when one stops answering, unless you're using a proxy of your own. `Find free proxies now` runs it right away, even with the switch off, and then only adds them to the list. Proxies you saved yourself are never touched. The phone number screen also always has Telegram's proxy button now, so you can add a proxy before you sign in, which helps where Telegram is blocked (#66).

- `Proxy order`, under Chat list below Find free proxies. Drag your proxies into the order you like or pin a few on top, and Telegram's own proxy screen lists them that way instead of re-sorting by speed every time it saves. A free proxy you pin becomes yours, so the next refresh won't remove it. `Sort by speed` drops your order and keeps only the pins. With HushTelegram paused the screen goes back to Telegram's order (#71).

- `Your proxy lists`, under Chat list below Find free proxies. Add the https addresses of up to 5 proxy lists you trust, pages of t.me/proxy or tg://proxy links, and Free proxies reads those instead of the public list, timing them all together and keeping the 10 fastest. A list that can't be read is skipped. Empty the box to go back to the public list. The addresses stay out of settings files (#71).

- `Proxy in the chat list menu`, under Chat list and off by default. The menu at the top of the chat list always has Proxy, so your saved proxies are one tap away. Telegram only puts it there while a proxy is on or in a country where Telegram is blocked (#67).

- `Ghost mode` has two new switches in Privacy, both off by default. `Read after you reply` sends the read receipt Ghost mode held back in a chat once you send a message there, so your other devices stop showing that chat as unread. `Read receipts button` puts a double check at the top of the chat list that sends every read receipt Ghost mode is holding for the account you're on. Held receipts last until Telegram restarts.

- `Ghost mode exceptions`, under Ghost mode in Privacy and off by default. The chats you pick get the opposite of Ghost mode: while it's on they read, type and watch stories as usual, and while it's off they keep back what the Ghost mode switches keep back, view counts included. Pick them in `Exception chats`, or long press chats in the chat list and use `Ghost mode exception` in the three dots menu. Online status isn't one chat's, so it follows Ghost mode everywhere (#71).

- `Fake typing`, under Ghost mode in Privacy and off by default. Long press chats in the chat list and pick `Fake typing` in the three dots menu, and they show you typing for 10 minutes or until you pick them again. It works with Ghost mode on too. Secret chats can't show it (#71).

- `Instant lock`, in Privacy and off by default. With a Telegram passcode set, Telegram locks a second or two after you leave it instead of waiting out your Auto-lock time. Your Auto-lock choice stays as it is and comes back when you turn the switch off.

- `Don't notify contacts`, in Privacy and off by default. When you sign up a phone number that's never used Telegram, the people who have it saved don't get the "joined Telegram" notice. Turn it on before you sign up. On a fresh install, long press the app icon to reach the Hush settings. Accounts that already exist aren't affected.

- `Suppress screenshot notification`, a new patch with its switch in HushTelegram settings > Privacy, off by default. Telegram stops telling the other person you took a screenshot, in regular and secret chats.

- `Unlock Premium features`, in Privacy and off by default. Telegram on your phone treats your account as Premium, so the parts the app itself locks open up. Telegram's servers still know your real plan, so their limits stay the same.

- `Bypass channel restrictions`, in Privacy and off by default. Channels and chats that turn off forwarding, copying and saving let you do all three. Their stories open up too, so you can share and screenshot them, and save them wherever Telegram lets you save other stories (#52). Its second switch, `Open restricted channels`, opens channels, groups and messages Telegram marks unavailable for copyright or local law, as long as Telegram still sends them (#58).

- `Bypass integrity check`, in Privacy and off by default. Telegram's two emulator checks always say your phone isn't an emulator.

- `Send photos and videos in the best quality`, a fifth switch under `Faster downloads` in HushTelegram settings > Playback, off by default. Photos go out in HD and videos at their own size and quality without a trip to the quality button, and you can still lower one before you send it (#63).

- `Auto-forwarding rules` forwards now. Under its switch in Privacy, `Forwarding rules` lists your rules for the account you're on, and `Add rule` picks the chat to watch, the chat to send to and whether every message goes or only ones with a photo, video or file. Only messages other people send go out. A forward from any account you're signed in to never goes out again, and neither does a copy of a message a rule already sent to that chat, so rules pointing at each other can't loop, even across two accounts or through channels. Saved Messages can take forwards but isn't offered as a chat to watch. Chats you can't post in, Replies, Telegram's own account and deleted accounts aren't offered to send to, and at most 20 forwards leave a minute. Off by default.

- `Never send an uncropped photo`, under Conversations and on by default. If Telegram can't finish a crop, say the photo hasn't loaded yet or there's no memory left for the cropped copy, the editor stays open with a short note instead of sending the whole photo. Tap Done or Send again to retry, or Cancel to leave the photo uncropped. Live photos get the same check, including when the still can't be read from its file. Videos crop the way they always did.

- `My messages`, under Conversations and off by default. A group's menu at the top gets My messages, which opens the chat's search on the messages you sent there, so you can step through them or see them as a list. Channels and private chats don't get it. Morphe Manager lists it under Search (#71).

- `Text direction`, under Conversations and off by default. Select text in the message box and its menu gets Right to left and Left to right, which start each selected line with an invisible direction mark so it reads that way for everyone. Picking the other one later swaps the mark. Control character opens the list of invisible marks Telegram Desktop has, like RLM or ZWJ, and puts the one you pick where your selection was. Morphe Manager lists it in a new Writing group along with Use normal paste (#71).

- `Hide for me`, a new item in the message menu, behind its own switch under Add Repeat to the message menu in Conversations, off by default. Long press a message, pick Hide for me, and it leaves the chat on this phone, its whole album with it. Nothing goes to Telegram, so everyone else still has it, and it stays out each time you open the chat. Show hidden messages, right below the switch, brings them all back, and so does turning the switch off (#71).

- `Forward as plain text` joins the message menu on its own switch under Add Repeat to the message menu, off by default. Pick it on a message you could forward, choose a chat, and the words land there as a brand new message from you. Bold, links and the original sender's name stay behind, and custom emoji turn into the regular emoji they stand for (#71).

- `Delete for them` is a new message menu item for your own messages in chats and groups, on its own switch below Hide for me, off by default. It deletes the message, album included, for everyone else and keeps your copy here with the "deleted" mark Keep deleted messages uses, even while that switch is off. It only shows while Telegram would still let you delete for everyone, so not on old messages in basic groups, and never in Saved Messages, secret chats, bots or channels. Clear kept messages removes those copies too (#71).

- `Lyrics and song dates`, a new patch with two switches in Playback, both off by default. `Lyrics in the music player` puts Lyrics in the player's menu. It looks the song up on lrclib.net and, when the lyrics are timed, keeps the current line in view as the song plays. `Dates on your profile songs` notes the day you add a song to your profile and shows it after the artist in your profile's song list. The days stay on this phone, so songs added earlier or from another device don't get one (#71).

- `Chat preview buttons`, under Chat list and off by default. Press and hold a chat and the menu under its preview ends with Open chat, which opens the chat the rest of the way, and Close preview, which puts the preview away (#71).

- `Screenshot selected messages` is a new switch under Add Repeat to the message menu, off by default. It puts a Screenshot button in the bar that shows while you pick messages. Tap it and the messages are saved to Pictures/Telegram as one picture, the way the chat shows them, with the wallpaper, date headers and times. Every message you picked has to be on screen. Secret chats never get a picture, and chats that don't allow saving only do when `Allow screenshots in chats that don't allow saving` is on (#71).

- `Keep captions with their photos`, under Conversations and on by default. When the photos you pick in the attach menu each have their own caption, unpicking the first one or dragging another photo in front of it used to put the first photo's caption on the new first photo. Now every caption stays with its own photo.

- `Folder icons on tabs` is a new switch under `Hide folder tab counters`, off by default, that takes an app restart. Each folder tab above the chat list gets a small icon in front of its name, in the name's own color: a chat bubble for All Chats, a person, group, channel or bot for a folder of only that kind of chat, Telegram's unread and unmuted icons for folders that drop read or muted chats, and a plain folder for the rest. With a pack picked under `Folder icons`, the tabs use that pack's icon for the folder's name instead.

- `Open a chat by ID`, under Look and feel below the Show user and chat IDs switches. Type the number from a profile's ID row and it opens that person, group or channel, as long as this app has already seen it, say someone who wrote in a group you opened. Bot-style IDs like -100 followed by the channel's number work too (#71).

Fixes

- `Hide sender names when forwarding` covers the Share sheet now, and forwards to several chats at once, which still went out with the original author (#70). The Share sheet's send menu starts on Hide sender's name, and you can switch it back there. Forwards to Saved Messages keep the sender.

- With `Turn videos only from the full screen button` on, a video you put in full screen with the button stays sideways on 13.2 instead of standing back up as soon as you turn the phone (#27).

- `Save to Downloads` in the message menu saves every photo of an album, not just the one you long-pressed (#46).

- `Save downloaded files` no longer logs an error in its diagnostics whenever a profile photo or a sticker finishes downloading (#27).

- `Save downloaded files` no longer puts one file's contents under another file's name (#7). When two different files had the same name and size, Telegram could open the first one's file for the second instead of downloading it, and the copy in Download/Telegram came out with the wrong contents. That second file now stays out of Download/Telegram, and so does any named file Telegram finds already saved instead of downloading it. Files whose names end in .enc get copied as well, where they used to fail.

- The account rows in HushTelegram settings and the checks that tell your own accounts apart no longer log an error on 13.2.1 from Google Play. They only look at the four account slots that build has.

- Turning `UnifiedPush notifications` off, or picking another push app, when your phone couldn't save the change (a full phone, say) no longer leaves the row saying the push app ended the sign-up. Turning it back on signs up again, and a move to another app goes ahead once the old one lets go. A refusal, an address or an end the old app sends in the middle of a move can't undo it anymore, and Telegram goes back to Google's push until the new app sends its address.

- With large text, the HushTelegram settings list no longer jumps a few pixels when you go back from a search. The top bar used to come back a little shorter after a long title had to shrink to fit.

- With Telegram set to Português (Brasil), HushTelegram settings and messages come out in Portuguese. They were in English, because Telegram runs that language with no region and only the Brazilian table had Portuguese text.

- In German, the text under `Receive only mode` and `Power off accounts` says "du" like the rest of HushTelegram settings.

- A settings search while an import, an export or a diagnostic report is running shows the same rows it shows the rest of the time. Searching "Import settings" during an import used to list `Export settings` too, since that row said "Importing settings" for the moment.

- With `Hide reactions under messages` on, a new reaction to your message gets marked as seen once you scroll to it. The heart in the chat list and the reactions button in the chat used to stay there for good. Telegram's pop-up animation for that reaction no longer plays over the hidden row either (#48).

Other changes

- The telegram.org web build moves from 13.2.0 (72809) to 13.2.1 (72919). Both builds now track Telegram 13.2.1.

- `Ghost mode` lets channel reads go out now, so a channel you read on this phone shows as read on your other devices too. Nobody in a channel can see who read what, so they learn nothing. Groups and private chats stay unread everywhere else, since there the read is what people would see (#65).

- With `Ghost mode` and `No read receipts` on, opening a channel post, or one forwarded into a chat, no longer adds your view to its count. The counts still load. Turning on `Hide online status`, or Ghost mode while it's on, now shows you offline on every signed-in account right away instead of whenever Telegram would have timed you out (#71).

- The patch bundle is signed now. Morphe Manager shows "Signed by d7d6 bd99 8faf 7bcc" on the HushTelegram source and remembers that key, so a later bundle signed with any other key, or not signed at all, gets refused instead of loaded.

Behind the scenes

- `scripts/name-table.ps1` writes a Telegram build's name table, the map from 13.1.1's names to the ones R8 gave the build. Run it again on a build that already has a table and it keeps the rows people added by hand and lets them win over anything it matched, so 72919's table comes back unchanged.

- The build signs the bundle when `HUSHTELEGRAM_BUNDLE_SIGNING_KEY` holds the private key (Morphe's shared `MORPHE_SIGNING_KEY` is the fallback), and refuses a key that isn't the one `morphe-signing.pub` publishes. Without one the build still works and says the bundle is unsigned. `verifyBundle` checks the signature with Morphe's own verifier and fails a bundle signed by another key, or an unsigned one when the build had a key. A release won't go out with a bundle the published key didn't sign, and the index gains `public_key`.

- `verifyBundle` fails a bundle holding any class file newer than Java 17 (major 61), which Morphe's patcher won't load. The bundle's classes are Java 8 and 11 today, so a toolchain change that crosses the line now stops the build instead of reaching Manager.

- The host test runner's Netty moves from 4.1.138.Final to 4.1.140.Final, which carries Netty's HTTP smuggling and decoder fixes. Only the tests on the build machine use it. Nothing in the bundle does.

How to update

1. Install [Morphe Manager](https://github.com/MorpheApp/morphe-manager) 2.5.0 or newer. It's the same version 0.0.24 needed.
2. Add HushTelegram as a patch source: https://morphe.software/add-source?github=SysAdminDoc%2FHushTelegram. If you already have it, refresh the source. From this release on Morphe Manager shows it as signed by d7d6 bd99 8faf 7bcc.
3. Get Telegram 13.2.1. From Google Play that's `org.telegram.messenger` with version code 72911, which [APKMirror](https://www.apkmirror.com/apk/telegram-fz-llc/telegram/) and Uptodown also carry. telegram.org's build is `org.telegram.messenger.web` with version code 72919, but the [Download button](https://telegram.org/android) there already hands out 13.2.2, which this release doesn't cover yet. Get 13.2.1 from Telegram's own [Telegram APKs for Android](https://t.me/TAndroidAPK) channel instead. The patched app needs Android 9 or newer.
4. Coming from 0.0.24? Patch the same 13.2.1 build you used last time (telegram.org users move up from 13.2.0) and install it over your current HushTelegram with the same Morphe Manager signing key. Your settings and chats stay. New to HushTelegram? Uninstall the stock Telegram first, since Android won't put a patched app over one signed with a different key. Your chats come back when you sign in, but secret chats don't. Back up Morphe Manager's signing key after your first patch. You'll need it for every update.
5. If Telegram turns down your login code with `API_ID_PUBLISHED_FLOOD`, that's Telegram refusing the public API ID that ships with any patched build, the Play one included. Register your own app at [my.telegram.org/apps](https://my.telegram.org/apps), using only letters and numbers in the short name. Then select `Use registered Telegram API credentials`, fill in `apiId` and `apiHash`, and patch again. The result installs over your current HushTelegram build. Keep both values private.
6. Want HushTelegram's own icon, or Telegram's logo in white on the black launch screen? Turn on Expert mode in Morphe Manager and pick `HushTelegram icon and name` or `Black and white launch logo` before you patch.
7. For notifications, open Telegram's Settings, tap Notifications, and turn on `Keep-Alive Service` and `Background Connection` under Other, near the bottom of the page. On phones where Firebase notifications don't come through, try the `UnifiedPush notifications` switch on HushTelegram's Notifications page with a UnifiedPush app like ntfy. It turns those two on for you unless you've set them yourself.
8. To change HushTelegram's switches, open Telegram's Settings and tap HushTelegram settings, or press and hold the Telegram title at the top of your chat list. The Ways in section on that page decides which of those (plus the side menu row and the icon shortcut) stay.

The `.mpp` download is a patch bundle, not a Telegram APK. [Installation instructions](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushTelegram#install).

What was checked

All 2327 runtime tests passed locally, and all 664 patch tests passed too (166 unit tests and 498 that patch the real Telegram APKs), along with both Android lints (the shared library and the Telegram extension). Every one of the 82 patches applied without forcing to telegram.org's Telegram 13.2.1 (version code 72919) and to the Google Play build of 13.2.1 (version code 72911). For each patched build the release receipt checked the package name, version, manifest, resource table, native libraries and zip alignment.

Both builds were patched from this exact bundle and installed over the HushTelegram already on a Galaxy S22, without clearing its data. Both were signed in to Telegram. On each one the walk opened Telegram's Settings, Privacy, Folders and Themes pages and a channel, then every section of the HushTelegram settings and the Changed switches page. That's 22 screens per build, with no crash and no problem found on either.

HushTelegram v0.0.24 has 69 patches for the Google Play build of Telegram 13.2.1 (`org.telegram.messenger`, version code 72911) and telegram.org's Telegram 13.2.0 (`org.telegram.messenger.web`, version code 72809). The 13.1 builds aren't supported anymore, so update Telegram before you patch. It's on Morphe patcher 2.3.0 now, which needs Morphe Manager 2.5.0 or newer. Most of it came from your reports again, and it changes something for #2, #7, #34, #35, #37, #50, #53, #54, #56, #59, #60 and #61. Special contacts keeps a history of the people you choose to track. The phone number screen can sign you in on Telegram's test servers or with a bot token, and another new switch lets screenshots work in chats that don't allow saving. New switches start off, except `Keep the Keep-Alive Service running`, which only does anything while Telegram's own Keep-Alive Service is on.

New in this release

- `Special contacts`, a new switch under `Show user and chat IDs` in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel, off by default. With it on, a person's profile menu gets `Track this user`, and from then on HushTelegram keeps a history of what Telegram already shows you about them. That covers coming online and going offline, typing, and changes to their name, username, phone number or profile photo. It also notes when you save or remove them as a contact, and when they add you back or drop you. Telegram never says when someone blocks you, so that line is a guess, written when their photo and last seen disappear together. The `Tracked people` row under the switch lists everyone, newest activity first. Tap a person to read their history, clear it or stop tracking them. Each account can track up to 50 people, the newest 500 lines are kept for each, and nothing leaves the phone. (#53)

- `Ghost mode button`, under Ghost mode in Privacy and off by default. It puts a ghost at the top of the chat list, next to Telegram's own buttons, and one tap turns Ghost mode on or off with a short message saying which. The ghost is filled while Ghost mode is on and just an outline while it's off. It steps aside while search is open.

- `Add Repeat to the message menu` has a new switch, `Add Save to Gallery to stories`, off by default. A story's three-dot menu gets Telegram's own Save to Gallery without Premium, on stories that don't allow saving too. It saves only the ones you pick.

- `Add Repeat to the message menu` has a new switch, `Allow screenshots in chats that don't allow saving`, off by default. Screenshots and screen recordings stop coming out black in those chats and channels, in their photos and videos, on their profiles and in protected stories. Telegram doesn't tell anyone you took one. Secret chats, view-once media and the passcode screen stay blocked. (#34)

- `Save downloaded files` has a `What to copy` row right under its switch. Tick documents, music, photos, videos or voice messages, and only those kinds get a copy in Download/Telegram. Everything is ticked to start, so nothing changes until you untick something.

- `Keep videos muted on volume keys` has a new switch, `Start videos without sound`, off by default. A video you open plays muted, so it won't blast out in public or cut over your music. Press a volume key and that video gets its sound. The next one you open starts quiet again. Round videos keep their sound. (#61)

- `Disable double-tap reactions` has a new switch, `Hide the emoji pack line`, off by default. It takes the line that says a message contains emoji from some pack off the bottom of the long-press menu, along with the gap above it.

- `Move All Chats`, under the folder tabs settings. It starts off. With it on, an account without Premium can drag All Chats to another place among its folder tabs, and it stays there after a restart. The place is kept on this phone for this account, so your other devices still show All Chats first.

- `Fit all folder tabs` is a new switch under `Hide folder tab counters`, off by default. With lots of folders, the tabs above the chat list shrink until every one of them fits on the screen, so you don't have to scroll sideways to find one. They stop shrinking at a size that's still readable, and with only a few folders nothing changes. (#53)

- `Keep Telegram's files in internal storage` has a `Folder in internal storage` row under it, so Telegram's files can go in a folder you name, like Internal storage/Plus, instead of Internal storage/Telegram. Changing the name takes a restart, and files in the folder you used before stay there and still open. Leave it empty for Telegram. (#7)

- `Add Repeat to the message menu` has a new switch, `Add Clear from cache to the message menu`, off by default. A video or file message gets a Clear from cache item. It stops a running download, deletes what Telegram kept of it and brings the download arrow back. A toast says how much was cleared, and copies you saved to Downloads or Pictures stay.

- `Add Repeat to the message menu` has a new switch, `Add Save album art to the message menu`, off by default. A song with art, inside the file or on Telegram, gets a Save album art item that puts the picture in Pictures.

- `Add Repeat to the message menu` has a new switch, `Add Save video cover to the message menu`, off by default. A video gets a Save video cover item that puts its biggest cover or thumbnail in Pictures, fetching it first if it isn't on the phone yet.

- `Add Repeat to the message menu` has a new switch, `Add Forward to Saved Messages to the message menu`, off by default. A message you can forward gets a Forward to Saved Messages item in its long-press menu. Pick as is, without the sender's name, without the caption, or both, and it lands in your Saved Messages at once.

- `Add Repeat to the message menu` has a new switch, `Add Fast forward to the message menu`, off by default. A message you can forward gets a Fast forward item in its long-press menu. Pick without the sender's name, without the caption, or both, then pick a chat, and it goes out at once.

- `Strip link tracking` has a new switch, `Clean links when you copy or paste`, off by default. Copy a link in Telegram, or paste one into the message box, and tags like utm_source and fbclid come off. Only text that is one link and nothing else changes. Find it in HushTelegram settings > More settings > Links. (#53)

- `Faster downloads` has a third switch, `Faster uploads`, off by default. An upload keeps four times as many pieces on their way at once, up to 64. Telegram's servers still decide how fast an account can send, and the piece size and file size limits don't change. Find it in HushTelegram settings > Playback. (#53)

- `Hide popular apps` has a new switch, `Disable secret chats`, off by default. When someone asks for a secret chat, the phone ignores the request. Nothing is saved or shown and nothing is sent back, so the other person just sees it waiting. Secret chats you already have keep working. Find it in HushTelegram settings > Ads. (#53)

- `Sort chats by date` is a new switch under `Hide folder tab counters`, off by default, with a second one, `Oldest chats first`. Your unpinned chats line up by the date of their last message, newest or oldest first. Pinned chats and the archive row stay where they are, and nothing is sent to Telegram, so it only changes this phone's list. (#53)

- `Passcode for hidden chats` is a new switch under `Hide picked chats`, off by default. With it on, opening `Chats to hide`, turning off `Hide picked chats` and turning the switch itself off all ask for your Telegram passcode first. It guards this settings page only, so search still finds the hidden chats. Telegram needs a passcode set before it will turn on. (#53)

- `Administrators row in the side menu` is a new switch under `Hide folder tab counters`, off by default. It adds an `Administrators` row to the side menu. One tap lists only the groups and channels you own or manage, and the row then reads `Show all chats` to bring the rest back. It only changes this phone's list and starts off again when Telegram restarts. (#53)

- `Hide accounts` is a new switch under `Hide folder tab counters`, off by default. The accounts you tick in `Accounts to hide` leave Telegram's account lists, and only there. Each one stays signed in, keeps syncing, and its notifications follow Telegram's own settings. Nothing is signed out or deleted, the account you're using always shows, and at least one account always stays. An optional `Passcode for hidden accounts` switch asks for your Telegram passcode before the list opens. (#53)

- `Stop usage reports` now also holds `Receive only mode` and `Power off accounts`, both off by default. Pick accounts under each switch in HushTelegram settings > Privacy. A receive only account reads, downloads and marks chats read, but messages, reactions, drafts and typing stay on the phone and show an error. A powered off account sends nothing, and its name in the side menu gets an (Off) tag. Telegram's connection can stay open in the background, so a powered off account may still receive messages and notifications. (#53)

- `Use normal paste` has a new switch, `Mention by ID`, off by default. Type @ and a user's ID number, or tg://user?id= and the ID, in the message box and it goes out as a real mention. It only works for people the app has already seen, in a chat or a group. For anyone else the text stays as you typed it and a short note says so. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

- `Faster downloads` has a third switch, `Download manager`, off by default. Files download one at a time, in the order you asked for them, instead of several at once. A `Downloads` row in the side menu (turn on `Side menu` too) lists what's downloading, what's waiting and what's finished, with a Cancel for each file still going. A file you open or play still jumps the line. (#53)

- `Voice messages in the music player` has a new switch, `Remember where playback stopped`, off by default. Videos, voice messages and music pick up where you left off, even short ones. Telegram only does that for long ones. Turn it off and everything plays as Telegram plays it. (#53)

- `Add Repeat to the message menu` has a new switch, `Select between`, off by default. It adds a button to the bar that shows while you pick messages. Tap it and everything between the first and last message you picked gets selected. Pick one past the end and the gap fills in. It stops at Telegram's 100 message limit. (#53)

- `Folder icons` is a new row with the folder tab settings. Pick Regular, Bold or Filled and HushTelegram draws a small icon beside each folder in its own lists, like Folder to open. A folder called Work gets a briefcase, Friends a group, and a name it doesn't know gets a plain folder. Telegram's own folder tabs stay as they are. The icons are from Phosphor Icons (MIT). Off by default. (#53)

- `HushTelegram icon and name` has a fourth `Icon style`, `Telegram's own icon`. Pick it with an `App name` and Telegram keeps its usual icon, with only the name under it changed. (#37)

- `Test server sign-in`, under Chat list and off by default. When you sign in or add an account, the phone number screen shows Telegram's own Test Backend box. Tick it to sign that account in on Telegram's test servers, kept apart from your other accounts. Untick it to go back. With the box ticked, the phone screen also takes Telegram's test numbers (+999 66 X YYYY), which the regular app turns away as an unknown country code. (#59)

- `Translate with an outside service` adds `Translate into` to a chat's three-dot menu, right under Translate this chat. It opens the same language list as the settings row, so you can switch between your language and English without leaving the chat. Pick one and the chat is written again in it. (#35)

- `Bot token sign-in`, under Chat list and off by default. Turn it on and the phone number screen gets a `Sign in with a bot token` button, both on first sign-in and when you add an account. Paste the token @BotFather gave your bot and that account signs in as the bot. A wrong or revoked token gets a short message and the box stays open so you can fix it. Chats show up as people message the bot and you can answer them, but there's no older history, and a bot has no contacts, stickers or folders. A bot with a webhook set, or one another program is already reading, may not get its messages here. (#53)

Fixes

- `Import settings` no longer says nothing will change for a file that only picks other folder icons. It lists the change and offers to import it.

- `Hide sponsored proxy channel` works the moment you flip it. The proxy's channel used to stay in the chat list until the next message or update came in.

- `Hide Premium, gifts and Stars` now takes Send a Gift out of the three-dot menu on profiles and channels too. It was still sitting there with the switch on.

- If you hide a pinned chat and unpin it on another device, the unpin now sticks. Hidden pins also count toward your pin limit here, so you see Telegram's limit message instead of a pin the server would turn down.

- When Google sign-in fails on Telegram's login email screen, a short message now points at the email box. Telegram used to just stay on the screen after you picked an account, and a patched copy can't get past Google there.

- If you use Telegram's Keep-Alive Service instead of push, messages no longer wait until you open the app. Android stopped that service about a minute after you left Telegram. Now it runs with a quiet notification and keeps going. A new switch under `Repair Firebase push registration`, `Keep the Keep-Alive Service running`, is on by default and only matters while Keep-Alive Service is on in Telegram's own settings. (#50, #54)

- `Keep deleted messages` now saves a kept photo, and any kept file or video up to 20 MB, the moment the sender deletes it. Before, a photo you hadn't opened yet just spun forever, because Telegram can't fetch a deleted message's file later. (#2)

- `Disable update checks` now hides the Update Telegram bar even when Telegram found the update before you turned the switch on. The bar used to stay, since Telegram only forgets an update when a later check comes back empty. (#60)

- With `Keep Telegram's files in internal storage` on, the photos and videos Telegram downloads no longer fill up the phone's gallery. The folder now gets a .nomedia file, so the gallery only shows what you save to it yourself. (#60)

- `Hide greeting stickers` now also hides the custom sticker a Premium or Business user picks for their intro, the one you see when you open an empty chat with them. Only the preview of your own intro, while you edit it, keeps its sticker. (#56)

- In the `Side menu`, New Message has a pencil beside it again. Telegram 13 turned the old message icon into an eye, so the row looked like it would show you something.

Other changes

- Moved to Telegram 13.2. telegram.org's build is 13.2.0 (version code 72809) and the Google Play build is 13.2.1 (version code 72911). The 13.1 builds aren't supported anymore, so update Telegram before you patch.

- `Hide the reaction picker` now covers the bubble of reactions that pops up over a selected message too, so tapping a post to pick it for a reply or a forward can't land on a reaction.

- `Hide picked chats` now also takes hidden chats out of the forward picker, the share sheet and quick share. Saved Messages always stays in those lists.

What was checked

All 2048 runtime tests passed locally, and all 625 patch tests passed too (162 unit tests and 463 that patch the real Telegram APKs), along with both Android lints (the shared library and the Telegram extension). Every one of the 69 patches applied without forcing to telegram.org's Telegram 13.2.0 (version code 72809) and to the Google Play build of 13.2.1 (version code 72911). For each patched build the release receipt checked the package name, version, manifest, resource table, native libraries and zip alignment.

Both builds were patched from this exact bundle and installed over the HushTelegram already on a Galaxy S25, without clearing its data. Both were signed in to Telegram. On each one the walk opened Telegram's Settings, Privacy, Folders and Themes pages and a channel, then every section of the HushTelegram settings and the Changed switches page. That's 22 screens per build, with no crash and no problem found on either.

The new `Allow screenshots in chats that don't allow saving` switch was checked on the same phone. With it off, a bot message that blocks saving and a channel with Restrict saving content both came out black in screenshots, same as stock Telegram. With it on, both showed normally.

HushTelegram v0.0.23 has 67 patches for the Google Play build of Telegram 13.1.1 (`org.telegram.messenger`, version code 72371) and telegram.org's Telegram 13.1.0 (`org.telegram.messenger.web`, version code 72299). It's on Morphe patcher 2.1.0 like 0.0.22, so Morphe Manager 2.3.0 or newer still loads it. Nearly all of it came from your reports again, and it changes something for #9, #29, #39, #41, #45, #48, #49 and #50. Calls can be recorded to a file on your phone, and a record button on the call screen does it for just the call you're on. View-once and timed photos and videos can stay in the chat after you open them, or get copied to Download/Telegram. Ghost mode can hide typing and your online status now. With UnifiedPush, reaction notifications can play a sound and name custom emoji, and turning UnifiedPush on also switches on Telegram's own background connection so messages arrive while the app is closed. New switches start off, except the Ways in ones, which keep every way into the HushTelegram settings open until you change them.

New in this release

- `Ghost mode` has two more parts, `Hide typing` and `Hide online status`, both off by default. With Ghost mode and `Hide typing` on, people in a chat don't see that you're typing, recording a voice message or sending a file, in secret chats too. With `Hide online status` on, Telegram isn't told that you're online while you use it. Going offline still goes out, so your account shows as offline when you leave. The diagnostic report counts what each one kept back. (#45)

- `UnifiedPush notifications` has a new switch, `Sound for reaction notifications`, off by default. Telegram keeps every reaction notification silent. Turn it on and they play the sound and vibration you picked in Telegram's Notifications and Sounds > Reactions. (#41)

- Reaction notifications with `UnifiedPush notifications` now cover custom emoji reactions too. Once Telegram has loaded that emoji on your phone, the notification names the regular emoji it stands for. (#41)

- `Disable call debug upload` has a new switch, `Record calls`, off by default. Turn it on and every call is saved on your phone as one .m4a file with both sides in it, named for when the call began, in Recordings/Telegram calls (Music/Telegram calls on Android 11 and older). Voice chats and live streams you're in get saved the same way. The other person isn't told. On Android 9 it needs Telegram's storage permission. (#39)

- `Record button on calls`, off by default, puts a round record button on the call screen right under the minimize arrow. Tap it to record just the call you're on. With `Record calls` on, the button starts out red and a tap skips recording that one call, keeping what was already recorded. It hides along with the rest of the call screen's buttons, and the choice ends with the call. (#39)

- A new `Ways in` section on the HushTelegram settings page has a switch for each way to open them, all on by default. They are the HushTelegram row on Telegram's Settings page, a long press on the Telegram title in the chat list, the row in the side menu, and the shortcut in the menu you get from holding Telegram's icon. A way you turn off acts like stock Telegram. The row, the long press and the side menu entry are gone, and the shortcut is taken off the launcher, pinned copies included. One way always stays on so you can get back in, and turning off the last one puts the switch back with a short message. No restart needed. `Lock HushTelegram settings` holds these switches like the rest. (#29)

- `Save downloaded files` has a third switch, `Also save view-once and timed media`, off by default. With it on, view-once and self-destructing photos, videos, voice messages and video messages get copied to Download/Telegram once they download, readable like any other file. Secret chats stay in Telegram whatever the switches say. From a chat that doesn't allow saving, `Also save from chats that don't allow saving` has to be on as well. (#9)

- `Keep deleted messages` has a new switch, `Keep view-once and timed media`, off by default. Turn it on and a view-once or self-destructing photo, video, voice message or video message someone sends you stays in the chat after you open it. There's no countdown, and you can open it again as often as you like. Secret chats work as usual. Timed media you send stays on your phone too. (#9)

Fixes

- With `Hide reactions under messages` on, TalkBack no longer reads out reactions you can't see. A message reads the same as one nobody reacted to, and Saved Messages tags are still read since they still show. (#48)

- Leaving `Message times with seconds` out in Morphe Manager now really leaves it out. `Keep deleted messages` used to pull the whole patch back in, so its switch still showed in the Hush settings. Now it takes along only the part it needs to mark a message deleted. (#49)

- With `UnifiedPush` on, Hush now also turns on Telegram's own `Keep-Alive Service` and `Background Connection` once your push app hands over its address, so messages come in while Telegram is closed instead of when you next open it. It only does that if you never set either switch yourself, and the notification report says what turned them on. (#50)

Behind the scenes

- The whole-app walk opens and closes the new `Ways in` section as well. Left off the walk's list, Ways in read as more rows of Updates, and the walk failed because Updates never looked closed. A contract test now holds the walk's sections to the ones the settings home draws, in the same order.

- The whole-app walk gets past Android asking for contacts or photos over the screen it's opening. It says no (Don't allow, or Not now on Telegram's own contacts prompt, never Allow or Continue) and opens the screen again. If the ask keeps coming back, the walk's problem line names it instead of a bare "would not open".

- The release build stage writes down how long the full gate took, the same way preflight already does, so a slow gate shows up next to the earlier timing.

- Release preflight runs the pre-push hook's check for tracked files that name the maintainer's machine or a phone. Everyday pushes skip that hook, so one such name sat in a build script comment on main until the contract tests read it.

The [changelog](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushTelegram/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md) has every earlier release too.

How to update

1. Install [Morphe Manager](https://github.com/MorpheApp/morphe-manager) 2.3.0 or newer. That's the same floor as 0.0.22, so if you patched that one you're set.
2. Add HushTelegram as a patch source: https://morphe.software/add-source?github=SysAdminDoc%2FHushTelegram
3. Get the right Telegram. From Google Play that's 13.1.1 (`org.telegram.messenger`, version code 72371), which [APKMirror](https://www.apkmirror.com/apk/telegram-fz-llc/telegram/) and Uptodown also carry. From telegram.org's [Download button](https://telegram.org/android) it's 13.1.0 (`org.telegram.messenger.web`, version code 72299). The patched app needs Android 9 or newer.
4. Coming from 0.0.22? Patch the APK of the same build you're on and install it over your current HushTelegram with the same Morphe Manager signing key. Your settings and chats stay. New to HushTelegram? Uninstall the stock Telegram first, since Android won't put a patched app over one signed with a different key. Your chats come back when you sign in, but secret chats don't. Back up Morphe Manager's signing key after your first patch. You'll need it for every update.
5. If Telegram turns down your login code with `API_ID_PUBLISHED_FLOOD`, that's Telegram refusing the public API ID that ships with any patched build, the Play one included. Register your own app at [my.telegram.org/apps](https://my.telegram.org/apps), using only letters and numbers in the short name. Then select `Use registered Telegram API credentials`, fill in `apiId` and `apiHash`, and patch again. The result installs over your current HushTelegram build. Keep both values private.
6. Want HushTelegram's own icon, or Telegram's logo in white on the black launch screen? Turn on Expert mode in Morphe Manager and pick `HushTelegram icon and name` or `Black and white launch logo` before you patch.
7. For notifications, open Telegram's Settings, tap Notifications, and turn on `Keep-Alive Service` and `Background Connection` under Other, near the bottom of the page. On phones where Firebase notifications don't come through, try the `UnifiedPush notifications` switch on HushTelegram's Notifications page with a UnifiedPush app like ntfy. It turns those two on for you unless you've set them yourself.
8. To change HushTelegram's switches, open Telegram's Settings and tap HushTelegram settings, or press and hold the Telegram title at the top of your chat list. The new Ways in section on that page decides which of those (plus the side menu row and the icon shortcut) stay.

The `.mpp` download is a patch bundle, not a Telegram APK. [Installation instructions](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushTelegram#install).

What was checked

All 1728 runtime tests passed locally, and all 564 patch tests passed too (162 unit tests and 402 that patch the real Telegram APKs), along with both Android lints (the shared library and the Telegram extension). Every one of the 67 patches applied without forcing to telegram.org's Telegram 13.1.0 (version code 72299) and to the Google Play build of 13.1.1 (version code 72371). For each patched build the release receipt checked the package name, version, manifest, native libraries and zip alignment.

Both builds were patched from this exact bundle and installed over the HushTelegram already on a Galaxy S22, without clearing its data. Both were signed in to Telegram. On each one the walk opened Telegram's Settings, Privacy, Folders and Themes pages and a channel, then every section of the HushTelegram settings (the new Ways in section too) and the Changed switches page. That's 22 screens per build, with no crash and no problem found on either.

HushGram still patches Instagram 456.0.0.53.78 on Morphe patcher 2.4.0, so you patch the same way as last time. Most of this release came from you: 57 of the changes below started with one of your reports or requests. You can blur a chat behind a message you're holding, record calls, lock a collection right from Saved, keep the tab bar on reel links and hide comments that use your blocked words. There are 44 fixes too.

Fixes

- Unticking Interested or Not interested in `Items in the three-dot menus` takes them off a suggested post's menu in Home again. Instagram 456 renamed those two rows there. Reported in #707.

- The time on a feed video's seek bar is smaller now and sits under the tags and sound buttons, so tapping it no longer opens the tags instead. Reported in #711.

- The dot beside a new setting stays until you've scrolled to it. Going back out of a page cleared every dot on it, even the ones further down you never saw. Reported in #689.

- `Show if a profile follows you` now labels profiles that have a name but no pronouns. The label and badges were only showing up on profiles with no name at all. Reported in #727.

- `Ambient light in stories` no longer flashes white bars on a light theme when a story opens or you swipe to the next one. The glow also stays on until the next story's is ready. Reported in #751.

- `Long press a profile picture to view it` works on accounts with an avatar too. Their picture turns between the photo and the avatar, and a long press there used to open Instagram's avatar card instead of the picture. Reported in #758.

- Posts with several photos and a song keep their seek bar in the reels viewer now, the same as a single photo with a song. Reported in #10.

- `See-through top bar` fades out below the header now, instead of stopping on a hard line when you scroll back up. Reported in #462.

- Home no longer crashes when a hide switch removes the only post on a page of the feed, which could happen when opening a link to a post.

- With `Ask for VP9 instead of AV1` on, a post or reel Instagram still sends as AV1 saves as VP9 from its website when one's there. HushGram asks logged out. Stories can still come as AV1. Reported in #546.

- Letting go after `Hold for 2x on feed videos` no longer pauses the video when `Tap a feed video to pause it` is on too.

- The tags and sound buttons on feed videos move up above the seek bar while it shows, carousel videos' sound button too, so they don't cover its ends. The toggle sits beside them. Reported in #794.

- An exported settings file now keeps `Time on the seek bar` and `Show the time left` for feed videos too.

- The `Show if a profile follows you` label no longer lands on top of the post count on profiles with no name.

- `Glass in chats` keeps the message bar's glass when Instagram switches the bar to its newer layout, and `Message bar tint` works on it again. Reported in #759.

- Messages in a chat no longer jump and snap back while you type a long message with `Glass in chats` on. Reported in #757.

- `Hide captions` no longer leaves an empty gap under the username on reels. The username row moves down into the caption's room. Reported in #680.

- Reels that run behind the glass tab bar sit where they should again instead of up against the top of the screen with a black band under them. Reported in #763.

How to update

1. Update Morphe Manager to 2.6.0 or newer, then refresh the HushGram source.
2. Patch Instagram `456.0.0.53.78`. [Supported Instagram builds](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushGram#supported-instagram-builds) lists the builds that work.
3. Install over your current patched Instagram with the manager's existing signing key. Keep that key so updates keep working.

The `.mpp` download is a patch bundle, not an Instagram APK. [Installation instructions](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushGram#install).

HushGram now patches Instagram 456.0.0.53.78 and builds on Morphe patcher 2.4.0, so update Morphe Manager to 2.6.0 or newer before you patch. All 62 new features in this release came from your requests. You can keep a list of who viewed your stories, search your blocked accounts, give the tab bar a Material look or make Instagram's text bigger. The fix list is a long one too.

- `Hide the seek bar on reels`, new under Reels, takes the seek bar off every reel. Drag sideways along a reel's bottom edge to bring it back and seek, even where Instagram turns that off. Needs a restart. Asked for in #680.

Other changes

- HushGram now patches Instagram 455.0.0.51.72 instead of 454.0.0.54.77. Get APKMirror's (arm64-v8a) (480-640dpi) (Android 9.0+) bundle, build 386113969. Its armeabi-v7a (386113968), x86 (386113970) and x86_64 (386113971) builds are declared too.

- HushGram now patches Instagram 456.0.0.53.78 instead of 455.0.0.51.72. Get APKMirror's (arm64-v8a) (480dpi) (Android 9.0+) bundle, build 386214574. Its armeabi-v7a (386214562) and x86 (386214575) builds are declared too. Meta published no x86_64 build this time.

- HushGram now builds on Morphe patcher 2.4.0, so patching needs Morphe Manager 2.6.0 or newer. On a computer, use morphe-desktop 2.2.0 or newer.

Behind the scenes

- The push gate starts its test suites without the git settings a hook hands them. Pushed from a second worktree, the release check's test had written its stand-in tag into the real repository. Nothing reached GitHub.

- The test for `patch-for-device.ps1` caught up with the script merging a split bundle first. It now checks the merge reads the declared build's .apks and hands the CLI the merged APK.

- Three contract rules had no fixture build that breaks them, so the contract test refused the file. They keep Instagram's code from calling clear mode's `entered()` and `scrubber()` or search's `hideSection()`. Each has a failing build now.

The [changelog](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushGram/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md) has every earlier release too.

How to update

1. Update Morphe Manager to 2.6.0 or newer, then refresh the HushGram source.
2. Patch Instagram `456.0.0.53.78`. [Supported Instagram builds](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushGram#supported-instagram-builds) lists the builds that work.
3. Install over your current patched Instagram with the manager's existing signing key. Keep that key so updates keep working.

The `.mpp` download is a patch bundle, not an Instagram APK. [Installation instructions](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushGram#install).

- The color you pick in `Story ring size` reaches the rings in Home's stories row again. On 454 Instagram draws those rings through a second copy of its gradient code, which the patch now colors too. Reported in #518.

- `Story rings in the accent color` no longer leaves a pink tail on a story's ring. On 454 the default ring ends in a lavender Instagram added, and that one now takes your color too. Reported in #519.

- A liked heart in your accent color no longer has a thin light edge around it. Instagram draws the empty heart under the filled one, and with `Accent color` on that outline is left out once a post is liked. Reported in #519.

- With a bigger `Tab icon size` the tab bar's icons are no longer cut off at their old size, so Home keeps its roof and your profile picture stays round. Reported in #541.

- The retro camera app icon fills the whole icon now, whatever shape your launcher gives it. It used to sit small on a white tile. Reported in #565.

- `Don't report Blend visits` now also keeps the time you last opened a Blend to yourself. Opening one sent that time in a request of its own, which the switch didn't cover. Reported in #474.

- A 60 fps reel or story no longer saves at 30 fps when Instagram's own file is the same size as the smoother track. A tie on size now goes to the higher frame rate. Reported in #546.

- A save the connection drops partway through gets one more try right away. A 1080p story whose download was cut off used to fall back to the 720p file. Reported in #546.

- With several HushGram icons in the column beside a reel, the column no longer runs up past the top bar and cuts off Like. It's drawn just small enough to fit, and every icon still takes its own taps. Reported in #516.

- With `Glass tab bar` on, a reel's seek bar is easy to grab again. Its touch area covers the top of the bar, and dragging there moves through the reel instead of pressing a tab. Reported in #526.

- With `Glass tab bar` on, the pill no longer pops back up over a chat's message box when the keyboard opens or closes. The bar stays hidden while a chat is open now.

- With `Page dots on a pill` on, a carousel's buttons sit right under the photo, the way they do on a single photo. Instagram kept an empty strip there for the dots the pill replaces. Reported in #527.

- With `Pure black dark mode` on, a photo or GIF in a comment no longer has gray corners. Instagram's newer comments screen has its own dark gray theme, and that theme goes black now too. Reported in #538.

- On an account that doesn't have Instagram's Friends tab, tapping Friends again after you've left it opens it again. It used to do nothing until you tapped Reels first. Reported in #571.

- With `Pick friends` on, holding the Friends tab opens the list again on builds where Instagram gives each tab a hold of its own, which only cleared the tab's tooltip. Reported in #571.

- Holding the Friends tab with `Pick friends` on opens the list on Instagram 454 again. It only showed the tab's name before. Reported in #616.

- With `Glass tab bar` on and the classic tab bar layout, reels no longer jump up and down. On phones with no navigation bar room, two parts of the pill kept moving the reel back and forth. Reported in #512.

- With `Pure black dark mode` on, the strip behind the navigation bar is black while comments are open and under a reel opened from the feed. It used to show the video through it. Reported in #571.

- `Rounded post corners` now rounds the top corners of a reel in the feed too. The shadow behind its name row stayed square over them, which showed with `Ambient light` on. Reported in #571.

- New `Keep the comment bar's space` switch under the comment bar switches in Reels. A reel opened from a post or profile used to slide into the hidden bar's space. This keeps that space empty so nothing moves. Reported in #523.

- With `Seek bar on feed videos` on, a swipe up or down that starts on a video's seek bar scrolls Home instead of doing nothing. Dragging along the bar still moves through the video.

- The Saved bookmark on your profile opens Saved again. Instagram now ignores its own Saved link unless Instagram itself sent it, so tapping the bookmark did nothing. Reported in #492.

Other changes

- Settings search knows more words, like "nav bar" for the Tab bar, "dm" for Messages and "colour" for color. Categories sit in groups with a chip for each, and a category's page has buttons to jump to another one. Asked for in #642.

- Settings categories now open on their own page with the category buttons pinned on top. `Descriptions behind an info button` starts on, so a switch shows its name and a small i. A category's rows join into one rounded card. Asked for in #650.

- `Seek bar shape` now shapes story progress segments and videos opened from chats, no seek bar switch needed. `Ambient light in stories` fills a story's corners and top strip with glow. `Ambient light` on its own no longer lights stories. Asked for in #630.

- `Save comment photo` now saves a comment's GIF sticker too. Press and hold the comment and pick Save. A sticker that's only on Giphy still has no Save row. Asked for in #623.

- The diagnostic report has a `[SCREEN]` part now. It names the screen you were on, which tabs show, and the views covering most of it, so a report sent right after a blank screen shows what was in front. Asked for in #535.

- Dusk blue, Pine and Slate are now full color sets. Story rings and Instagram's other gradients run through three colors, likes and badges get the set's own color, and backgrounds start from its screen color.

- With `Keep a seek bar on Reels` on, Instagram's own track now glides between position updates too, and a round handle stays on the line's end. Reported in #10.

- `Bend light at the edges` works on the standard glass pill as well as the liquid one, round whatever corners you picked. It sits under `Blur behind the tab bar` now, since the bend needs the blur. Asked for in #391.

- The `Instagram gradient on dark` app icon is bigger on the home screen, about as big as the other icons. Reported in #327.

- `Pure black dark mode` now also blacks out the menu you get by holding a message or an inbox chat, the Instagram Plus card over it, the menu behind the + in a chat and the notes above your chats. Asked for in #543 and #635.

- With `Full screen Reels` hiding the status bar, the Reels and Friends tabs and the buttons at the top of a reel now sit just below a punch hole camera instead of under it. Asked for in #525.

- `Select text` opens a comment, caption or bio in HushGram's own dark window now, black with `Pure black dark mode`, instead of the phone's gray one. Asked for in #525.

- The story mentions sheet from the top bar floats over the story as glass now, with the story blurred behind it on Android 12 and up. Phones that can't blur get a nearly solid tint so names stay readable. Asked for in #525.

- `Glass in chats` gives the back, call and video buttons real glass circles that match the liquid tab bar, with a lit rim instead of flat grey. The thin line under a chat's top bar is gone too. Asked for in #537 and #542.

- With debug logging on, the diagnostic report has a timed line each time a tab bar moves a screen, the Reels viewer, a sheet or the space under a reel. Reported in #509 and #222.

- In Morphe Manager, `Call blocker` now sits under Privacy and `Hide the Community Standards reminder` under Fixes, so the Messages group stays short. Both switches are still on the Messages settings page.

Behind the scenes

- `scripts/gen-readme-patches.py` writes the README's patch table and counts from `patches-list.json` and leaves the rest of the README alone.

- The release walk now reads the settings overview while its own header shows HushGram's name, Home's welcome screen on 454, a long reel with its scrubber, and a screen with the activity tooltip up.

- `patch-all-builds.ps1` merges a split bundle before patching it, like the other patching scripts.

- The release facts check reads the patch count and target build from the description's sentences, so a change's bullet that counts patches no longer stops a release.

- Morphe Desktop 2.1.1 now has its reviewed advisory exceptions, so the audit accepts it.

The [changelog](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushGram/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md) has every earlier release too.

How to update

1. Update Morphe Manager to 2.5.0 or newer, then refresh the HushGram source.
2. Patch Instagram `454.0.0.54.77`. [Supported Instagram builds](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushGram#supported-instagram-builds) lists the builds that work.
3. Install over your current patched Instagram with the manager's existing signing key. Keep that key so updates keep working.

The `.mpp` download is a patch bundle, not an Instagram APK. [Installation instructions](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushGram#install).

What was checked

The bundle patched Instagram 454.0.0.54.77 cleanly, and the whole app was walked on a Galaxy S22 with every screen opened and no crash.

HushPinterest 0.0.14 has 36 patches for Pinterest 14.44.0. It's built on Morphe patcher 2.3.0, so update Morphe Manager to 2.5.0 or newer before you patch. Older Manager builds can't open this bundle.

It's also the first signed release. When you add or update the source, Manager shows who signed the bundle, and that should read `46a2 ea94 21d7 b269`. Manager keeps that key from then on and won't take an update signed by a different one.

Downloads got most of the work this time. Download pin doesn't get stuck at Queued anymore, and it now saves the videos Pinterest only streams. There's a new Change package name patch if you want HushPinterest next to the stock app, plus new switches for Inbox updates, Home suggestions, the AI Assistant and comment previews.

Pinterest 14.41.0 isn't supported anymore. Get 14.44.0, patch it with the same signing key you used before and install it over your current HushPinterest. Your settings stay as they are.

## What's new

- The patches now target Pinterest 14.44.0, version code 14448030. APKMirror has it as a plain APK for Android 10 or newer. Older Pinterest versions are refused.
- The patches are now built on Morphe patcher 2.3.0, so you'll need Morphe Manager 2.5.0 or newer to apply them.
- The patch bundle is signed now. Morphe Manager shows the signer when you add or update the source, and it should read `46a2 ea94 21d7 b269`. After that, Manager won't take a HushPinterest update signed by another key. The public key is [`morphe-signing.pub`](morphe-signing.pub) in this repo.
- Hide ads now covers Meta's ad network as well. Pinterest 14.43.0 started filling some ad slots through Meta Audience Network, and with Hide ads on, Pinterest's own consent check answers no for Meta, so that SDK never starts. Export report lists it as `Meta ad SDK` under Hide ads coverage.
- Long-press download now covers the newer list-style long-press menu too. Download shows up there and saves the pin you pressed, and the switches that hide Save, Send and Search image work on that menu as well.
- With GmsCore support, Continue with Google no longer does nothing when microG-RE can't be reached. You get a message saying to install it, turn it on or open it, and the setup guide says to add your Google account there first. Export report has a new Google sign-in section (no account names, no tokens) so a failure can be traced.

## Behind the scenes

- Release walks now bind the bundle, stock build and patch selection to the signed APK installed on the test device. Publish rejects missing or mismatched evidence, unsupported app versions, invalid times and reported problems. A survey of an installed app without matching build evidence stays diagnostic only.
- The build runs on Gradle 9.8.2. Gradle 9.7.1 had three high advisories, all fixed in 9.8.1. Two are about the local daemon and workers on the build machine, and the third is a repository fallback that the build's strict dependency checksums already guard against. The build advisory check now reads the Gradle version from the build's dependency report and refuses one in those affected ranges, since the per-library advisory lookup never covers Gradle itself.
- The patched-bytecode check now looks for the hooks where Pinterest 14.44.0 moved them. It still expected Keep Home feed's five-minute check in Home's presenter, the pin menu sheet's Download image row in its onViewCreated and the long-press list in the event handler itself, so every 14.44.0 device build stopped there even though the patches were right.
- The patched-bytecode check now knows Change package name's hook, the one that points Pinterest's own provider names at the installed copy. Every build of a second copy that sits next to Pinterest stopped there with an unclaimed call. The hook itself also checks that Change package name is in the build, like every other hook checks its own patch.
- The whole-app walk now checks that the hooks really ran. Before it restarts Pinterest it turns on every switch it has a screen for. At the end it saves the diagnostics report and fails, naming the family, when Hook status shows a hook that never ran on its screen or missed a target. A paused Hush fails it too, and so does a report that leaves out a family the walk switched on. Families it can't reach count as not exercised rather than passed, and the walk turns its switches back off when it's done. It reaches the Inbox through the button at the top of Home, since Pinterest sends the notifications link to the home feed, and takes an `-Exclude` list for phones without microG-RE.
- The whole-app walk now checks that each screen is the one it meant to open. It works through a numbered case list (Home, a home feed pin's menu and its long-press menu, a pin and its own menu, three searches, the Inbox, the Hush settings and each of their pages) and fails a case when Pinterest's login screen or any other screen shows instead, naming the mark that was missing. The boards and people searches have to show their own filter chip and no pins, so the pins tab can't stand in for them, and the Inbox needs its title with the home feed gone. The long press starts from a fresh look at the home feed with no menu left open and cancels the touch instead of lifting it, so nothing on the menu gets picked. Leaving a case or a hook family out makes the walk PARTIAL. The receipt lists each case with its result and the menu layout Pinterest served, when the walk recognizes it. The walk starts Pinterest first if it isn't running, so the stop always leaves its own record. After that it reads Android's exit records after every screen and fails on any crash, freeze or restart of Pinterest, or a helper process killed while it was still in use. Only the stop's own record and helpers the system cleared once they were idle are excused, and a crash in a cloned or work profile copy of Pinterest doesn't count. Publishing checks all of this again and classes every exit a second time from the facts the receipt keeps, so a receipt from a shorter walk, an older case list, a walk with a failing exit or one without the stop's record can't back a release.
- Release receipts now record how each target's native libraries hold up on phones with Android's 16 KB memory pages. The device build and the receipt build both compare the patched APK's libraries with Pinterest's own, checking their bytes, their compression, the extractNativeLibs flag and `zipalign -c -P 16`. If patching changed, dropped or added a library, or broke alignment Pinterest shipped with, the build stops there. A library Pinterest itself ships off the 16 KB boundary is reported as Pinterest's problem and doesn't stop anything. On 14.44.0 every 64-bit library is aligned and all 68 come through patching unchanged. The receipt marks the check on a real 16 KB device as still to do.
- The build signs the bundle when `HUSHPINTEREST_BUNDLE_SIGNING_KEY` is set and refuses any key that isn't the one `morphe-signing.pub` publishes. The release checks the signature again on every copy of the assets, the one it builds, one an earlier run left and one it takes back from GitHub, before anything is uploaded. The index names the key only from a bundle that passed that check.
- The prepare stage checks the source census before it cuts anything. Only publish used to ask, after the GitHub release was already out, so a census older than two weeks stopped a release halfway.
- Changelog entries don't open with a "Pinterest:" label anymore. HushPinterest only patches Pinterest, so it repeated itself on every line. The release scripts stopped adding or asking for it, and drop it from any bullet that still has one when a release is cut.
- The source census now reads a GitLab source's watched folders with one GraphQL question for up to 30 branch and folder pairs, instead of a REST request for each, and asks about each branch comparison only once a run. GitLab lets an address with no token make about 60 REST requests an hour, so a mirror with a few dozen branches ran out before the census could finish. Forks that GitLab has queued for deletion are left out as well. A scanner keeps forking ReVanced's mirror and deleting the fork again, and 92 of the first 100 forks there were waiting to go.
- The source census can now place a bundle in Jman's index that downloads from its project's own server, the way Reseam's do. It takes the GitHub repository the row names only when a release there of the same version carries a file with the hash Jman recorded. Before, every such row came back as an address with no repository, and the census couldn't finish clean. It also asks again when an index answers a server error or a GitHub code search page comes back a hit short, since both clear up within a minute. Only an answer that's still wrong after a few tries holds the census back.

## Install

1. Install [Morphe Manager](https://github.com/MorpheApp/morphe-manager) 2.5.0 or newer.
2. Add HushPinterest as a patch source: https://morphe.software/add-source?github=SysAdminDoc%2FHushPinterest
3. Download Pinterest 14.44.0, version code `14448030`. APKMirror has it as a plain APK for Android 10 or newer, so there's nothing to merge. Pick that file in Manager.
4. Uninstall the stock Pinterest first, since Android won't put one over the other. Save anything you keep only on the phone before you do. Your boards and pins come back when you sign in. If you'd rather keep the stock app, pick Change package name in Expert mode and HushPinterest installs beside it with its own sign-in.
5. Sign in with your email and a Pinterest password. If you joined through Google or Facebook, tap `Forgot your password?` on Pinterest's login page to set one first. On a phone with microG-RE, pick GmsCore support when you patch and Continue with Google goes to microG-RE's sign-in instead.
6. Right after your first patch, export Morphe Manager's signing key (Settings, then System, then Import & export, then Signing key) and keep it somewhere private. Updates only install over a Pinterest signed with that same key.

Already on HushPinterest? Update Manager, then skip steps 4 and 5. Patch 14.44.0 with the same key and install it over the one you have.

The `.mpp` download is a patch bundle, not a Pinterest APK. [Installation instructions](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushPinterest#install). The bundle is signed for Morphe Manager with the key in [`morphe-signing.pub`](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushPinterest/blob/main/morphe-signing.pub), and Manager should show the signer as `46a2 ea94 21d7 b269`. `SHA256SUMS.txt` is signed with the HushPinterest release key, fingerprint `FCE5 ECE3 182A 647B 3AF2  C5ED 2DC3 5E8D 5C00 E8A6`. [How to check a download](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushPinterest#verify-a-release-download).

If the picture is too big, isn't really an image, or takes too long, you're told so and your clipboard stays as it was. (#11)

Its row sits under Copy image and opens Android's share menu with the full-size picture itself rather than a link, so the app you pick gets the image. It now waits a moment for a helper to come free.

When a pin shows only a smaller size, the link to that size goes on the clipboard right away, and it becomes the original's link once Pinterest's media server answers, but only if the clipboard still holds that copy. Everything that talks to the file's app now runs on its own helper, never on the screen's thread, including the clean-up after a list that couldn't be written while HushPinterest was paused.

- The release check and the publish step leave a GitHub description alone when it names no version, patch count or Pinterest build, since there's nothing in it to go stale. One that names any of them still has to match the release. This release would have stopped on the shorter description the repository uses now.
- The source census reads Jman's bundle registry again. On October 14 the registry took down the files the audit read and now serves the same list from its own site, so every audit since stopped on a missing file. It reads all of the site's pages, not only the first hundred releases.
- The device scripts write their lease times in UTC with a `Z` at the end. They used `+00:00`, and the other tools sharing the test phone took a lease written that way as already expired. They also read a `Z` time as UTC now. Before, a busy phone's expiry was read as local clock time, so an expired lease looked hours from ending.
- The script tests now clean up after themselves. The pre-push cases remove the worktree the hook builds in, and a passing host reference run deletes its report folder. Each run used to leave both in the temp directory.

## Install

1. Install [Morphe Manager](https://github.com/MorpheApp/morphe-manager) 1.34.0 or newer.
2. Add HushPinterest as a patch source: https://morphe.software/add-source?github=SysAdminDoc%2FHushPinterest
3. Download Pinterest 14.41.0, version code `14418010`. APKMirror has it as an arm64-v8a bundle (`.apkm`) for Android 12L or newer. Pick that file in Manager and it merges the parts before patching.
4. Uninstall the stock Pinterest first, since Android won't put one over the other. Save anything you keep only on the phone before you do. Your boards and pins come back when you sign in.
5. Sign in with your email and a Pinterest password. If you joined through Google or Facebook, tap `Forgot your password?` on Pinterest's login page to set one first.
6. Right after your first patch, export Morphe Manager's signing key (Settings, then System, then Import & export, then Signing key) and keep it somewhere private. Updates only install over a Pinterest signed with that same key.

Already on HushPinterest? Skip steps 4 and 5. Patch 14.41.0 with the same key and install it over the one you have.

The `.mpp` download is a patch bundle, not a Pinterest APK. [Installation instructions](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushPinterest#install). `SHA256SUMS.txt` is signed with the HushPinterest release key, fingerprint `FCE5 ECE3 182A 647B 3AF2  C5ED 2DC3 5E8D 5C00 E8A6`. [How to check a download](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushPinterest#verify-a-release-download).

## Reported issues

- #2: Download pin now shows in the full-screen pin menu some accounts get from a pin's three dots, so it's there whichever menu Pinterest gives you.
- #11: Copy image and Share image under Download pin, the three long-press hide switches and Show posted date all came from this one.
- #12: Black comments covers the gray strip under the status bar now, on photo and video pins.
- #13: There's a new switch, Hide Search image label on pins, that takes the label off the lens button.
- #14: Hide suggested replies takes away the row of ready-made replies next to the comment box.

## Validation

All 232 patch tests and 1067 extension tests passed on this commit, none skipped. The bundle attached here was patched onto a real Pinterest 14.41.0 bundle from APKMirror with Morphe's desktop patcher, and all 32 patches applied without forcing. `release-receipt-0.0.12.json` records that result, the bundle's hash and what patching changed in the app's manifest.

Before release, these patches went on a signed-in phone running Pinterest 14.41.0, installed over 0.0.11 with the same key, so the sign-in and settings carried over. The new switches were tried there one at a time: Filter feed, Keep Home feed, Show posted date, Copy and Share image, the long-press hides, Hide suggested replies, Hide pins that say they're AI and the full-screen menu's Download rows. Black comments left no gray strip under the status bar, and Black bottom bar and Black pin menu stayed black on the new version. Copy media link put the smaller size's link on the clipboard right away and swapped in the original's once Pinterest answered. Queue selected stayed off until a pin was picked, Save list wrote its file, and the Feed page's new row opened Pinterest's own AI setting.

The Search image label switch is covered by tests but wasn't seen on the phone, since Pinterest only shows that label on the first two pins each day. Copy media link leaving a newer copy alone and Save list's 30 second limit are covered by tests too.
