# PixelBoard Stable Release v1.3.3

## Summary
PixelBoard v1.3.3 brings important daily usability fixes and AI stability updates: **word suggestions are back**, the **glowing voice bar no longer gets stuck**, the **one-tap blue "Fix it" proofreading button is restored**, you can now **minimize the voice typing bar** easily, and **AI Writing Tools (Rephrase, Tone changes) work reliably across all your apps** without errors.

---

## What's New in v1.3.3

-  **Word Suggestions Are Back**: Next-word suggestions and predictive text now display normally above the keyboard as you type.
-  **"Fix it" Button Restored**: The blue "Fix it" button and inline grammar suggestions now appear automatically whenever spelling or grammar mistakes are detected.
-  **Minimize Voice Typing Bar**: Tap the minimize arrow during voice typing to smoothly collapse the voice bar and return to the keyboard anytime.
-  **More Reliable AI Writing Tools**: Changing tone (Professional, Casual, Concise) and rephrasing text now works smoothly without timeouts or "can't use writing tools" errors.
-  **Works in Every App**: AI Proofread and Writing Tools now work across all third-party messaging and notes apps with zero restrictions.
-  **Clear Voice Button Labels**: TalkBack screen readers now clearly announce voice buttons as "Minimize keyboard" and "Back to keyboard".
-  **Zero Setup Needed**: Modern Google Sans font and the convenient Undo button are enabled automatically from the start.

---

## Detailed Improvements

### Word Suggestions & Stuck Voice Bar Fix ([#109](https://github.com/Akshayykadam/PixelBoard/issues/109))
  - **Word Suggestions Restored**: When typing, predictive next-word candidates were previously blocked because the voice toolbar remained active. Word suggestions now display cleanly and responsively above your keys.
  - **Fixed Stuck Glowing Bar**: After using voice dictation, the rainbow gradient bar previously stayed stuck across the top of the keyboard even when idle. It now hides immediately when speech is done, keeping your keyboard clean and clutter-free.

  - **One-Tap "Fix it" Button**: Restored the prominent blue "Fix it" chip above your keyboard. Whenever you type a misspelled word or grammar error, tapping "Fix it" instantly corrects it.

### Minimize Voice Typing Toolbar ([#108](https://github.com/Akshayykadam/PixelBoard/pull/108))
  - **Easy Collapse**: Added back the down-arrow minimize key on the voice typing bar. You can smoothly collapse the voice bar back down to a floating button or return to the regular keyboard with one tap.
  - **TalkBack Screen Reader Support**: Added clear spoken descriptions (*"Minimize keyboard"* and *"Back to keyboard"*) so users with screen readers can easily navigate voice typing controls.

### Reliable AI Writing Tools Across All Apps
  - **Smooth Rewriting & Tone Switching**: Fixed connection issues that caused Rephrase, Professional, Casual, Concise, and Emotive tones to fail or time out. Text generation is now fast and dependable.
  - **No App Restrictions**: Removed artificial app limits—use AI proofreading and rewriting inside any messaging app, social media, or text editor.

### Clean Defaults Out of the Box
  - **Google Sans Font**: Keycaps use modern Google Sans variable typography automatically on Android 12+.
  - **Quick Undo**: The Undo button is ready in your suggestion strip whenever autocorrect changes a word you didn't want changed.
  - **Emoji Quick Bar & Magic Emoji**: Fast emoji bar and magic emoji suggestions (🪄) are ready out of the box with all-app support.

Stable build for Waze **5.28.4.900** (versionCode 1030753). 37 rows.

### The fixes behind the "it applies but nothing happens" reports
Waze's map, alert engine and Android Auto layer read their settings from a **native** config store, not from the Java getters the rows were changing. On this build, 71 of the 80 forced keys never reached it, so the row flipped a settings screen and left the driving behaviour untouched. Every forced key is now written to both stores, strings included, and a check in the build fails if one is missing.

### Rows that were verified dead and rewired
- **YouTube Music / Any audio app** — the partner entries were appended after the list had been measured, so they never entered it. The length is reloaded before the roster is sized.
- **Hide recent destinations** — the empty list was written into the wrong register; callers received `null`, not an empty list.
- **Picture-in-picture** — touches were routed to a hard-coded view id that is a different view on this build; the map is now resolved by name.
- **Lane guidance** — the consumer requires a third flag (`LANE_GUIDANCE_USER_ENABLED`) that was never set.
- **Live drive sharing** — the map button also needs `SHARE_DRIVE_BUTTON_BACK_ENTRY_POINT_ENABLED`.
- **Remove ads** — search results carry their own two gates, now forced.
- **Cameras & hazards** — crosswalks were only switched on in Settings; the two announcement keys are now set, so a mapped crosswalk warns instead of only drawing.
- **Car map zoom** — the write hung off an unrelated setter and could be skipped; it goes through the shared guarded helper on every config sync.
- **Allow high refresh rate** — 90 Hz became 88 and 165 became 160 because the constant truncates the double; such rates are now refused instead of silently changed.
- **Instrument cluster** — the "large layout" option was actually Waze's light-commercial-vehicle mode and was on by default. Off by default, renamed.
- **Smoother Android Auto map** — dropped a key Waze removed in this version.

### Option values are validated
Passing a label where a value token belongs ("Phone only" instead of "phone") used to apply cleanly and change nothing. It now aborts with the accepted values listed.

### Supported builds
Every row is pinned to **5.28.4.900**. Waze 5.27.90.900 uses **0.30.64**, which pins that build; a bundle refuses a build it was not verified against rather than half-applying.

Verified on 5.28.4.900: every row alone (37/37), every option variant (18/18), option effects read back from the built APK (16/16), and all rows together with non-default options — 37/37 applied, 0 broken branch targets, frame count identical to stock, 85/85 forced keys reaching the native store.

Development build for Waze **5.28.4.900** (versionCode 1030753). 37 rows.

### Fixed: Alert distances (issue #24)
The row applied cleanly and changed nothing, because the numbers only reached Waze's Java config getter while the alert engine reads its policy from the **native** config store. Every distance is now written to both. Standard writes nothing at all; the row is off by default and defaults to Moderate - a row that looks enabled and does nothing was the bigger trap.

Waze's server also turns on a time-based trigger window, and with it on an alert only appears as far ahead as you drive in 22 s (30 s for police, 200 m minimum), so wide distances were never reached. It is now forced off for Moderate and Heavier, the same conclusion bearinmindcat/morphe-patches reached in its issue #157.

New: **Speed cameras - all types** (`CONFIG_VALUE_ALERTS_ALERTER_ALERT_DISTANCE`). In most countries this single key drives normal camera alerts; the three enforcement-zone distances alone did not move them.

- 外した版：Reddit 2026.45.0（Morphe 公式のパッチ 2.3.0 で、公式の最新の対象が 2026.46.0 に変わったためです）

Reddit のパッチの中身は変えていません。2026.45.0 を使っている場合は、アプリを README の表の版に入れ替えてください。

### Twitch

**パッチを機能ごとに分けました。** `Block ads`・`Chat enhancements`・`Player enhancements` はなくなり、全 63 個から必要なものを選べます（[一覧](https://github.com/sabopura/sabopura-morphe-patches/blob/v1.19.0/docs/twitch.md#パッチ一覧)）。更新するときは、Morphe Manager でパッチを選び直してください。対応する Twitch の版は 1.18.3 と同じです。

### Twitch：設定画面とメニュー

- プレイヤーメニューと設定画面を作り直しました。ドラッグで動くシート、指に追従するスイッチとスライダー、スリープのダイヤル、動画の上の短い通知、メニューの並べ替えなどです。動きを減らす端末の設定に従います。
- 設定は使う場面ごとに 7 つに分けました（広告／チャット／弾幕／プレイヤー／ホームと表示／アカウントとプライバシー／このパッチについて）。最初の画面に、それぞれのオン・オフと、止めた広告などの累計が出ます。広い画面では、一覧と中身の 2 列になります。
- チャットと弾幕の設定に見本を付けました。文字サイズや時刻、速さなどを変えると、その場で見本が変わります。
- 設定の書き出しと読み込みを足しました（「このパッチについて」の「設定の引っ越し」）。別の鍵で署名した版や別アプリとして入れ直すと設定が空になるので、その前に書き出しておけます。
- 「このパッチについて」に、パッチ集と Twitch のバージョン、「診断」を足しました。Twitch の版が変わってパッチの一部が働かなくなったとき、その箇所を記録して、コピーや共有で不具合の報告に貼れます（アカウントの情報は含みません）。
- 設定・メニュー・通知の文は、日本語と英語があります。アプリ（またはスマホ）の言語に合わせて出ますが、「このパッチについて」の「表示言語」で、日本語か English に固定できます。
- 画面の読み上げ（TalkBack）とキーボードで操作できるようにしました。
- 起動直後のクラッシュが続いたときに、パッチの機能を自動で止める安全装置を入れました。パッチの処理が途中で失敗しても、Twitch を落とさずに本来の動きへ戻るようにしています。

### Twitch：広告

- 31.9.0 以降のホームから開いた配信で、広告の差し替えが働いていなかったのを直しました（広告のない再生リストに差し替えられず、黒い画面で隠すだけになっていました）。
- 予備の再生リストが 1 回取れなかっただけで広告に戻っていた、いちばん高い画質で見ていると差し替えられなかった、別のプレイヤーの広告で画面が黒くなった、といった不具合を直しました。

### Twitch：弾幕

- VOD でも弾幕が流れます。チャットのリプレイを再生位置に合わせて流すので、チャットを閉じた全画面でも流れ、一時停止・シーク・倍速にも合います（弾幕の設定の「VOD でも流す」）。
- 弾幕が配信の遅れに合わせて流れるようになりました。映像が大きく遅れているとき、遅れのうち約 3 秒を超える分だけコメントを待たせるので、まだ見ていない場面への反応が先に流れません。これまでどおりにするには、弾幕の設定の「配信の遅れに合わせる」をオフにします。
- プレイヤーの操作部が出ている間は弾幕を薄くして、ボタンや題名を読めるようにしました。
- NG ワードの正規表現のうち、文法が正しくない式や極端に時間がかかる式（`(a+)+` など）は使いません。使わなかった式は、設定の行に表示します。

### Twitch：チャット

- チャットの読み上げ、入力欄の上の定型文チップ、チャットの速さのグラフを足しました。読み上げの声は、発言の文字に合わせて日本語と英語を切り替えます（「声の言語」で、端末の言語・日本語・英語に固定もできます）。エモートの名前は読みません（「エモートの名前も読む」で読めます）。同じ文字の長い連続は短く読み、日本語の声では「www」を「わら」、「888」を「ぱちぱち」と読みます。
- 7TV の名前のペイントを表示できます（「エモートとバッジ」の「7TV の名前のペイントを表示」。初期値はオフ）。7TV の登録者が名前に付けているグラデーションや画像を、チャットの名前にそのまま描きます。
- 指定したユーザーの発言をハイライトできます（フィルターの「ハイライトするユーザー」）。ハイライト・初めての発言・交互の背景は、文字の後ろだけでなく行の幅いっぱいに付くようになりました。
- 追加エモートの選択画面を、画像のグリッド（お気に入り／チャンネル／グローバル、検索）に作り直しました。タップしても閉じないので続けて選べます。`:` の入力補完の候補にも画像が付きます。
- 過去チャット・履歴の検索・ユーザー検索を、プレイヤーメニューと同じ見た目のシートに作り直しました。Twitch のエモートも画像で出ます。
- 過去チャットで、空白のない本文のメッセージが抜け落ちていたのを直しました。日本語のチャットはほとんどが空白のない本文なので、流れの速い日本語の配信では 500 件のうち 10 件ほどしか出ていませんでした。
- 「送信時刻を表示」をオンにすると、バッジのある行では時刻が出ずに同じバッジが 2 つ並び、バッジのない行では時刻が名前の色になっていたのを直しました。
- そのほか：動くエモートが静止画になっていた、31.9.0 で VOD のチャットに追加エモートなどが出なかった、ログイン名で非表示にした人が弾幕と読み上げには出ていた、文字サイズを変えているとエモートとバッジの大きさが途中で変わった、のを直しました。

### Twitch：プレイヤー

- 読み込みが止まったときの自動の再読み込み、レイドで勝手に移動しない、チャンネルごとの設定の記憶を足しました。
- 動画が終わったあと、次の動画が勝手に始まらないようにできます（`Player: No autoplay after videos`。設定の「動画が終わったら次を自動再生しない」）。スリープタイマーには、VOD で選べる「この動画が終わったら」を足しました。
- プレイヤーメニューに「消音」と「画面ロック」を足しました。消音は、端末の音量を変えずに見ている配信や動画の音だけを消します。画面ロックは、タッチと戻る操作を受け付けなくします（左上の鍵のボタンを長押しで解除）。
- 戻る操作で、ミニプレイヤーにせずプレイヤーを閉じられます（`Player: Close instead of mini player`。「プレイヤー › レイアウト」の「戻るでプレイヤーを閉じる（ミニプレイヤーにしない）」）。
- VOD のプレイヤーにも、パッチのメニューボタンが出るようになりました（これまではどの版でも出ていませんでした）。縦型のクリップ用プレイヤーには出ません。
- 31.9.0 以降の VOD で、チャプターとチャット同期が出ない、覚えた速度が当たらない、チャンネルの追加エモートが出ない、という状態だったのを直しました。
- 一時停止から戻るたびに覚えた VOD の速度と音量に戻されていた、「キャストボタンを隠す」が VOD のプレイヤーで効いていなかった、のを直しました。
- 小窓（ピクチャーインピクチャー）で見ている間に配信のリンクを開くと、小窓の動画が全画面に戻るだけで、開いた配信に切り替わらないことがあったのを直しました（`Fix links during picture-in-picture`。VOD を小窓にしているとき、約半分の割合で起きていました）。

### Twitch：ホームと表示

- 31.9.0 以降のスマホではホームが新しい作りになり、フォロー中の欄の設定が効かなくなっていました。「フォロー中のカテゴリを隠す」「視聴の続きを隠す」「オフラインのチャンネルを隠す」と、「表示の整理」の「広告なしプランの案内を隠す」（フォロー中のタブのボタン）は、新しいホームのままで効くようにしました。見出しも空白も残りません。
- 「配信を大きなカードで表示」と「おすすめ配信を隠す」は、新しいホームでは効きません。そのために「従来のホーム画面を使う」（初期値はオフ）を足しました。オンにすると、Twitch がタブレットなどで使っている従来のホームに切り替わり、この 2 つも効きます。
- 配信のリキャップ（配信のクリップをまとめた棚）を隠せます（`Interface: Hide recaps`。「表示の整理」の「配信のリキャップを隠す」）。チャンネルのページと従来のホームで効きます。新しいホームの棚は隠せません。
- 「探索タブを隠す」は、実際のタブの名前に合わせて「ブラウズタブを隠す」に直しました（設定はそのまま引き継がれます）。

### Twitch：そのほか

- 他のパッチ集から良い部分を取り込みました：既定の画質、起動時のタブ、起動画面の固まり解消、解析の停止、共有リンクの掃除、更新案内の停止、Drops の自動受け取り、AMOLED 黒、エモートのタップ表示、コンパクトチャット、ログインせずに見る、など。出典は [NOTICE](https://github.com/sabopura/sabopura-morphe-patches/blob/v1.19.0/NOTICE) にあります。
- ポイントのボーナスの自動受け取りを、設定のスイッチで止められるようにしました（パッチを当て直す必要はありません）。累計の「受け取ったボーナス」は、成功した回数だけ数えるようにしました。
- 別アプリとして入れたとき（`Install: Separate app`）に、横向きの強制・表示の整理・エモートのボタン・遅延バッジが効かなかったのを直しました。
- 「フォロー解除ボタンを隠す」が 30.7.2 で効かない恐れがあったのを直しました。
- 設定の値の形式が食い違っているとき（手で書き換えた設定を読み込んだ場合など）に、配信を開くと Twitch が落ちることがあったのを直しました。

- เพิ่มหน้า "ผู้ที่อ่านแล้ว" ดูได้ว่าใครอ่านข้อความแล้วในกลุ่มและแชทหลายคน การตั้งค่าทั้งหมดปิดไว้เป็นค่าเริ่มต้น
  - แสดงไอคอนของสมาชิกที่อ่านข้อความของคุณแล้วไว้ข้าง "อ่านแล้ว"
  - แสดง "อ่านแล้ว N" และไอคอนผู้ที่อ่านแล้วเหนือเวลาในข้อความของผู้อื่น (ตั้งค่าแยกกันได้)
  - แตะการแสดงสถานะอ่านแล้ว หรือเลือก "ผู้ที่อ่านแล้ว" ในเมนูกดค้างของข้อความ เพื่อเปิดรายการสมาชิกที่อ่านแล้วและยังไม่ได้อ่าน
  - ซิงค์บันทึกการอ่านของแชทนั้นกับเซิร์ฟเวอร์เมื่อเปิดรายการ (เมื่อปิดจะไม่มีการสื่อสาร)
- เพิ่ม "ซ่อน Agent i ในเมนู +" ซ่อนสวิตช์ "แสดง Agent i ในห้องแชท" ที่ด้านบนของเมนู + ในแชท ค่าเริ่มต้นคือเปิด
- เพิ่ม "ซ่อนไลฟ์สด" ในส่วนหน้าหลักของ "ซ่อนรายการ" ซ่อนการ์ดไลฟ์สดในฟีดหน้าหลัก เช่น LINE MUSIC ของบัญชีทางการ ค่าเริ่มต้นคือปิด และจะมีผลหลังรีสตาร์ท

แก้ไข:
- "เปิดลิงก์ในเบราว์เซอร์ภายนอก" ใช้กับลิงก์ในริชแมสเสจ ริชเมนู และการ์ดของบัญชีทางการด้วยแล้ว (#18)
- แก้ปัญหาในฟีเจอร์อ่านโดยไม่ส่งสถานะอ่านแล้ว ที่แม้จะปิดทั้งการตั้งค่าเมนูและการแจ้งเตือน ก็ยังระงับสถานะอ่านแล้วต่อไปนานสูงสุด 2 วินาทีหลังปิดแชท
- เพิ่มการตรวจสอบก่อนแพตช์ หากโครงสร้างภายในของ LINE ไม่ตรงกับที่คาดไว้ จะไม่แก้ไขโค้ด

เปลี่ยนแปลง:
- ชื่อแพตช์ที่แสดงใน Morphe เป็นภาษาอังกฤษแล้ว หน้าการตั้งค่าไม่เปลี่ยนแปลง

รายการผู้ที่อ่านแล้วสร้างจากบันทึกการอ่านที่ LINE บันทึกไว้ในอุปกรณ์นี้ จำนวนจึงตรงกับ "อ่านแล้ว N" ของ LINE

รองรับ LINE 26.16.0 (versionCode 261600106)

## Bahasa Indonesia

Baru:
- Menambahkan halaman "Pembaca". Di grup dan chat multi-orang, Anda dapat melihat siapa yang telah membaca pesan. Semua pengaturan nonaktif secara default.
  - Tampilkan ikon anggota yang telah membaca pesan Anda di samping "Dibaca"
  - Tampilkan "Dibaca N" dan ikon pembaca di atas waktu pada pesan orang lain (masing-masing dapat diatur terpisah)
  - Ketuk tanda dibaca, atau pilih "Pembaca" di menu tekan lama pesan, untuk membuka daftar anggota yang sudah dan belum membaca
  - Sinkronkan catatan baca chat tersebut dengan server saat membuka daftar (tidak ada komunikasi jika nonaktif)
- Menambahkan "Sembunyikan Agent i di menu +". Menyembunyikan tombol "Tampilkan Agent i di ruang chat" di bagian atas menu + chat. Aktif secara default.
- Menambahkan "Sembunyikan siaran langsung" di bagian Beranda pada Sembunyikan item. Menyembunyikan kartu siaran langsung di feed Beranda, seperti LINE MUSIC dari akun resmi. Nonaktif secara default; berlaku setelah aplikasi dimulai ulang.

Perbaikan:
- "Buka tautan di browser eksternal" kini juga berlaku untuk tautan di pesan kaya, menu kaya, dan kartu akun resmi (#18).
- Pada fitur baca tanpa tanda dibaca, tanda dibaca tidak lagi tetap ditahan hingga 2 detik setelah chat ditutup saat pengaturan menu dan notifikasi sama-sama nonaktif.
- Memperketat pemeriksaan sebelum menerapkan patch, sehingga kode tidak diubah jika struktur internal LINE tidak sesuai harapan.

Perubahan:
- Nama patch yang ditampilkan di Morphe kini dalam bahasa Inggris. Halaman pengaturan tidak berubah.

Daftar pembaca dibuat dari catatan baca yang disimpan LINE di perangkat Anda, sehingga jumlahnya sama dengan "Dibaca N" di LINE.

Mendukung LINE 26.16.0 (versionCode 261600106).

HushTumblr 0.0.11 has 57 patches for Tumblr 47.0.0.108. It's built on Morphe patcher 2.3.0, so it needs Morphe Manager 2.5.0 or newer.

Two patches are new, and both start off. Hide reblogs of your posts keeps other people's reblogs of your posts out of your dashboard. Tags open the blog's tag search sends a tap on a tag to that blog's own search instead of all of Tumblr. Hide ads now catches the app promos on tag pages and in search, Hide Blaze prompts takes the Blaze buttons off posts, and the row of buttons under your own posts picks up the dark background at last. A lot of the rest is for people who use the HushTumblr settings with a keyboard, a D-pad or TalkBack.

Coming from 0.0.10, patch Tumblr 47.0.0.108 with the default selection and install it over your current build, and your settings stay. Coming from stock Tumblr, uninstall it first, then install the patched app and sign in with your email.

## What's new

- Line between posts only draws between two posts now. It used to show up under headings like "Looking for more?", above carousels and around buttons too, where it didn't divide anything. Sponsored and Blaze posts still count as posts.
- Hide ads now takes out the one-line app promos that tag pages and search results slip between posts, like "Made with WordPress" with its Install button.
- Dark background color now reaches the row of buttons under your own posts too, the one with Blaze, delete and edit. It kept a lighter gray strip with a rounded bottom under each post, which stood out on a black background. It takes the card's color now on your blog, in drafts, the queue and scheduled posts. With the switch off or HushTumblr paused it's Tumblr's gray as before.
- Hide Blaze prompts now takes the Blaze buttons off posts too. The flame under your own posts goes, and so does Blaze in a post's three-dot menu, Blaze in the share sheet and Promote in a community post's menu. Delete and edit keep their places. Your Blaze dashboard and the Keep Blaze posts switch under Hide ads work as before, and with the switch off or HushTumblr paused every button is back.
- Reveal allowed mature content now opens labeled posts on the first screen after Tumblr starts. Tumblr picks each post's cover while it lays out the dashboard, and that usually happened before its answer about your Content Labels setting came back, so the first posts kept their cover until a refresh. HushTumblr now keeps the last yes for your account for up to a day and checks again in the background every time. A no, or an answer it can't read, wipes it at once. The diagnostic report also counts the checks, the answers and the covers lifted, so a cover that stays up shows where it stopped.
- New **Tags open the blog's tag search** switch on the Posts page, off by default. Tapping a tag under a post opens that blog's own search for the tag, the page you'd see at blog.tumblr.com/tagged, instead of a search of all of Tumblr. It works in the dashboard, other feeds and a post you open by itself. A post with no blog name to go on, or a community's post, keeps Tumblr's usual search.
- New **Hide reblogs of your posts** switch on the Feed page, off by default. It takes other people's reblogs of your posts out of your dashboard, so a post of yours that's going around doesn't keep coming back to you between the posts of people you follow. A reblog counts when it came straight from one of your blogs or when one of your blogs made the original post. Your own reblogs stay unless **Hide your own reblogs** is on too. Your blog, a post you open by itself and the rest of Tumblr still show them all.
- Settings with TalkBack: flipping a switch that needs a restart keeps your place on that switch now. The Restart row showing up above it used to grab the focus and read itself out, and then the switch's "Restart Tumblr to apply" line got read again on its own. A switch also says its state once now, instead of "on, Switch" and then "ON, Switch" a second time.
- Turning Hide ads off with Tumblr open doesn't close Tumblr anymore when a feed reloads before the restart (changing the text size did it). The feed went to load a Smart banner ad, and Hide ads had kept that ad network from being set up when Tumblr started. Whatever Hide ads turned off now stays off until you restart Tumblr, which the restart row already asks for, and Disable analytics works the same way.
- Custom font: picking a font while Tumblr couldn't save its settings used to put the new file in place under the old font's name. Nothing changes now until the new name is saved. Two picks made close together can't mix their files anymore, and a font that couldn't be copied because storage is full isn't called a broken file.
- Settings with TalkBack: a refused save in the word lists is read once now. It was read twice, from a pop-up and again from the line under the field.
- Settings with TalkBack: coming back from the file picker (Choose a font file, Import settings, Export settings) puts you back on the row you opened it from. TalkBack used to start over at the top of the page.
- Arrow keys work on the settings page. With a keyboard or a D-pad they did nothing there until Tab was pressed, since the page itself held on to the focus.
- Settings with a keyboard: going Back to the main settings page leaves your keys on the row you opened, with TalkBack on or off. That holds after the screen was redrawn too, and a row that sat half off the edge comes all the way into view. The next arrow key used to start from a different row.
- Settings with a keyboard: the first arrow key after you've touched the page lands on the top row in view, and the "HushTumblr is on" card stays where it was. That key used to scroll the card away, and TalkBack read nothing for it.
- Settings with a keyboard or D-pad: the card's Pause button isn't a stop for arrow keys anymore. Pressing Enter on it opened Quick setups instead of pausing. TalkBack still reaches and presses it, and the Pause HushTumblr switch on the Pause, backup and diagnostics page works with keys.
- Settings with a keyboard: pausing from the "HushTumblr is on" card keeps the card where it was, instead of the Restart row pushing it off the top. TalkBack stays on the card's button, which now says Undo. Flipping a switch at the top of a page with keys also shows the Restart row above it now.
- Settings with a keyboard or TalkBack: focus stays where it was while Tab order or a word list saves. It used to jump to the dialog's buttons and read them out before the answer.
- Manage muted posts with TalkBack or a keyboard: a failed mute or unmute is read once, and its notice shows under the list, so the row you were on stays put. Undo also stays while you're on it instead of going away after 10 seconds. With a keyboard or D-pad, trying again after a failed unmute takes one press, not two.
- Settings with a keyboard or D-pad: flipping a switch keeps the selection on that switch. It used to jump to the switch under it, or to the top row of scrolled search results, so the next press flipped the wrong one.

## Behind the scenes

- The source audit reads Jman's Patch Bundle Registry through its new API and asks again with fewer rows when a page fails. It also reads every page of a GitHub code search now. Before, it stopped at the first page that came back short and missed files.
- A release checks the source census when it's cut and again before anything goes up on GitHub. A census refreshed after the cut no longer keeps the publish step from running.

The walk went through the dashboard, Explore, a search, a tag page, a blog and your likes, then the HushTumblr settings and all ten of their pages. Tumblr didn't crash once.

Nine patches are new. Hide your own reblogs and Hide liked posts keep your own activity out of the dashboard, and Hide Featured posts drops the staff picks Tumblr pushes into it. ## What's new

- The patches move from 46.8.1.100 to Tumblr 47.0.0.108, the newest release. Every patch applies to it, so that's the version to patch.
- The bundle is built on Morphe patcher 2.3.0 now, the one that comes with Morphe Manager 2.5.0 and Morphe Desktop 2.1.0. Update Manager to 2.5.0 or newer before you add this release, since older Manager builds can't load it.
- Dark background color now reaches blog and tag pages. Those pages paint their owner's color, so a cream blog or a teal tag used to show through the gaps between black posts. A blog's title or link color that wouldn't show on the new background turns white or near black. The screens where you edit your own blog's colors still show the real ones.
- New **Line between posts** switch on the Interface page, off by default. It draws a thin line in the gap between posts, so it's easier to see where one ends on a black background.
- New **Hide Featured posts** switch on the Feed page, off by default. It takes out the posts Tumblr's staff push into your dashboard under a Featured header. A post goes only when Tumblr marks it both ways, with the Featured icon and the menu choice Tumblr gives its own promotions, so a regular post with a similar header stays. Quick setups' Quiet choice turns it on too.
- New **Hide your own reblogs** switch on the Feed page, off by default. It takes the reblogs you made out of your dashboard, so you don't scroll past your own reblogs between the posts of people you follow. The rest of Tumblr still shows them, your blog and a post you open by itself included.
- New **Hide liked posts** switch on the Feed page, off by default. It takes posts you've already liked out of your dashboard, so the ones that come back around don't cost you scrolling. A post you like while it's on screen stays put until the feed loads it again. Everywhere else still shows them, so a liked post you open from a link or a notification is still there.
- A post you open by itself, from a link or a notification, now loads with Hide reblogs or Hide posts with words on. Those switches clear a feed, so they took out the very post you asked for and the page stayed empty. The same post in a feed later is still hidden as usual.
- New **Match my wallpaper** switch under Dark background color, off by default. On Android 12 or newer it takes the dark background from your wallpaper's colors, so there's no color code to pick when patching. A new wallpaper shows after Tumblr restarts.
- New **Share video links** switch on the Posts page, off by default. Long-press a video in a post and you can share its direct link or copy it. Before, a long press on a video did nothing at all. The same menu can also save the video into your Downloads folder, with a toast once it's in. Android 10 and newer don't ask for storage access for that. Android 8 and 9 ask first, and the save starts by itself once you allow it.
- New **Sharper images** switch on the Posts page, off by default. Tumblr loads photos in posts at 640 pixels across at most, and smaller on a slow connection, so they look soft on most phones. With the switch on, a photo loads from the larger copy Tumblr already keeps, up to twice the width it's shown at (usually the 1280 one), and a slow connection gets the same copy. It uses more data. GIFs go up too, but never past the pixel count of a 1280 by 960 one, since a playing GIF keeps a few frames in memory. Very large photos stay capped as well.
- New **Collapse long posts** switch on the Posts page, off by default. A long post can take several screens of scrolling. With the switch on, a post longer than about a screen gets cut in your timelines with Tumblr's own Read more row under it, the same one you see when an author cuts their post. Tap it and the whole post opens right where it is in the timeline, so you don't lose your place, and it stays open as you scroll on. That holds on tag pages too, where Tumblr fades long posts out by itself, so the post you opened isn't cut again there. A post Tumblr always cuts still opens on its own page. A post that runs only a little over stays whole. A long entry in a reblog trail gets cut the same way, and its Read more opens the post on its own page like an author's cut does. Asks keep Tumblr's layout. The **Collapsed post length** row under the switch moves the cut to about half a screen or two screens with a tap, and a settings file carries your pick.
- New **Sanitize sharing links** switch on the Privacy page, on by default. Tumblr adds `?source=share` to the post and blog links you share or copy, which tells it the visit came from a share. With the switch on, the link goes out without that tag and still opens the same post. A link is otherwise left exactly as Tumblr made it. Quick setups' Privacy choice turns it on too.
- Hide ads now takes sponsored banners out of your feeds too, the takeover banners a sponsor pays for and the Sponsored Day ones. Tumblr's own banners without a sponsor, like Answer Time, stay. When a sponsor has paid for the header at the top of Explore, that header stays empty instead, the same as when it doesn't load, so its takeover ad can't open from it.
- New **App font** patch, off by default. Turn it on under Interface and Tumblr's own font gives way to your phone's, or to a .ttf or .otf file you pick there. Fonts a post's author picked stay as they are, and a change shows after a restart.
- Flipping a switch near the bottom of a settings page doesn't make the page jump anymore, so a second tap in the same spot can't land on the switch next to the one you meant. Two things moved it. The restart row appearing above slid the list down, and while a switch saved, its shorter "Saving the setting" line let the rows above drop into the gap and stay there.
- Hide the Follow button now reaches the reblog trail too. Each blog quoted in a reblog has its own header with a Follow button, and those kept showing while the one at the top of the post was gone.
- The patch bundle is signed now. Morphe Manager shows "Signed by 0859 9c9b 1bd2 9cac" on the HushTumblr source and remembers that key, so a later bundle signed with any other key, or not signed at all, gets refused instead of loaded.
- Hide ads now also turns off the full-screen ad Tumblr can show when you open a blog, whether you get there from the dashboard, a reblog, a notification or a message. The pause Tumblr keeps between those ads is left alone, since switching it off would only take the pause away.
- When something in HushTumblr settings can't finish, what to do next now stays under the row you tapped. It used to be a toast that faded after a few seconds, and Android 12 and later show only two lines of one, so large text got cut off. This covers links no app can open, Android's app settings not opening, switches and tab moves that didn't save, a Resume or Quick setup that didn't run, font files that couldn't be used and refused exports or imports. The diagnostic report and **Clear diagnostic data** rows work the same way now, so the folder a full report went to stays readable. A link you can't open comes with a Copy link button.
- A failed tab move or import keeps what you tried, so trying again picks up where it stopped. The import preview also gets a **Choose another file** button for when the file itself was the problem. Notes under rows come back when Android rebuilds the screen (say, after you rotate the phone), and a result that lands after you've closed settings or switched apps shows under its row once you're back. One that lands while the screen is being rebuilt shows on the new one, and one for a row on another settings page waits there until you open it. Hiding Quick setups says right under that page's row where to get it back. A Tab order tap while a change is still saving opens the list once the save is done instead of doing nothing.
- A settings page opened with a keyboard or D-pad starts at the top again. The "HushTumblr is paused" line used to sit just above the view, so the switches under it read as on.
- With a keyboard, D-pad or mouse, the settings home page comes back where you left it after Back or a cleared search, even when a section heading or the status card sat at the top. It used to land one row further down, with that heading pushed out of view.
- A switch, font file or Quick setup that waits for a restart now says so right under that row. The note goes once you undo that change or nothing's waiting anymore, and a change the next start makes anyway (Pause while safe mode already pauses) doesn't get one. Screen readers read it once from there, and again only if you go back to it. The Tab order list shows "Saving changes" under it while a slow save runs, then where the tab went and whether Tumblr needs a restart, and the dialog keeps its size while those come and go. Android 16 is phasing out the pop-up announcements these used, and those were gone the moment they were spoken.
- Hide ads now keeps Tumblr's ad networks (Google Mobile Ads, Meta Audience Network, Vungle and Nimbus) from starting when Tumblr launches. They woke up at every cold start and wrote their files before any HushTumblr switch was read. Disable analytics does the same for LiveRamp's identity tracker. Turn either switch off, or pause HushTumblr, and they start again after a restart.
- With Hide hashtags on, a Tumblr TV video whose only text was its tags doesn't keep a lone "... more" under the blog name anymore. Tapping it opened nothing. A video with a description still gets its label.
- With Hide note counts on, each comment in a post's notes drops its own like and reply counts too, and TalkBack doesn't read them out either. The Reply and like buttons still work.
- New **Keep Blaze posts** option under Hide ads on the Feed page, off by default. With it on, posts someone paid to promote with Blaze stay in your dashboard while network ads and other sponsored cards still go. Your word and post type filters still apply to those posts.
- The Words to hide and Allowed words editors can test your list on a made-up post now. Type some post text, trail text, tags or a summary under **Try it on a post** and it tells you whether the word filter would hide that post. It names the word that did it and where it was, or the allowed word that kept the post. It uses the same whole-word matching and the same Match switches as your dashboard, and tags work typed with commas or the way a post shows them (#art #cats). Nothing typed there is saved, and it's empty again each time you open the editor.
- With **Mute posts locally** on, a post's menu on the dashboard can also hide one blog's reblogs or its originals. A reblog offers "Hide reblogs from" that blog and an original offers "Hide originals from" it, so you can keep someone's own posts while their reblogs go, or the other way around. The rule only works on your dashboard and its tabs. Explore, their blog page and search still show those posts, and so does a post you open by itself. It goes in the same private list as your muted posts, for this account only, and Manage muted posts shows it as its own row you can tap to remove. A post Tumblr doesn't say enough about to tell which kind it is always stays.
- Disable analytics now really keeps Crashlytics crash reports off. The patch already set Firebase's manifest flag for that, but Tumblr turns crash collection back on by itself every time it starts, and its call wins over the flag. With the switch on, that call now leaves collection off. Turn the switch off, or pause HushTumblr, and Tumblr's own setting is back after a restart.
- The README's Help explains how to keep a patched copy next to your regular Tumblr with Morphe's Clone app patch. You sign in to the copy with your email and it keeps its own HushTumblr settings, but `Fix push notifications` only covers the regular app.

## Behind the scenes

- The check that every GitLab mirror in a source notice still answers doesn't fail anymore when GitLab says "too many requests". It spaces its requests out, waits as long as GitLab asks (a minute at most) and tries again, so only a mirror that's really gone fails it.
- The build runs on Gradle 9.8.2 with Gson 2.15.0, Guava 33.8.0 and Commons Lang 3.21.0. None of them fixes a known advisory here, so it's upkeep. The release check accepts the 9.8.2 wrapper now.
- Device runs don't stop anymore when another session happens to read the shared lease file at the same moment. Opening or releasing the lease waits a few seconds and tries again, and a missing lease or one someone else holds still stops the run.
- The source census reads ReVanced's GitLab mirror in three GraphQL questions now. Over REST it took a request for every branch and watched path, 70 of them for that mirror's 35 branches, and GitLab allows an address with no token about 60 an hour. Each comparison is asked once a run too. Forks that GitLab has renamed while they wait to be deleted stay out of the census, because a scanner keeps making and deleting them faster than any census could record them.
- A release walk now waits for Android's verifier to finish on both the clean reference and the exact build that got installed, and both files have to hash the same before and after it runs. Publishing refuses evidence that's old or partial. It also refuses evidence that doesn't match, down to one verifier message too many or too few.
- A release walk now checks each required destination instead of trusting its screen count. Login screens, wrong search results, duplicate or missing routes, recorded problems and invalid timestamps can't earn a full PASS. Shorter exploratory walks remain partial.
- Release walks now prove which APK was installed. Patch runs keep the input, bundle, patch selection and signing identity beside the signed output. The walker checks the installed bytes before and after its run, and publishing refuses evidence that's missing or doesn't match this build.
- `scripts/walk-app.ps1` scrolls the Hush settings list with slow drags now, down first and then back up, and stops once the list stops moving. Quick swipes flung the list past rows that slid under its pinned header, so a walk on a phone could miss settings pages that were there all along.
- `scripts/patch-for-device.ps1` can now sign a gate run it reuses with the BKS key Morphe makes. Plain `apksigner.bat` can't open that keystore, so the script falls back to apksigner's own jar with BouncyCastle loaded. When both fail, the error shows what each one said.
- Changelog entries don't open with a "Tumblr:" label anymore. HushTumblr only patches Tumblr, so it repeated itself on every line. The release scripts stopped adding or asking for it, and drop it from any bullet that still has one when a release is cut.
- The build signs the bundle when `MORPHE_SIGNING_KEY` holds the private key, and refuses a key that isn't the one `morphe-signing.pub` publishes. Without it the build still works and says the bundle is unsigned. `release.ps1` loads the key from `HUSHTUMBLR_BUNDLE_SIGNING_KEY` for the build alone, won't build a release without it, and checks the bundle came out signed by the published key. The release push gate signs its bundle with the same key, so the two still match byte for byte. The index now carries that key as `public_key`.
- Device patching and the release gate know the resource ids of Tumblr 47.0 now. Rebuilding Tumblr's resource table renames four ids and rewrites one string, just as it did on 46.8, but those sit at new ids in 47.0, so every patch run stopped at the resource check after the move.
- The build uses the Morphe settings plugin 2.1.0 now, which brings Kotlin 2.4.21 with it. The old plugin brought 2.4.10, which has the Kotlin build cache flaw (CVE-2026-53914), so the build had to force Kotlin up to 2.4.20 itself. That force is gone. The new plugin also signs the bundle it builds when `MORPHE_SIGNING_KEY` is set, and the release copy is still re-signed after its timestamp is pinned, so it verifies against `morphe-signing.pub` as before.
- A release that stopped partway through `gh release create` picks up where it left off. The rerun checks the draft's commit, its title and tag, and every file already uploaded, sends the rest, then publishes it with fresh notes as a full release. A draft that doesn't match, an upload another run may still be sending, or a published release with the same tag gets refused before anything on GitHub changes.

The bundle attached here was patched onto a real Tumblr 47.0.0.108 build with Morphe's desktop patcher, and all 55 patches applied without forcing. `release-receipt-0.0.10.json` records that result, the build's hashes and what patching changed in the app's manifest.

Before release, this exact bundle patched Tumblr 47.0.0.108 for a signed-in Galaxy S22 Ultra on Android 16, and the app got a walk from end to end. It opened the dashboard, Explore, a search, a tag page, a blog, your likes, the HushTumblr settings and all ten of its pages, and Tumblr didn't crash once.

HushTumblr 0.0.9 has 46 patches for Tumblr 46.8.1.100. It's built on Morphe patcher 2.0.0, so it needs Morphe Manager 2.0.0 or newer.

Two patches are new: Hide suggested tags and Hide filtered posts. Both live on the Feed page in HushTumblr settings and stay off until you turn them on. Hide ads now reaches blog pages, your likes and blog search. Hide suggested blogs catches the follow prompt between a blog's posts, and the buttons under a post finally match Dark background color.

Coming from 0.0.8, update Morphe Manager to 2.0.0 or newer first. Then patch Tumblr 46.8.1.100 with the default selection and install it over your current build, and your settings stay. Coming from stock Tumblr, uninstall it first, then install the patched app and sign in with your email.

## What's new

- The patches move from 46.5.0.109 to Tumblr 46.8.1.100, the newest release. Every patch applies to it, so that's the version to patch.
- The bundle is built on Morphe patcher 2.0.0 now. You'll need Morphe Manager 2.0.0 or newer, since older Manager builds can't load it.
- With Dark background color on, the row of buttons under each post now matches the post. In Tumblr's Dark palette it used to come out a shade lighter.
- Hide ads and the other feed switches now work on a blog's own posts, your likes and blog search. Those pages kept their own unfiltered copy, so sponsored posts kept turning up between a blog's posts.
- Hide suggested blogs now takes out the "Like this? Follow to see more" prompt and the Follow button under it that show up between a blog's posts. Tumblr sends that prompt as a heading and a lone button, so it got past the blog cards check.
- Hide suggested blogs and Hide suggested communities now reach the Posts tab of a search, where Tumblr slips a tag's top blogs and related communities in between the posts. The Blogs and Communities tabs still list everything the search found.
- New **Hide suggested tags** switch on the Feed page, off by default. It takes out the carousels of tags Tumblr wants you to follow, like "Check out these tags" on the dashboard, "Related tags" in a search and "Explore more" on a tag's page, along with their headings. The "Know someone who'd love this tag?" prompt between a tag's posts goes too. Tags you already follow stay put.
- New **Hide filtered posts** switch on the Feed page, off by default. Posts that Tumblr would cover with "This post contains filtered content" (because of your filtered tags or words) drop out of your dashboard, searches and other feeds. Leave it off and they stay covered like before.

## Behind the scenes

- A release can't go public until the whole app has been walked with that exact bundle on a release phone or an emulator. The publish stage now takes the walk's receipt as `-Walk` and stops before GitHub or the index if the walk wasn't a full pass, saw a Tumblr crash, ran on some other device, or patched with a different bundle.
- New `scripts/walk-app.ps1` patches Tumblr from the release bundle and installs it on a phone or emulator. Then it opens the dashboard, the patched screens and every Hush settings page, and writes the receipt publish asks for. Only a full walk with no Tumblr crash earns a PASS.
- `scripts/patch-for-device.ps1` can sign with the key Morphe makes, which has no store password and its own key password. Pass `-NoStorePassword` and put the key password in `HUSHTUMBLR_SIDELOAD_KEY_PASSWORD`.

## Reports this release answers

- #1 The row of buttons under a post didn't follow Dark background color.
- #2 A switch to drop filtered posts instead of covering them.
- #3 Sponsored posts showing up on blogs.
- #4 and #5 Suggested blogs between a blog's posts, and suggested blogs and communities slipped into search.
- #6 A switch to hide suggested tags.

The `.mpp` download is a patch bundle, not a Tumblr APK. [Installation instructions](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushTumblr#install). `SHA256SUMS.txt` is signed with the HushTumblr release key, fingerprint `2143 368A A5CE 6E5D FFEA  79CF BBC1 3768 83CF 3AB4`. # 1.0.0 (2026-09-07)


### Features

* **soundcloud:** add download hook, home filter, navigation UI, and settings patches ([b4cb397](https://github.com/lootdev78/morphe-patches-sc/commit/b4cb397c54bdba93a67fd65724516a858998ee5d))

Fixes scrolling from the checkbox column, and makes a failed removal say what went wrong.

### Scrolling

Dragging from a checkbox did nothing. The overlay claimed the whole checkbox gutter the moment you pressed, and then held on to every movement, so the list only scrolled if your finger happened to start on the thumbnail or the title.

A press that travels past the system's drag threshold now gives up on being a tap and hands the gesture to the list, which receives the press it never saw so the scroll starts from the right place. Tapping a checkbox still ticks it.

### Failed removals

Removals are sent in chunks, and the server takes a chunk all or nothing. One entry it refused therefore reported every other entry in that chunk as failed as well. A chunk that fails is now retried one entry at a time, so the entries the server was happy with go through and the failure count is the real one. The extra requests happen only for a chunk that had already failed.

The request also knew exactly why a removal had failed and threw it away, showing one flat "Could not remove the selected videos" for everything from an expired credential to a dropped connection. The reason now reaches the message:

- `Could not remove the selected videos: HTTP 401`
- `Removed 3 videos, 2 failed: timed out`

A 401 there means the credentials the app handed over had gone stale, which previously took a logcat to tell apart from the playlist refusing the edit.

### Known issue

Removing a video while the playlist page is open leaves its row on screen with a greyed out checkbox, until YouTube refetches the page. The video really is gone from the playlist; the row is stale and the dead checkbox is the overlay declining to act on a video it can no longer identify. Leave the playlist and come back to see the real contents.

### Notes

- Built and tested against YouTube `21.13.164`.
- Meant to be applied **alongside** the official bundle, not instead of it.
- The feature is always on; there is no settings toggle yet.
- Derived from MorpheApp/morphe-patches, GPLv3.

Fixes checkboxes that stayed on screen after you left the playlist.

Tapping a video to play it left the selection checkboxes drawn on top of the player, in the places the playlist rows had been, and rotating into landscape fullscreen did not clear them either. The action bar had the same problem, and the invisible overlay was also swallowing taps meant for whatever was now in front.

The cause was that nothing tied the overlay to the playlist being on screen. Opening a video does not detach the list, it swaps the page out from under it, and the listener driving the redraw belongs to the window rather than to the list, so it kept firing while the player was up and kept drawing at the coordinates the hidden rows still held.

The overlay and the action bar now follow the playlist page on and off screen. They are hidden rather than torn down, so a selection survives watching a video and is still there when you come back. The miniplayer deliberately does not count as leaving the playlist, since the list stays usable underneath it.

No change to the feature itself.

### Notes

- Built and tested against YouTube `21.13.164`.
- Meant to be applied **alongside** the official bundle, not instead of it.
- The feature is always on; there is no settings toggle yet.
- Derived from MorpheApp/morphe-patches, GPLv3.

Fixes a bundle that a manager reported as having **0 patches**.

The published `.mpp` contained no `classes.dex`. Manager runs the patcher on Android, which can only load dex, so it refused the bundle outright with `Patch bundle is missing dex entries` and listed the source with no patches in it.

The cause was in the release tooling, not the patch. `generatePatchesList` depends on the plain `build` task, which re-runs `jar` and rewrites the `.mpp` without the dex that `buildAndroid` had just added. The two were being run in that order. The list is now generated first, `buildAndroid` runs last, and the tooling refuses to publish a bundle that has no `classes.dex`.

This is invisible from the desktop: `morphe-desktop` runs on the JVM and loads the class files, so it downloads, lists and applies a dex-less bundle without complaint. v1.0.0 and v1.0.1 were both affected and should not be used.

No change to the feature itself.

Restores missing YouTube Auto-translate menus and expands language coverage using YouTube's per-video metadata.

### Changes
- Restore the native Auto-translate option when valid original captions exist but Android returns an empty translation list.
- Support ASR, uploaded/manual and named captions, including multiple current-audio sources.
- Read target languages dynamically; use the dated 156-language fallback only when native metadata is empty. Preserve regional menu targets.
- Preserve signed source URLs and Morphe's caption preference, Off and manual-selection policies. Existing native menus respect Morphe's additional-language setting.

### Installation
Import `universal-captions-2.1.0.mpp` or refresh this repository in Morphe Manager. Select **Universal Captions - additional translation languages** alongside **Captions**, using a clean YouTube **21.20.405** or **21.41.525** APK. Replace older experimental Universal Captions imports; select only one version. Repatch YouTube to apply the update.

### Validation
The runtime is byte-for-byte identical to device-tested experiment.4. The user reported successful translation, Off/on, audio/source changes and video switching on 21.20.405; the app-process capture showed no crash. Automated construction checks cover 193,440 source/target/locale cases. The full 45-test native-combined suite passed again, and the exact stable MPP passed Android patching/DEX/hierarchy/signing verification on both declared APK versions. Native coexistence in both orders was validated with the identical experimental implementation.

Additional user-reported device testing confirmed working operation across YouTube **20.21.37–21.42.241**, including both endpoints and intermediate versions. Automated APK validation covers **21.20.405** and **21.41.525**.

### Known limits
YouTube may withhold a translation for particular videos/accounts. Native automatic regional preference matching may choose generic `pt` for `pt-PT`; manual menu options remain separate. The fallback uses the current-audio default/native order and does not guarantee tracking every manual source choice.

`f25f28130260895efcaea4f267b26293d057b2401c0e643c53d0aa7275923622`

Universal Captions 2.0.0 expands YouTube’s native Auto-translate language menu and sorts it by localized display name.

- Adds all languages supported by the patch to YouTube’s native Auto-translate menu, while retaining native entries.
- Caption preferences, source selection, visibility and Off behavior are managed by Morphe’s **Captions** patch.
- When the native Morphe additional-language feature is present, its setting controls the menu; the standalone addon leaves that behavior to Morphe.
- Older Morphe builds continue to use the independent language-menu extension.

**Upgrading from 1.4:** version 2.0 is a menu-only addon. Enable Morphe’s **Captions** patch for caption preference and visibility features. Use only one Universal Captions version in each patching session.

**Validated APK targets:** YouTube **21.20.405** and **21.41.525**. All 20 regression tests passed, and standalone and combined-native APKs passed SDK verification on both targets. The release implementation was also confirmed working on-device. Other versions remain unverified; translation availability varies by video and account.

**Install:** update this source in Morphe Manager, or import `universal-captions-2.0.0.mpp` from the assets below.

[Add source](https://morphe.software/add-source?github=itolkien%2Fmorphe-universal-captions&name=Universal%20Captions) · [Native Morphe integration (merged)](https://github.com/MorpheApp/morphe-patches/pull/3754)

YouTube-native captions in your preferred language, with remembered language selection and an alphabetical Auto-translate menu.

- YouTube **21.41.525** and **21.20.405** compatibility.
- A curated translation-language catalogue, including Greek, with native entries retained.
- Language choices ordered by their displayed names using the app locale.
- Manual/ASR caption preference and YouTube-native translation when a suitable source is available.
- Remembered language and explicit Off preferences.

**Install:** add this repository as a source in Morphe Manager, or import `universal-captions-1.4.0.mpp`. Replace development-source copies with the release source before patching a clean supported APK.

Universal Captions 3.0.1 is a maintenance update to 3.0.0. The translation menu and source-selection behavior remain unchanged.

### What's Changed

- **Safer caption parser cleanup:** Cleanup is now request-specific. Native exception handlers can no longer close another decoder's styling scope.
- **Code cleanup:** Removed two test-only `augment()` overloads from the Android extension.
- **Improved test coverage:** Added regression tests for nested exception cleanup and the recorded 156-language fallback catalog.
- **Release workflow fixes:** Corrected the Morphe Manager bundle URL. The workflow now reads the version directly from `patches-list.json` and skips versions that have already been published.
- **Documentation:** Updated the architecture and compatibility documentation.

### Installation

Download `universal-captions-3.0.1.mpp` or refresh the custom source in **Morphe Manager**.

Patch a clean YouTube APK using one of the supported versions: **21.20.405** or **21.41.525**.

### Testing & Compatibility

- Universal Captions 3.0 development builds were manually tested on both supported YouTube versions.
- Version 3.0.1 includes automated regression coverage. The updated parser cleanup has not been separately documented in an on-device test.
- YouTube may still withhold translations for certain tracks or languages.

### Release Files

This release includes the **MPP patch bundle**, patch metadata, and a **SHA-256 checksum** for verification. It does not distribute a modified YouTube APK.

This is the rewrite I've been working toward. The old patch could restore Auto-translate and offer extra languages on many videos, but some still showed just 16–18 choices. Those videos often had several original caption tracks, and copying a translation from the wrong one wasn't a safe fix.

I reverse-engineered the original YouTube caption manager and followed how its metadata connects caption sources to the active audio track. In 3.0 the patch uses that native source-index routing, keeps YouTube's original translated tracks, and adds missing language choices from the correct source. It no longer depends on guessing which caption happens to be the default.

The translated subtitle styling fix has also been rewritten. Instead of using a global flag for the last network request, it identifies the caption during parsing, including cached captions. Original creator styling stays on original subtitles, while affected translations use visible default text styles.

### What's included

- A wider Auto-translate menu, typically around 155–156 languages when an eligible source exists.
- Restored Auto-translate menus for videos with original captions but no translated choices.
- Support for auto-generated, uploaded and named captions, including videos with multiple audio/caption sources.
- Native signed caption URLs and existing per-language selections preserved.
- Caption styling handling scoped to the actual XML parser rather than a process-wide request flag.
- More tests for source identity, signed URLs, multi-audio routing, regional language aliases, cache parsing and concurrent requests.

### Install or update

Download **`universal-captions-3.0.0.mpp`** or refresh this repository in Morphe Manager. Patch a clean **YouTube 21.20.405** or **21.41.525** APK and select **Universal Captions - additional translation languages**.

**Important for 2.1.0 users:** 3.0 has its own translated-caption pen and Auto-translate hooks. Do **not** apply it alongside an older Morphe **Captions** patch that already supplies those same hooks. Use the standalone Universal Captions patch until the old Morphe implementation is replaced. Repatch YouTube after updating; updating a patch source alone doesn't update an installed APK.

### Testing and limits

Both listed YouTube versions were patched and tested manually during development. The previously limited menu on YouTube 21.20.405 expanded from 17 to 156 choices, and the user confirmed that selecting Turkish showed actual translated captions. The later dev builds, including the parser-scoped styling refactor, were tested without reported problems. Automated regression tests and Android bundle checks passed.

A visible language choice is not a guarantee that YouTube's backend will translate that particular video. The patch also doesn't replace YouTube/Morphe's caption preference or visibility settings, and exact handling of every manually selected source remains subject to the native player.

The release contains the MPP bundle, generated `patches-list.json` and its SHA-256 checksum. No modified YouTube APKs or private device logs are distributed.

Universal Captions is an independent project I developed and maintain. The Morphe maintainers later invited me to integrate it into their patch set.

See [NOTICE](https://github.com/itolkien/universal-captions/blob/main/NOTICE) for the applicable copyright and license notices.

Restores missing YouTube Auto-translate menus and expands language coverage using YouTube's per-video metadata.

### Changes
- Restore the native Auto-translate option when valid original captions exist but Android returns an empty translation list.
- Support ASR, uploaded/manual and named captions, including multiple current-audio sources.
- Read target languages dynamically; use the dated 156-language fallback only when native metadata is empty. Preserve regional menu targets.
- Preserve signed source URLs and Morphe's caption preference, Off and manual-selection policies. Existing native menus respect Morphe's additional-language setting.

### Installation
Import `universal-captions-2.1.0.mpp` or refresh this repository in Morphe Manager. Select **Universal Captions - additional translation languages** alongside **Captions**, using a clean YouTube **21.20.405** or **21.41.525** APK. Replace older experimental Universal Captions imports; select only one version. Repatch YouTube to apply the update.

### Validation
The runtime is byte-for-byte identical to device-tested experiment.4. The user reported successful translation, Off/on, audio/source changes and video switching on 21.20.405; the app-process capture showed no crash. Automated construction checks cover 193,440 source/target/locale cases. The full 45-test native-combined suite passed again, and the exact stable MPP passed Android patching/DEX/hierarchy/signing verification on both declared APK versions. Native coexistence in both orders was validated with the identical experimental implementation.

Additional user-reported device testing confirmed working operation across YouTube **20.21.37–21.42.241**, including both endpoints and intermediate versions. Automated APK validation covers **21.20.405** and **21.41.525**.

### Known limits
YouTube may withhold a translation for particular videos/accounts. Native automatic regional preference matching may choose generic `pt` for `pt-PT`; manual menu options remain separate. The fallback uses the current-audio default/native order and does not guarantee tracking every manual source choice.

### Install

Refresh the EB source in Morphe Manager 2.1.0 or later, then patch the untouched **ACall 14.4.0 (14409)** input. Refreshing the source does not update an installed APK. Select optional patches explicitly.

The optional original AppProtect hash patch requires a local filesystem path to the exact untouched, signed original APK/APKM. The base APK must contain both arm64-v8a and armeabi-v7a native libraries. Vendor APKs, patched APKs, model weights, recordings, and private keys are not distributed.

# Changelog

## 0.6.0
- Stremio for Android TV 1.12.0 is supported. 1.12.0 shrinks and renames Media3 with R8 (`Player`, `MediaItem`, `Cue`,
  `PlayerView`… get short names that change with every release), so the extension no longer names any Media3 class: it
  reaches Media3 through one bridge class (`M3`) whose stand-in methods the patch writes when patching, from the app's own
  members found by their structure, never their names. The rest is read by reflection on field types. The same patch
  still applies to Android TV 1.11.3 and the phone app 2.4.0.
- The subtitle-address hook moved from `SubtitleConfiguration.Builder(Uri)` (inlined away in 1.12.0) to the end of the
  `SubtitleConfiguration` constructor: only its Uri is set again (`&ssp=1` on the one improving entry).
- A picked subtitle is matched by its source number in the track id ("2:" = the second side-loaded subtitle) for every
  app; player events reach the patch through a proxy listener; the playback speed is measured from the player's clock.
  `bufferingAfterSwap` in the report is no longer measured (always 0).
- The subtitle delay is read from 1.12.0's renderer too (its one long field, µs).
- Stand-in addon: `TOAST="text"` sends a swap notice (default none).
- Tested on the A50 with Stremio TV 1.12.0 (temporary account, nothing spent): the stand-in's one entry processing →
  versions 1, 2, 3 drawn on the video clock; toast shown when the addon sends one and none when it sends `""`; right-to-left
  lines in Stremio's own drawing and in ours; delay readable. End to end with the real addon's code offline (stored Toy
  Story 5 run, every outgoing connection refused): `ssp=1` → processing file in 4 ms → version ready → swapped 465 ms after
  ready, lines on time. Patched without errors: TV 1.12.0, TV 1.11.3, phone 2.4.0.

## 0.5.0
- The questions about the addon's own entries carry the address of the video that is playing (header
  `X-Subsense-Stream`, caps `link`): the addon reads the exact stream the viewer plays. Sent only to the addon whose
  subtitle asks, never in an address, never logged; read on the main thread from Media3's current media item.
- New Media3 hook, `MediaItem.SubtitleConfiguration.Builder(Uri)`: the one improving entry (`/1.srt?u=1`) is loaded
  with `&ssp=1`, so the addon answers Stremio's own fetch at once with its processing file and the app swaps it later.
  Every other subtitle address is left as it is.
- The processing line `تتم معالجة الترجمة الآن` is recognised.
- Tested on the A50 with Stremio TV 1.11.3 (temporary account, stand-in video, the addon's own code offline, nothing
  spent): the marked fetch got the processing file in 3 ms and the line showed; every question carried the exact video
  address played; version 1 replaced the line when it was ready and its Arabic lines showed.

## 0.4.1
- Stremio's phone app (2.4.0, same package `com.stremio.one`, same Media3 player as Android TV) is supported. The phone
  app adds addon subtitles with no id, so "Subtitle auto-refresh" could not tell which addon subtitle was picked and
  never asked the addon. A picked track is now also matched by its place: Media3 puts each side-loaded subtitle's source
  number in front of its track id ("2:" = the second subtitle). The TV app (which names its subtitles) is matched as
  before. A text track that matches nothing is logged.
- morphe-builder publishes a third APK, a phone copy that installs beside the original Stremio
  (`com.stremio.one.subs.phone`, "Stremio Subs"). The patches work in the ExoPlayer player only (the phone app's default).
- Tested on an Android 11 phone (Stremio 2.4.0 phone app, temporary account, stand-in addon, nothing spent): one entry
  picked while processing → versions 1, 2 and 3 drawn on time with no buffering; a normal Arabic file shows its dash on
  the right and its "?" on the left.

## 0.4.0
- New patch "Right-to-left subtitle lines": Arabic and Hebrew subtitle lines are laid out right to left, so their
  punctuation shows on the right side. At the start of `SubtitleView.setCues` (Media3, the same hook as before)
  Stremio's left-to-right mark is dropped and every right-to-left line is wrapped in a right-to-left embedding, which
  Media3's own left-to-right wrapping at draw time keeps. Nothing of Stremio's own code is read.
- Tested on an Android 11 phone with Stremio TV 1.11.3: a normal Arabic file showed its dash and question mark on the
  left before and on the right after; files that already carry the embedding look the same with and without the patch.
- `tools/patch.sh` applies the new patch.

## 0.3.1
- Stand-in addon (test only, no app change): a question asked before Stremio's own fetch is answered waits for that
  fetch, like the addon (D77 fix), so Stremio's copy is never swapped for itself.
- The addon's `"toast": ""` now always means no notice, also for the first version drawn over the processing file (0.3.0
  still showed its own notice there). An addon that names no toast keeps the notice for that first swap.
- Tested on the A50 with the stand-in addon: a processing file with no visible text (only its tag), versions 1 → 2 → 3
  swapped with no notice; a subtitle already finished when played: one question, answered "nothing new", no swap.

## 0.3.0
- One subtitle that improves over time: an addon can offer one entry and replace it with each better version while the
  viewer watches — as many versions as the addon's answers say (`version` only goes up, `more`, `nextBy`, `plan`).
- Each upgrade is switched in at a gap between lines (`swap.gapMs`, or after `swap.maxWaitMs`), silently unless the
  addon names a notice; the first version over Stremio's own copy also waits for a gap.
- A promised version that never comes ends cleanly: the addon's `stop`, an expired promise, or an hour with no new
  version — what is drawn stays.
- Questions carry `caps`, `have`, `showing` and `pos` (where the viewer is), and the generic answer can name a
  question to follow (`ask`); older addons and older apps keep protocol 1.
- After a drawing failure, the newest version in memory is drawn again (a few times at most) instead of leaving
  Stremio's older copy; a passing failure of the generic question on one of the addon's own entries is retried.
- Reports: each swap with its version, counted when it is drawn; entries still upgrading; the addon's plan.
- Tested: a JVM harness for the versions protocol (N = 1, 2, 3, 5, 8 versions, stop, silent addon, follow, gaps,
  leave/reopen) and on the A50: 3 and 5 versions, a promised version that never came, and an addon gone silent.

## 0.2.1
- Leaving a video ends its questions at once: an open request is closed and nothing queued is sent any more, so quick
  leave/reopen never makes a new play wait behind an old one.
- One scheduled question per subtitle at a time (switching subtitles back and forth no longer starts extra ones).
- An addon is only ever asked about its own subtitles, and the play's report only goes to the addon that was asked.
- A finished subtitle that happens to contain the word "processing" is no longer mistaken for the processing file; an
  unusable file is retried with a growing pause instead of at the addon's pace; an unheld "wait" is never asked faster
  than every 3 s.
- The addon's "stop", an unknown job (404) and the 45-minute give-up now hold for the rest of the play.
- The drawing survives the device sleeping while paused; after a hand-back the downloaded file is drawn again (no new
  download, no second toast); no toast while Stremio is in the background.
- The report carries no addresses or paths in its error text, and its ready-to-screen time is measured from the
  addon's "ready". It only carries what concerns the addon that receives it.
- A 404 stops the questions only when it is the protocol's own `{"subsense":1, "op":"stop"}`; any other 404 (an addon
  without the question route) keeps the file fallback.
- Emptying an unrelated PlayerView no longer ends the play's session; an `<i>` opened at the end of a line carries on.
- Tested: a JVM harness (106 checks) and the A50: 20 quick leave/reopen plays no longer delay the next play (232 s
  before, 6 ms now), a held question closes ~1 s after leaving, nothing is left in memory after a play, and one real
  play swapped a real subtitle with no buffering.

## 0.2.0
- The addon drives the swap through one versioned question ("anything to draw instead?"): its processing file names
  the question in an invisible tag, so the patch needs no knowledge of the addon's addresses or wording.
- The "ready?" question is held open by the addon until the file is ready (no polling every few seconds).
- A generic question for any other selected subtitle lets the addon offer a better copy later, without a new patch.
- One small report per play goes back to the addon (versions, hooks seen, swaps, failures), so a broken release is noticed.
- Sturdier drawing: one owner of the screen per play, a watchdog, and on any problem Stremio's own lines come back at once.
- SRT italics kept. Any Stremio for Android TV release is accepted; a release whose hooks no longer match fails to patch.

## 0.1.0
- First version: the finished subtitle replaces a selected "processing" entry during playback, with no reload, and a toast.

- The addon's `"toast": ""` now always means no notice, also for the first version drawn over the processing file (0.3.0
  still showed its own notice there). An addon that names no toast keeps the notice for that first swap.
- Tested on the A50 with the stand-in addon: a processing file with no visible text (only its tag), versions 1 → 2 → 3
  swapped with no notice; a subtitle already finished when played: one question, answered "nothing new", no swap.

## 0.3.0
- One subtitle that improves over time: an addon can offer one entry and replace it with each better version while the
  viewer watches — as many versions as the addon's answers say (`version` only goes up, `more`, `nextBy`, `plan`).
- Each upgrade is switched in at a gap between lines (`swap.gapMs`, or after `swap.maxWaitMs`), silently unless the
  addon names a notice; the first version over Stremio's own copy also waits for a gap.
- A promised version that never comes ends cleanly: the addon's `stop`, an expired promise, or an hour with no new
  version — what is drawn stays.
- Questions carry `caps`, `have`, `showing` and `pos` (where the viewer is), and the generic answer can name a
  question to follow (`ask`); older addons and older apps keep protocol 1.
- After a drawing failure, the newest version in memory is drawn again (a few times at most) instead of leaving
  Stremio's older copy; a passing failure of the generic question on one of the addon's own entries is retried.
- Reports: each swap with its version, counted when it is drawn; entries still upgrading; the addon's plan.
- Tested: a JVM harness for the versions protocol (N = 1, 2, 3, 5, 8 versions, stop, silent addon, follow, gaps,
  leave/reopen) and on the A50: 3 and 5 versions, a promised version that never came, and an addon gone silent.

## 0.2.1
- Leaving a video ends its questions at once: an open request is closed and nothing queued is sent any more, so quick
  leave/reopen never makes a new play wait behind an old one.
- One scheduled question per subtitle at a time (switching subtitles back and forth no longer starts extra ones).
- An addon is only ever asked about its own subtitles, and the play's report only goes to the addon that was asked.
- A finished subtitle that happens to contain the word "processing" is no longer mistaken for the processing file; an
  unusable file is retried with a growing pause instead of at the addon's pace; an unheld "wait" is never asked faster
  than every 3 s.
- The addon's "stop", an unknown job (404) and the 45-minute give-up now hold for the rest of the play.
- The drawing survives the device sleeping while paused; after a hand-back the downloaded file is drawn again (no new
  download, no second toast); no toast while Stremio is in the background.
- The report carries no addresses or paths in its error text, and its ready-to-screen time is measured from the
  addon's "ready". It only carries what concerns the addon that receives it.
- A 404 stops the questions only when it is the protocol's own `{"subsense":1, "op":"stop"}`; any other 404 (an addon
  without the question route) keeps the file fallback.
- Emptying an unrelated PlayerView no longer ends the play's session; an `<i>` opened at the end of a line carries on.
- Tested: a JVM harness (106 checks) and the A50: 20 quick leave/reopen plays no longer delay the next play (232 s
  before, 6 ms now), a held question closes ~1 s after leaving, nothing is left in memory after a play, and one real
  play swapped a real subtitle with no buffering.

## 0.2.0
- The addon drives the swap through one versioned question ("anything to draw instead?"): its processing file names
  the question in an invisible tag, so the patch needs no knowledge of the addon's addresses or wording.
- The "ready?" question is held open by the addon until the file is ready (no polling every few seconds).
- A generic question for any other selected subtitle lets the addon offer a better copy later, without a new patch.
- One small report per play goes back to the addon (versions, hooks seen, swaps, failures), so a broken release is noticed.
- Sturdier drawing: one owner of the screen per play, a watchdog, and on any problem Stremio's own lines come back at once.
- SRT italics kept. Any Stremio for Android TV release is accepted; a release whose hooks no longer match fails to patch.

## 0.1.0
- First version: the finished subtitle replaces a selected "processing" entry during playback, with no reload, and a toast.

## 0.3.0 (2026-10-10)

### ✨ New Features

* **Cloudflare WARP while open** (off by default): while YouTube is in the foreground it uses its own per-app VPN through Cloudflare WARP, and goes back to the normal connection in the background. A free WARP device is registered on first use; Android asks for VPN permission once. Useful when the direct connection to YouTube is slow at peak hours.

### Changes

* **Settings screen:** the Thread Ripper entry now looks like the official Morphe entries (icon, title only), and its texts are in Traditional Chinese.

Built for YouTube 21.16.256 with Morphe Patches 1.45.0 and Spoof video streams = visionOS. WARP was checked on the phone: VPN up 0.3–0.4 s after a cold start, 40–116 Mbps per range, down on Home and up again on return.

## 0.2.0 (2026-10-03)

### ✨ New Features

* **Settings screen:** all options are in YouTube → Settings → Morphe → Thread Ripper (needs the official Morphe Patches). `debug.tr.*` system properties still override them for testing.
* **Stall recovery** (off by default): resume playback after a stall once 1.6 s of video is buffered instead of the app's 5 s.

### Changes

* **Video buffer preload:** default target raised from 300 s to 900 s (memory limit stays 250 MiB). The official "Playback buffer size" = Maximum buffers about 650 s at 1080p, so the old 300 s target buffered less than the official setting there. With both enabled you get the larger of the two.

Built for YouTube 21.16.256 with Morphe Patches 1.45.0 and Spoof video streams = visionOS. The settings screen was checked on an Android emulator; the effect of stall recovery on playback has not been measured yet.

## 0.1.0 (2026-10-03)

First release.

### ✨ New Features

* **Multi-connection video download:** download each video byte range of non-SABR (spoofed) streams as 1 MiB chunks over 8 concurrent requests, delivered in order, with the needed chunk at the highest priority.
* **Video buffer preload:** keep loading until 300 s of video is buffered or the buffer holds 250 MiB, instead of YouTube's ~21 MB limit.

Verified on YouTube 21.16.256 with Morphe Patches 1.45.0 and Spoof video streams = visionOS.

# TikTok Interaction Add-ons 0.7.1-beta.1

Fixes the **translucent orange Favorites and Sound popup backgrounds** reported on 0.7.0. Both now use the inspected opaque sheet background: pure black when HushFeed AMOLED is black, the selected custom dark color when applicable, and white in light mode. No new toggle is needed.

Target: original global **TikTok 47.5.3 / 2024705030**, external **HushFeed 0.79.0 Settings**, **Manager 2.0.0+ / patcher 2.0.0**. ## Get the repair in Morphe

Refresh the TikTok Interaction Add-ons remote source with **Pre-release patches** enabled. Enable **Experimental app versions** as required and confirm **0.7.1-beta.1**. Repatch the **original unmodified APK** with HushFeed 0.79.0 Settings, either/both personal add-ons and your desired AMOLED option in the same Expert-mode run. Keep your existing signing key. Remove/disable any older local personal source so two copies are not selected together.

## Verification and limits

The old reader used a24, which the original 47.5.3 resources resolve to translucent orange. The corrected shared reader uses **a27 / UISheetFlat1** and rejects translucent surface colors. Four regression scenarios reproduce exact orange with the old reader and pass after the fix.

**87 unit/simulated tests**, seven helper tests, three Android API lint tasks, eight HushFeed 0.79 combination/negative checks and three nine-role Sound native audits passed locally. All 140 global TikTok patches were checked in both source orders; each personal feature was checked alone. The compiled resource APKs contain opaque black dark sheets and white light sheets in both orders. Delivered bytecode was inspected for the corrected token and alpha validation. Payload remains 78 isolated own classes without duplicate, foreign, host-stub or test classes. The included verification report captures the prepublication test phase; publication state is established by this release and its feed.

**Phone appearance acceptance remains pending.** Confirm black/custom/light surfaces and retained tap/hold/scroll/cancel/save behavior. Provider/account, ART and accessibility limitations remain; a dedicated accessible sound-disc long-click action is not implemented. Static success does not prove native saves or every runtime setting combination.

No TikTok APK is distributed, signed or installed here. Refreshing the source does not automatically repatch the installed app.

version, and what they changed: [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/aic0d3r/oxbow/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md).
