
#### Added
- **Cooldown lock** (Settings > Lock, off by default): a softer alternative to the permanent
  lock. Loosening a block or showing a hidden nav icon starts a wait (1, 6, 24, 48 or 72 h, default
  24 h) instead of applying; when it ends you confirm it. Requests survive restarts and can be
  cancelled, the page shows what is waiting and the time left, and tightening stays instant. The
  wait runs on the device's uptime clock, so moving the date back doesn't skip it. Once on, the
  cooldown can only be switched off through the same wait. The permanent lock wins if both are on.
- **Hold Download to save all slides**: long-press the Download row in a carousel post's `⋯`
  menu to save every slide even with *Download all slides* off. A normal tap still saves the
  slide on screen.
- **Ghost mode shortcut**: long-press **New message** at the top of the inbox to switch story-seen,
  read-receipt and typing hiding on or off together, with a toast and a short haptic (Keep >
  Ghost mode > Long-press New message, on by default). The Messages tab keeps opening settings.
  Idea from HushGram; the button is found at runtime, no code ported.
- **Hide Meta AI / Muse** (*Blocked surfaces* > Meta AI and Muse, on by default): removes Muse's
  target from the share sheet, the Meet Muse promo cards and the generated "About this reel"
  summary (with its Ask Meta AI box) in post and Reels menus, and drops Vibes, Meta AI chats and
  Imagine units from the feed. Approach adapted from HushGram. Search-bar, inbox, profile and
  Blend entries are not covered.
- **Copy caption** in the `⋯` menu of posts and Reels (Keep > Copy caption, on by default).
- **Patch-only releases reach you now**: the update check used to compare only the Instagram
  version, so a new Oxbow on the same Instagram build was never offered. It compares the patch
  bundle version too (Keep > Check for updates), and the prompt names the bundle when only that
  moved.

#### Fixed
- **Ghost mode: chats clear for you again.** With read receipts off, opening or replying in a chat
  used to leave it bold in your own inbox. Instagram still gets no receipt — the sender stays on
  Delivered — but the row, its "N new messages" line and the Messages tab badge clear on your
  phone, and stay cleared after a refresh or a restart. The queued receipt is now finished through
  Instagram's own callback instead of being dropped, and the ids you read are kept so the inbox's
  "has this message been seen" answer can say yes without anything leaving the phone. Approach
  informed by HushGram's read-without-receipt patch; no code ported.

#### How to use
- **Read DMs without a receipt, still cleared for you**: Keep > Ghost mode > *Don't send read
  receipts*, or hold **New message** in the inbox to flip all three ghost switches at once.
- **Download a whole carousel**: hold the Download row in a post's `⋯` menu.
- **Copy a caption**: `⋯` menu of a post or reel > Copy caption.
- **Cooldown lock**: Settings > Lock.
- **Hide Meta AI / Muse**: Blocked surfaces > Meta AI and Muse.

# v0.5.0 — ブックマーク詳細から記事を開く

Hatena Bookmark 5.80（versionCode 58000）専用。Hoshioriに6件目のMorpheパッチ「Open article from bookmark card」を追加しました。

- ブックマーク詳細画面の記事カード（タイトル・サムネイル・余白）をタップすると、既存のアプリ内ブラウザで記事を開きます。

### Summary

First release where every asset is built by the workflow and carries a build provenance attestation. The patch bundle, the Gboard build and the PixelBoard build all come out of the same tagged commit, and the digest of each file can be checked against the tag that produced it.

This release also carries the security fixes from 0.0.4-alpha, and it fixes the release metadata that pointed at a release that did not exist.

### What's Changed

- **Assets built in CI**: A new workflow job builds both patched APKs from the pinned Gboard base and the patch bundle, then publishes the bundle and the two APKs and attests each of them. The release assets are no longer built on a laptop and uploaded by hand.
- **Attestation on every asset**: `gh attestation verify <file> --repo ShubhamJ010/gboard-clipboard-history` checks a file against the tag that built it.
- **Pinned Gboard base**: The Gboard base lives on the `build-inputs` release of this repository and is checked against a sha256 digest in `scripts/pins.env`, so the CI job and a local build use the same file.
- **Keystore password rotated**: The release keystore password is now a random value held in a repository secret. The certificate is unchanged, so installed builds keep updating over each other.
- **Security fixes from 0.0.4-alpha**: Keystore passwords out of the repository, every download pinned to a commit and verified with a digest, and the clipboard provider only answers callers whose permission the installed build declares. The access token is masked on screen, the settings screen blocks screen capture, and the token is copied to the clipboard as a sensitive clip.
- **Metadata fixed**: The bundle metadata now names the same version as the tag. The 0.0.3-alpha bundle pointed at a 1.0.0 release that does not exist, and its asset was removed so that nobody can fetch it.
- **Release checks**: The workflow reads the published assets back and fails the job when the patch bundle is missing, so an empty release cannot pass.

### Upgrade note

This release is signed with the project key `CN=GboardClipboard` (`5eb6dcd2779998ed1c6233aa480727234033db0d1f3c8dbdf01f69749394ca10`). Android refuses to install over a different signature, so an install from 0.0.3-alpha or 0.0.4-alpha needs an uninstall first. The uninstall wipes the stored clipboard history and the access token.

### Release assets

| Asset | sha256 |
| :--- | :--- |
| `patches-0.0.5-alpha.mpp` | `5b8c42a75875a1caea6a1a1fee54870e1624619a1cb0db7706cbc7347cd31e8e` |
| `Gboard-Clipboard-History.apk` | `5c8d21a744d76f166269cf3a18df7b0331b3f92fb0ce35b57a88c83031bb5423` |
| `PixelBoard-Clipboard-History.apk` | `c7412be5126ccbfd77f21b90873c1bc01d323cd86af95a4121545c30eed858ba` |

### Verify an asset

```bash
gh attestation verify Gboard-Clipboard-History.apk --repo ShubhamJ010/gboard-clipboard-history
```

### Known limits

- The history lives in the plain SQLite database `gboard_clipboard.db` that Gboard already uses. Nothing is encrypted at rest and entries do not expire.
- `android:allowBackup` is still true in the patched Gboard manifest, so the database and the token preferences can end up in a backup.
- Export writes plain text, and it includes sensitive entries when the sensitive toggle is on.
- An entry counts as sensitive only when the app that copied it set the sensitive flag.
- The backfill resolves `content://` items, so a URI copied from another app can pull that app's content into the history.

1. Add `rikunode/fairemail-morphe-patches` as a Morphe patch source; get the original upstream APK and verify the hash.
   In Morphe Manager, **switch OFF “Use prerelease patches”** so it reads stable `main` instead of the older `dev` preview. Refresh the source and confirm **0.3.0 / six patches** before patching. This does not automatically update an installed clone.

2. Confirm the built-in clone patch is ON; turn the external Morphe universal Clone app OFF.
3. Decide whether to enable experimental OAuth, local Pro and export functions.
4. Patch the **original** APK using Morphe Manager. If updating an existing clone, **confirm the package and signing certificate match** before attempting a data-preserving update; `scripts/check_clone_upgrade.py` provides a read-only preflight.
5. After installing, test inbox, outgoing SMTP, token refresh and restored account sync independently. No existing installation must be uninstalled.

## Licensing and project

- Independent project, GPL-3.0. Clone source attribution and required license header retained.
- Existing v0.2.0 release and older prereleases are unchanged; no personal backups, OAuth credentials, APK signing keys or modified pre-signed APKs are distributed.
- [Open release-test checklist](https://github.com/rikunode/fairemail-morphe-patches/issues/5) tracks unverified device scenarios; report only non-sensitive results.

# FairEmail Morphe v0.3.0-rc.1 — public release candidate

This is an **unofficial, independent** GPL-3.0 Morphe patch bundle for the original FairEmail GitHub APKs. It is **not** a FairEmail/FairCode or Morphe official upstream release. This release candidate is for installation and compatibility testing; the existing stable v0.2.0 remains available and unchanged.

## What's new versus v0.2.0

Six patches total, with their defaults:

- **Clone FairEmail alongside official app — ON** (FairEmail 1.2338 only). Uses the same `eu.faircode.email.morphe` package name and provider authority mapping as Morphe's standalone Clone app. **Uncheck the external Morphe Patches → Clone app; do not use both.**
- **Suppress automatic changelog popup — ON** (1.2338 only). Keeps manual changelog available.
- **Permanently hide donation banner — ON** (1.2337/1.2338).
- **Enable OAuth setup in re-signed FairEmail — OFF (experimental)** (1.2338 only). Enables local OAuth setup entry, does not spoof Android signing or change Google OAuth servers.
- **Enable local Pro features — OFF (experimental)** (1.2337/1.2338). App-local checks only, no Play purchases modified.
- **Enable local settings export — OFF (experimental)** (1.2337/1.2338). Makes existing backup-export interface available.

## Verified evidence

- GitHub Actions Java 21/Kotlin build, Android `.mpp` DEX, and six-patch metadata validated.
- All six patches applied to the SHA-256 pinned upstream FairEmail 1.2338a APK; rebuilt APK verified to have the cloned package name.
- Exact provider authority, permission and Android deep-link configuration parity with pinned Morphe universal Clone app.
- In an earlier development build, user screenshots showed Google consent, account addition and receiving newly sent Gmail mail; an encrypted account/settings backup was created and import onto another device was user-reported successful.

## Known limitations — important

- **NOT YET VERIFIED:** Gmail SMTP sending *from* the patched app, refresh after OAuth token expiry, new mail synchronization after restoring on the destination phone, and updating an existing signed clone in place while retaining private data.
- Auto-changelog suppression in a full device lifecycle is not independently confirmed.
- The included clone is tested in APK CI, but **not yet a proven safe upgrade** of an existing clone. Android requires the **same APK package AND same signing key** for a non-destructive update.
- Google OAuth behavior depends on the provider and account configuration; success on one phone is not a general compatibility guarantee. The experimental OAuth patch is OFF by default.
- Do not publish the backup, OAuth credentials, signing key or personal logs in issues.
- FairEmail backup export with an **empty password is unencrypted JSON**; choose a strong nonempty password.

## Installation and safety

1. Obtain the [original FairEmail 1.2338a GitHub APK](https://github.com/M66B/FairEmail/releases/download/1.2338/FairEmail-v1.2338a-github-release.apk); expected SHA-256 `666b9f4ada53f69199355f1ccc2bed73e01fa23786fc0189cf81cc51932dc5a9`.
2. Add the repository as a Morphe patch source, select the release candidate bundle (or download the attached `.mpp`), choose optional features, **disable the separate universal Clone app**.
3. Generate a clone; do not uninstall or clear data of the official FairEmail app or your existing clone.
4. If upgrading an existing clone, first preserve a password-protected backup; use the same package and signing key. See `docs/UPGRADE_AND_RESTORE.md` and `scripts/check_clone_upgrade.py` (read-only compatibility check).

**Distribution:** the downloadable artifact is a **patch bundle**, *not* a signed or modified FairEmail APK. Private keys and account backups are never included.

**Source/licensing:** GPL-3.0; integrated clone code retains upstream Morphe/ReVanced copyright/attribution notice. See repository `LICENSE` and source files.

**Final stable promotion:** device checks and verified release hash are tracked at [release gate issue #5](https://github.com/rikunode/fairemail-morphe-patches/issues/5).

### Features

* Trax Morphe Patches 1.0.0 (Duolingo only) ([9a0a1b3](https://github.com/bastlam/trax_patches/commit/9a0a1b34d80a1629f89f3b977841718d5c6920f7))

In Morphe, refresh the [testing source](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Hexclyde/bitchord-morphe-patches/refs/heads/testing/patches-bundle.json) and select an original BitChord 1.9.1 or 1.9 APK.
For updates, use the same package and signing key to preserve app data.

- **Expanded Java heap** requests Android’s larger app heap and displays the measured device limit. Managed work remains capped at 1024 MiB or the smaller granted limit, with playback reserves and bounded analysis preserved. Install the patched APK and restart the app to activate it.
- **Detailed performance recording** offers bounded 2, 5 and 15 minute sessions, issue markers, correlated operation spans, memory samples and timeline export. Telegram cache reads and estimated download progress remain separate.
- Telegram search collects completed chat requests without waiting behind a slower earlier request when enough results are available. Background searches have a separate bounded worker. Confirmed cached audio reads no longer wait for another reader’s download lease.
- Diagnostics rotates append-only segments instead of rewriting the retained history for every event. Provider cooldown also handles HTTP 429 and longer server retry instructions.

- Player statistics, the quality badge, Audio Pipeline and exported logs use the active rendition's snapshot. A pending or rejected FLAC copy cannot lend its bitrate to Opus playback. Cached source labels use saved provenance, and unknown encoded bit depth remains unknown. File-derived bitrate is labelled as an estimate or average.
- Smooth upgrades allow seek results to settle before another alignment correction. Failed alignment retains the current audio; recording and timing checks remain enforced. Handover diagnostics include the patch revision and source fingerprint.

- **Unofficial Telegram** searches Telegram first, whether the saved index is on, off, empty or still building. The saved index answers when Telegram can't (an error, busy or a rate limit) or finds nothing. A search that only partly worked is shown as incomplete, not as no results. The log for each search names the chats searched (a short hash, never the chat ID), where the answer came from, how many posts Telegram returned, how many were songs, and why the rest were left out. Posts sent as documents without a file extension are recognised by their audio type. A search that found nothing is not repeated while the catalogue and chats are unchanged, and is forgotten when they change or when index pages arrive.
- **Automatic backup** (Advanced) posts a backup to a private channel you created, on a schedule you choose: every 1, 3, 6, 12 or 24 hours or any number of hours, with the saved index, the settings or both. It runs as a background job that survives a restart and a reboot, waits for Telegram's rate limits, yields to playback, previews and searches, and makes one backup for all the intervals that passed while the phone was off. A backup counts as done only when Telegram has posted the file. One that Telegram hasn't confirmed is kept and looked for, not sent again by the clock. Retention removes only older backups this app posted. **Back up now** and **Restore the newest backup** are on the same card.
- Backups now carry how far each chat's index had got, so a restore continues from there. They hold only a fixed list of settings, never the key that protects the Telegram session. Restoring adds the chats and main channel only for the same account and only if this account can open them.

- Playing sources keep their own file routes when another quality upgrade fails or changes the shared lookup. Source labels and upgrade bookkeeping wait for the replacement player; cancelled swaps release their standby buffers.
- AutoMix separates Java measurement arrays from native working memory and reduces read-cache allocations under heap pressure. Decoder checks account for the source channel count.
- Recording diagnostics distinguish allocation refusal, empty or incomplete decoded audio, callback failures and HTTP errors, with sample counts and timestamp ranges.

- **Automix Editor** previews take priority over indexing and background preparation. Track headers distinguish queued work, playback waits, memory waits and audio reads from analysis.
- AutoMix reuses completed decoding after a temporary memory wait and retries promptly when resources become available. Model analysis can use a larger allowance while playback buffers stay under an enforced ceiling.

- **Unofficial Telegram** reuses confirmed cached file ranges instead of asking Telegram again for every small read. It searches further matching pages and tries distinct posts even when their titles and durations match. File reads verify the selected message's file identity.
- Recording verification retries temporary window-read failures without repeating completed windows. Prepared playback accepts small padding differences only after matching fingerprints across the recording.

- Playback preparation pauses competing Telegram indexing, archive checks and AutoMix analysis. Background work resumes after playback settles.
- Recording checks share completed windows for the same audio pair, reject interrupted reads and retry temporary read failures with a delay. Standby upgrades seek from the current playback position and measured recording offset.
- **Diagnostics** includes recording-check identities, stages and timing, and separates system memory, Java heap, playback reserves and analysis allowances.

- **Saved index** now pauses instead of deleting. Turning it off keeps the index, and it can still be backed up or shared. **Back up** can save to a file or post to a private channel you created, and **Restore from a private channel** reads it back. A backup is written to a temporary file, checked, then copied and read back, so an empty or failed save is reported as an error.

- Keep video pictures hidden in Audio mode while BitChord 1.9.1 switches a queued video to its song version. Explicit video selections remain available.

- Support the BitChord 1.9.1 universal APK for shared audio, Telegram and Soulseek. Unsupported 32-bit x86 libraries are removed; ARM64, ARMv7 and x86-64 remain available.

- **Unofficial Telegram** catches up a delayed quality upgrade before fading it in. If the copies cannot be aligned, the current audio keeps playing.

- Fix a startup crash on BitChord 1.9.1 with **Unofficial Telegram** or **Soulseek** installed.

- **Automix Editor** keeps the waveform layout steady through a continuous swipe, including swipes that reach the start of the settings. A fresh pull at the start expands the waveform.
- **Diagnostics** records AutoMix failure stages, memory waits, preview loading times, buffering, source errors and why a preview stopped.

- **Automix Editor** reads downloaded files directly for track analysis and waveform loading.
- **Audio and video switch** refreshes lyrics when the active recording’s length arrives late and preserves a chosen provider across a version with no result.

- **Automix Editor** analyzes queued tracks with missing durations and uses the selected file’s duration when its queue label is rounded.

- **Karaoke** uses smaller model working buffers. Read-ahead stays bounded while the model is loaded, and background decoding waits when heap headroom is low.

- **Automix Editor** reuses native analysis, timing and beat matching unless an explicit tempo override is saved. Deck headers show measured keys and tempo with low-confidence indicators, and Preview waits for an actual automatic plan.

- **Automix Editor** follows the playing pair without discarding drafts, prioritises the outgoing waveform and retries failed waveform requests. Queue analysis prepares one additional readable local or fully cached track when current and next analysis have settled.

- Playlist and album downloads expand source results inside each track card, with reported format filters, duration, size and selected-source details. Each original duration stays visible beside the selected copy’s reported duration.
- Tapping a completed download opens BitChord’s local player. Its recorded source stays available for local playback, and FLAC tag updates preserve existing metadata when no replacement is supplied.

- **Karaoke** (formerly Sing) adds a microphone control directly above Translate in the lyrics. Tapping it switches on separation-model vocal removal and opens a vertical slider linked to the settings slider; after it closes, the microphone stays faintly visible and can be tapped to reopen the slider.
- **Diagnostics** records app and patch events for startup and sign-in troubleshooting. Start and stop capture explicitly, then share a compressed report through Android’s share menu.
- **Audio and video switch** carries a manual lyrics-provider choice between versions of the same queued song and reloads lyrics for the active version.
- Returning to audio clears the video-origin flag so native AutoMix can analyse and blend the song again. Fullscreen can follow the player's request when the window ignores rotation, with Back handled in the player's scope.
- The player's **Download** control uses the current downloadable non-YouTube stream first, then matching alternatives ranked by quality. YouTube is the last fallback when enabled; the control shows the download queue's reported percentage.
- **Transition editor** restores the full waveform when scrolling back to the top, offers an overlap slider and separates draft saving from applying a transition.
- **Automix Editor** has uniform controls, separate track-tempo and matching controls, and adjustable filter depth. Explicit overlap rates keep pitch and return to the listener’s speed after the blend.
- Track analysis accounts separately for decoding and measurement memory, and offers Retry when repeated memory rejections prevent analysis.
- **Automix Editor** loads device audio and reverses preview order without changing listening. **Use this pair** explicitly changes the current and next queue entries; opening a draft does not apply it.
- Draft changes in **Automix Editor** survive rotation without an older delayed save overwriting them.
- Fixed: Google sign-in handles links to other apps without opening an unknown-scheme error page.
- **YouTube Music** can be turned off from Sources. Playback only stops YouTube audio and Full disable also stops its search and browsing; songs use saved files, matching local music or another enabled source, with **No audio track found** shown when none has playable audio.
- **DJ mode** orders upcoming tracks by key and tempo with Steady, Build up and Wind down choices. Compatible keys receive longer blends; Save DJ order updates a local playlist after confirmation.
- **Unofficial Telegram music** updates the saved index when audio and ZIP posts arrive, change or disappear while connected.
- **DJ mode** leaves queue order to native shuffle while shuffle is on. **Audio and video switch** respects music-only playback and manual version changes.
- **Battery saver** stands down for native AutoMix even without **Automix Editor** installed. **Equaliser per output** leaves the native equaliser off while JamesDSP controls effects.
- Supports BitChord **1.9.1** and its experimental **1.9.1-beta1** build alongside 1.9.
- The player's **Audio/Video** pair is centred above the playback-origin caption. **Automix Editor** opens from a separate waveform icon below the stats; the icons follow BitChord's player colours and blending.
- **Automix Editor** is the patch name for source-aware transition analysis and pair editing. Its preset options remain scrollable, with compact Save draft and Apply controls.
- **Downloads** offers a default audio folder through Android’s picker, including writable folders on SD cards and USB drives. New transfers keep their selected destination through pause and retry.
- Completed files in selected folders use Android’s document-provider delete operation. A failed deletion keeps the saved entry.
- YouTube video preparation uses less memory when handling cipher scripts.

Native Patches & tweaks adds installed-feature search, category/enabled filters,
distinct icons, gear-only settings, precise sliders and scoped toggle Undo.

checks. Telegram tasks use grouped native cards and expandable advanced settings.

source selection, original-speed transitions, player and playlist work is retained.

APK configurations, 22 device decoder probes, all 20 native feature controls,
local playlist operations, live previews/downloads and GGlos two-track fades.

## 1.7.7

### Twitter / X (12.7.1)

**"Show media tab for sensitive profiles" — reworked into a proper restriction bypass.**

- The empty profile Media tab ("@user hasn't posted media") is a **server-side** restriction: when
  a profile's media is sensitive and the viewer is not authorised for sensitive content (e.g. an
  age/region-restricted viewer account), the server returns `media_timeline_v2` empty on every
  client — the web grid is empty for the same viewer too. No client-side "show sensitive media"
  unmasking can fill it, because the media is never delivered to that operation.
- The patch now bypasses this by rebuilding the Media tab from the posts-and-replies timeline
  (`user_with_profile_tweets_and_replies_query_v2`), which is **not** withheld the same way, trimmed
  to the owner's own posts that carry media. Reposts (which carry the original author) are excluded.
- **Fallback only, never an unconditional swap** (fixes the v1.6.0 over-application bug where
  non-restricted profiles such as media-rich accounts showed only ~2 items): a profile keeps using
  the server's media grid and only falls back to posts-and-replies once its media timeline has
  actually come back empty.
- **Fixed the repost leak:** filtered entries are now written back by mutating the list in place
  (`clear`/`addAll`) rather than by reflective assignment to the `final` list field, which silently
  no-ops on current ART — so reposts are now actually removed, not just intended to be. The filter
  is also per-entry fail-open so one malformed entry can't abort the whole pass.
- Limitation: posts-and-replies is a sparser source than the real media grid, so an account that
  mostly reposts shows few own-media items, and older own media appears only as you scroll. A
  restricted profile also needs one Media-tab refresh to fill in (the fallback arms after the first
  empty response).

**New: "Bypass native certificate validation (X)"** — optional, off by default. Stubs X's custom
`X509TrustManager` (`com.x.android.io.impl.d`) so an intercepting proxy with a user-installed CA can
read X's native API traffic. For inspecting your own device's traffic; pair with the universal MITM
patches. Leave off for normal use.

- Tracer получает клонированный `applicationId`, поэтому запуск и логин после смены пакета не ломаются.

Известно:

## Что нового

**Блокировка рекламного баннера под плеером.** Пропала карточка «РЕКЛАМА» между блоком комментариев и «Смотрите также» на странице видео. Это не карточка ленты: элемент `AboutVideoItem$a` строится из события `VideoAdBannerRepository`, рисуется `AdBlockDelegate` по layout `res/layout/video_ad_banner.xml`. Патч глушит колбэк доставки загруженной рекламы, поэтому событие не попадает в поток, на который подписан презентер страницы.

Проверено на устройстве на VK Видео 1.168 — карточка пропала.

## Остальное в бандле

- Блокировка видео-рекламы в плеере (прероллы, мидроллы, оверлей).
- Блокировка нативных MyTarget-карточек в lego-ленте.
- Обход нативной проверки подписи в `libvkcore.so` / `libvkmedia.so` (kill-блоки ищутся по структуре, а не по смещению).
- Рабочий вход в аккаунт в клоне (фикс OK Tracer: сверка `applicationId` с пакетом).
- Клонирование пакета рядом с оригиналом (authority провайдеров, объявленных строковым ресурсом).
- Качество видео, выбираемое при патчинге: Авто / 1080p / 720p / 480p / 360p.
- Отключение телеметрии, обход VPN-детекта, перекраска адаптивной иконки лаунчера.

## Оговорки

- Качество видео — опция патча; поведение на устройстве отдельно не проверялось.
- MyTarget-патч ленты применяется (проверено в собранном APK), но именно эта поверхность скриншотом с устройства не подтверждена — та карточка оказалась баннером под плеером.

`patches-1.1.0.mpp` — 913 468 байт, SHA-256 `8dd85be139a600a889cb13a66d1655de5183af342ce09ac75ace47ae22eb577c`.

Патчи Morphe для официального клиента «VK Видео» 1.168 (`com.vk.vkvideo` → клон `com.vk.vkvideo.morphe`).

**В бандле 9 патчей:**

- **Video ad-blocker** — прероллы, мидроллы, построллы, рекламная плашка в плеере, промо-карточки и growth-traps.
- **Video quality preference** — разрешение выбирается при патчинге (Авто / 1080p / 720p / 480p / 360p), по умолчанию 1080p; выбор вручную в плеере перекрывает авто.
- **Native anti-tamper bypass** — обход проверки подписи в `libvkcore.so` и `libvkmedia.so`: kill-блоки `mov w0,#1 ; bl _exit` находятся структурно (по PLT-стабу `_exit` и единственному guard-переходу), а не по жёстким адресам, поэтому переживают смену сборки.
- **Bypass security and package checks** — проверки пакета в AuthBridge и `BuildInfo`, детект окружения.
- **Bypass VPN detection** — перехват `NetworkCapabilities.hasTransport/hasCapability`, `ConnectivityManager.getNetworkInfo` и прокси-свойств.
- **Disable telemetry** — MyTracker.
- **Fix Tracer manifest for clone** — без него клон падал при входе в аккаунт: OK Tracer сверяет `applicationId()` своего манифеста с реальным пакетом и ронял процесс фоновым исключением.
- **Clone app** — смена пакета, снятие split-ограничений, перезапись прав и authority провайдеров, включая те, что объявлены как строковый ресурс (без этого клон не ставился рядом с оригиналом).
- **App icon colors** — перекраска адаптивной иконки: фон и знак отдельными цветами.

**Не закрыто и проверено не полностью:**

- Нативная реклама в ленте рекомендаций под постом (карточка с меткой «РЕКЛАМА», MyTarget) — это отдельный слой, в этом релизе не блокируется.
- Качество проверено на уровне байткода (хук на месте, вызов `getPreferredQuality1080` в APK), но не на глаз в воспроизведении.
- Целевая версия — 1.168; на других сборках патчи ищутся по структурам и могут частично не примениться (в этом случае они молча пропускаются, а не ломают APK).

Установка: импортировать `patches-1.0.0.mpp` в Morphe Manager, выбрать исходный APK «VK Видео» 1.168 и собрать.
- Без уведомления «Найдено опасное приложение»: проверка установленных приложений при запуске (`checkHijackingApps`) находила сам клон по чужой подписи и отправляла отчёт в аналитику.

### Gboard Enhancement Patches Suite v1.4.2

#### 🐛 Fixes in v1.4.2
- **Fix Glide Trail Custom Color Reflection:** Resolved an inverted branch condition (`if-gez` -> `if-ltz`) in `GestureOverlayView.morpheOnDrawHook` timing calculation which was prematurely returning and permanently blocking `morpheApplyCustomTrailSettings` from executing and applying the custom color during glide typing.
- **Synchronous Dual-Context Storage:** Upgraded preference saving in `GlideTrailPreferences` to synchronously `.commit()` values to both default and Device-Encrypted (DE) storage contexts so preferences are immediately visible across all Gboard processes.
- **Mutual Exclusivity:** Choosing a custom color in `ColorWheelDialog` automatically disables Rainbow RGB mode so your chosen color is immediately displayed without conflicting rainbow cycles.
- **View Lifecycle Hook:** Added an active hook on `GestureOverlayView.onSizeChanged` to proactively reload and apply custom settings whenever the keyboard view is displayed or resized.

#### ✨ Included Patches
- **Backspace Repeat Haptic Feedback**: Delivers continuous tactile pulses on each repeated character deletion when holding down the backspace key.
- **Enter Key Tasker Event**: Dispatches high-priority Android Intent broadcasts to Tasker on Enter/IME actions.
- **Glide Trail Customization**: Color Wheel picker, continuous duration/width/length sliders, and dynamic Rainbow RGB effect.

2. Go to **Settings** -> **Sources** -> Refresh sources (or add `https://github.com/ausamnco/gboard-enc-patches`).
3. Repatch Gboard and enjoy!

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/azkiabenington/es-file-explorer-morphe-patches/commits/v1.0.0

### New

All new patches are on by default.

- **Floating window**: When the camera, another app or Home covers Maps during guidance, a small window shows the next turn, the map and your arrival time. Tap it to go back to Maps. On BYD it shows only in D. To allow it and set its size, open Maps' Settings > Floating window.
- **Home and Work**: Two icons under the search box become Home and Work. Tap one to start the route to the place saved in your Google account.
- **Navigation speech**: When Google's online voice isn't ready, Maps reads directions with the car's own text-to-speech voice, so you still hear street names. #15 by @rananga.
- **BYD GPS interval**: During guidance on DiLink 3, Maps no longer asks the car for its position more often than the car updates it.

### BYD battery

- On by default on DiLink 3 BYDs with BYD's energy tables. It starts off on DiLink 5, or if your car's data is too far from BYD's table; the BYD battery screen then says why.
- With Battery on the phone (on by default), Google Maps on your phone now uses your car's measured consumption and the outside temperature. In tests, the phone and the car differed by at most 1% on arrival. Before, the phone showed 3 to 6% more.
- Above 90%, Maps' battery percentage follows the dashboard, so a trip from a full battery no longer shows an arrival a few percent too low.
- On a new install, tap Allow on the trip log card in the BYD battery screen, then on Android's prompt. Maps reads BYD's trip log and starts from your car's real consumption.
- The BYD battery screen shows what to set before a trip first, with the rest under Details. Its km per 1% now comes from your own driving and is one number for the whole battery.

### Also

- The pop-ups these patches add have a new look in Maps' day and night colors.
- In Maps' Settings, UI density is now Display size and Color scheme is now Day/night colors.
- If MicroG-RE isn't on the battery whitelist, Maps can add it for you with **Do it now**.
- Maps warns if your MicroG is not MicroG-RE.
- **Report Maps** shows a **QR code to talk**. Scan it with your phone to add details and read the developer's reply. Only the latest release can send reports; 0.1.9 can still send them for 3 days.

Needs Morphe Desktop 2.2.0 or newer.

Tested on a BYD Dolphin (DiLink 3.0, Android 10) with Google Maps (Android Automotive) 26.10.120003.E and MicroG-RE 7.3.0. Other BYD models are untested, and BYD battery does not support plug-in hybrids (DM-i).

Setup: [README](https://github.com/fangkampanat/google-maps-automotive-patches#install).

## ♟️ Prathxm Patches v1.19.0

Game Review now knows its openings and gives a report card based on how you actually played. The daily puzzle is the real Lichess puzzle of the day, and puzzle sounds work again. Every change was traced through the Chess.com 4.10.17 code and checked against the real app classes.

### ✨ New
- **Opening names and Book moves.** Game Review names your opening (e.g. *Ruy Lopez: Morphy Defense*) and marks theory moves as **Book**, like Chess.com's own review. It runs fully offline from a built-in book of 3,815 lines (Lichess chess-openings). A book line the engine rates as a mistake, blunder or miss keeps that rating.
- **A real report card.** Opening, Middlegame and Endgame ratings come from how accurately you played each phase; before, they were fixed offsets from your overall rating. Tactics rewards brilliant and great moves and penalises blunders and misses. The summary line shows the opening, both accuracies and the blunder count.
- **Book toasts.** With *Rate each move* on, theory moves show `📖 Book: <opening name>`.

### 🐛 Fixes
- **The daily puzzle is the real Lichess puzzle.** Lichess sends solutions in a format Chess.com's parser rejected, so the same fallback puzzle appeared every day.
- **Puzzle sounds play.** The correct, wrong and solved sounds pointed to files that don't exist in 4.10.17, and a wrong move could trigger the "correct" sound. The puzzle's reply now uses Chess.com's opponent-move sound.
- **Report-card grades are read by the app.** The old grade words were ignored.
- **The crash screen always appears**, even for very long error logs (these used to stop it from opening).
- **Custom titles work offline** and on phones set to Turkish.

### 🔧 Improvements
- Less work per move: the app context and settings are cached instead of looked up again and again.

### 🚀 App support
- **Chess.com 4.10.17 / 4.10.17-googleplay** (recommended: **4.10.17-googleplay**)

**CLI:** `java -jar morphe-cli.jar patch -p patches-1.19.0.mpp -o chess-patched.apk com.chess.apkm`

**Controls:** press and hold the top bar of the home screen to open **Engine Settings**. Double-tap it for **panic mode**.

**Quwi's Patches settings** - Quwi's Patches and the Lichess login now open on a root mount too. The screens are a plain view tree now: the activity hosts them on a normally installed patched app, and a dialog hosts them where the activity cannot start. Pages open their own windows again, and Back goes a page back instead of closing. The app log, crash, Discord login and Lichess's review in the app's own browser are separate screens and still need a normal install, which the patch descriptions now say.

**Stockfish analysis** - when the 80 MB engine can't be downloaded, the message now lists every source it tried with the error each one gave, so a name the phone's DNS blocks can be told from a mirror that answered with an error. One more GitHub mirror is tried, and the message names the source that failed instead of the download server it redirected to.

The bundle targets chess.com 4.10.28 and 4.10.27.

**Quwi's Patches settings** - tapping the row on an install where Android has not loaded the patched app yet (a mounted patch before a restart) now says to restart the phone instead of closing chess.com. HushPine moves to PineDrama 47.7.3, so update PineDrama to 47.7.3 before you repatch. There's one new patch too. `Open on Home` starts PineDrama on the Home tab every time, where some accounts landed on Discover (#6).

## What's changed

* `Open on Home` (on by default) starts PineDrama on the Home tab every time. It used to open on Discover for some accounts.
* Retargeted to PineDrama 47.7.3 (version code 2024707030). All the patches apply to it, and every patch that hooks the app's own code was checked again against 47.7.3's code. 47.6.3 isn't a target anymore, so update PineDrama before you repatch.

## Update

Refresh the HushPine source in Morphe Manager 2.5.0 or newer and patch PineDrama again. Keep the manager's existing signing key so your login and settings carry over. The .mpp is a patch bundle, not a PineDrama APK.

## Checked

* All 101 PineDrama patches applied to PineDrama 47.7.3 with none failing.
* This exact bundle was patched onto PineDrama 47.7.3 and run on a signed-in Galaxy S22. A walk through the whole app opened 26 screens with no crash.
* On a fresh install of PineDrama 47.7.3 that wasn't signed in, a cold start opened on Discover with `Open on Home` off, the way #6 showed it. With it on, three cold starts in a row opened on Home.

Saved posts you open from Favorites now play in your Dub priority language, even right after PineDrama starts.

## What's changed

* Saved posts opened from Favorites play in your Dub priority language. The post's page doesn't list the video's dubs, so it used to switch the audio back to the original. Right after PineDrama started, a dub request could also get lost before the audio tracks loaded.

## Update

Refresh the HushPine source in Morphe Manager 2.5.0 or newer and patch PineDrama again. Keep the manager's existing signing key so your login and settings carry over. The .mpp is a patch bundle, not a PineDrama APK.

## Checked

* All 100 PineDrama patches applied to PineDrama 47.6.3 with none failing.
* This exact bundle was patched onto PineDrama 47.6.3 and run on a signed-in Galaxy S22. A walk through the whole app opened 26 screens with no crash.

You can swipe between a drama's episodes in full screen now, and when one ends the next one starts. Subtitles and dubs can follow a language list you set, and History and Favorites keep your place when you come back to them.

This one moves to PineDrama 47.6.3 and a newer patcher, so update Morphe Manager to 2.5.0 or newer before you refresh the HushPine source.

## What's changed

* `Episodes in full screen` is new. Swipe up for the next episode and down for the previous one in PineDrama's full screen view, and an episode that ends moves on to the next instead of looping. Leave full screen and the portrait player is on the episode you stopped at. It's on by default, with a switch under Playback.
* `Keep list position` is new. History and Favorites on your profile hold your place when you switch tabs or come back from a video, and a list you haven't scrolled still shows what you just watched. It's on by default.
* `Subtitle and dub preference` is new. Give Playback an ordered list of subtitle languages and another for dubs, like `en, original`. Force subtitle and Force dub use the first one a video has, while Force original subtitle and Force original dub keep the video's own track. When nothing on your list exists, PineDrama's own pick plays as usual. Feed filter can also hide videos without one of your subtitles or dubs, and on Mini Drama a page it would empty keeps one video so there's still something to swipe from. A dub language counts only when the video has a dubbed track in it, since subtitles in your language don't mean a drama is spoken in it. Everything here starts off.
* The bundle is built on Morphe patcher 2.3.0 now, the one that comes with Morphe Manager 2.5.0 and Morphe Desktop 2.1.0. Update Manager to 2.5.0 or newer before you add this release, since older Manager builds can't load it.
* Retargeted to PineDrama 47.6.3 (version code 2024706030). All the patches apply to it. Every patch that hooks the app's own code was checked again against 47.6.3's code.
* Auto-advance no longer depends on a panel check 47.6.3 dropped, and the streak button patch lets go of a getter the new build removed.
* The Feature Gate Lab's Manage topics and More hashtags per post presets are gone, and AI Self sets one rule fewer. PineDrama 47.6.3 took those gates out of the app.
* What's new shows up again on a PineDrama you first patched with Hushfeed's bundle. The version you'd dismissed there was higher than HushPine's, so the row stayed hidden.
* Picking another language on PineDrama's App language page and tapping Done switches the app's language again. PineDrama waited on a Play Store language download that a patched copy never gets, so nothing changed.

## Update

Refresh the HushPine source in Morphe Manager 2.5.0 or newer and patch PineDrama again. Keep the manager's existing signing key so your login and settings carry over. The .mpp is a patch bundle, not a PineDrama APK.

## Checked

* All 100 PineDrama patches applied to PineDrama 47.6.3 with none failing.
* This exact bundle was patched onto PineDrama 47.6.3 and run on a signed-in Galaxy S22. A walk through the whole app opened 26 screens with no crash.
* In full screen, swiping up and down moved between a drama's episodes, an episode that ended moved on to the next, and leaving full screen kept the episode I was on.
* History and Favorites held their place after switching tabs and after coming back from a video.
* Picking Indonesian on the App language page and tapping Done switched the app's language.
* With Indonesian first in `Dub priority` and `Force dub` on, dubbed dramas on Mini Drama played the Indonesian dub, going by recordings of their audio. `Hide videos without a preferred dub` cleared the undubbed ones, keeping one video on a page it would have emptied.

Bundle oficial Apple Music 7.0.0 (versionCode 1614, 4 ABIs + 7 densidades) usado pelo CI para montar os engine APKs. Nao e um app executavel por si; e o insumo do pipeline.

# Apple Music — apps 1.7.0

Todos os APKs desta release estão assinados com o **mesmo** certificado Morphe
(CN=Morphe, SHA-256 1e058623722ed37eb59bb55411d01d6b7b212c6a8353aacecd60d515cee60463).
O engine e o companion compartilham o UID (sharedUserId com.apple.android);
certificados diferentes fazem o MediaBrowserService recusar a conexão.

## Instalação (nesta ordem)

1. Desinstale o Apple Music oficial (com.apple.android.music): a assinatura é outra.
2. Instale o engine do device: AppleMusic-engine-arm32.apk (TV 32-bit) ou
   AppleMusic-engine-arm64.apk (carro/arm64).
3. Instale o companion: AppleMusic-TV.apk (TV) ou AppleMusic-Car.apk (carro).

## Limitações conhecidas

- Busca indisponível: o MediaBrowserService do engine não anuncia SEARCH_SUPPORTED.
- Criar estação: só a partir do item atual; a sessão não expõe a ação para outros itens.

Confira os downloads com SHA256SUMS.

## Atualizações in-app

O arquivo `updates.json` descreve esta release (versão, versionCode e, por APK,
SHA-256 e tamanho). Os companions com o updater in-app leem esse arquivo em
`releases/latest`, baixam o APK novo, verificam o SHA-256 e abrem o
instalador do sistema; o engine é atualizado antes do app quando houver
versão nova.

## [1.3.1](https://github.com/TahmidSummy/proxy-patches/compare/v1.3.0...v1.3.1) (2026-11-06)

### 🔒 Security

* **Proxy logins are no longer stored in the APK.** The **username** and **password** patch options have been removed.
  * Patch options are stored as plain text inside the patched APK, and **any app on your phone can read installed APKs**. That's how "APK extractor" apps work, with no root needed.
  * Your login is now only ever entered in the app: long-press the Reddit icon → **Proxy settings**. It's stored there in the app's private storage, which other apps can't read.
  * Host, port and proxy type remain available as patch options, to pre-fill the app.
* **Fixed a first-launch DNS leak.** Reddit has a startup "DNS warm-up" that, on a **fresh install's first launch**, looked up `gql-fed.reddit.com` and `cf.gql-fed.reddit.com` using your phone's own DNS, outside the proxy.
  * No traffic went around the proxy, but your network's DNS could see that you'd opened Reddit.
  * The warm-up is now switched off, and the proxy resolves those names as for everything else.

### 🐛 Bug fixes

* **No more false "Can't find your proxy's host name" at startup.** Reddit opens many connections at once when it starts, so a split-second DNS hiccup could fail several of them together and trigger the message, even though everything worked a moment later. A proxy problem now has to **last at least 8 seconds** before you're told about it. Real problems are still reported.

### ⚠️ After updating

* **If you had entered your proxy login as a patch option** (not in the app), enter it once in **Proxy settings**: long-press the Reddit icon. Until you do, the app tells you "Your proxy rejected the login".
* Logins already saved in the app's Proxy settings are kept, so there's nothing to do.

### ✅ Tested

Tested with Reddit 2026.40.0 on an Android 15 emulator, recording every connection **and every DNS lookup** the app made:

* **Fresh installs:** Reddit made **no DNS lookups of its own hostnames**, before and after setting a proxy.
* **Test HTTPS and SOCKS5 proxies:** everything went through the proxy. The only DNS lookup was the proxy's own name.
* **No login set:** the app stays offline and shows "Your proxy rejected the login".
* **Startup DNS hiccups:** no false proxy message any more.

### 📝 About encrypting the saved login

Encrypting the login inside the app (Android Keystore) was looked at and **not added for now**. Android already keeps it private from other apps, encrypts your phone's storage, and encrypts cloud backups with your screen lock. Malware with root could unlock it anyway. And it would add ways for the app to lose your login (for example after some system updates). This may be revisited if the patch ever stores anything more sensitive than a proxy login.

## Waze × Morphe Music — v1.0.0

Premier release des patches de compatibilité entre Waze et Morphe Music.

### Patches inclus

| Patch | App |
|-------|-----|
| Waze Morphe Music support | `com.waze` |
| Waze Morphe Music bytecode | `com.waze` |
| Waze compatibility (MicroG) | `com.google.android.apps.youtube.music` |

### Installation

1. Ouvrir **Morphe Manager**
2. Paramètres → Sources → Ajouter `https://github.com/Loupric/morphe-waze-music-patch`
3. Patcher **Waze** avec les 2 patches Waze
4. Si tu utilises **MicroG**, patcher aussi **YouTube Music** avec le patch MicroG

### Téléchargement manuel

Télécharge `patches-1.0.0.mpp` ci-dessous et importe-le directement dans Morphe Manager (import local).

## YouTube

- **Home feed:** Show a channel’s display name instead of its handle when the card identifies the channel. No network lookup is made. On supported 21.x versions, you can also add an **Add to queue** button to eligible thumbnails. It appends the video without starting playback. Both options are off by default. (#80, #83)
- **Video quality button:** Show the current resolution as `LQ`, `SD`, `HD`, `FHD`, `2K`, `4K`, or an exact number. The timestamp no longer duplicates the quality button; turning the button off restores your timestamp settings. (#75)
- **Swipe controls:** Choose separate side and top/bottom overlay styles, including a horizontal bar centered in the player. Customize the overlay background independently of opacity. Optionally enable swipes in the portrait watch player. Swipe icons follow the selected player icon style, and seekbar gestures stay with the native scrubber. (#82)
- **Cast and Companion:** Restore toolbar Cast independently of player Cast. YouTube 21.39.525 and 21.45.90 also have a separate **Hide Companion button** setting. (#81)
- **Default miniplayer:** Hide the overlay buttons, tap the tile to expand, or swipe down to dismiss. Touch exploration retains the native buttons. (#79)
- **Player fixes:** Keep the played gradient visible after the controls fade in dark portrait mode, and keep the dislike count from disappearing during action-row updates. (#71, #78)

## YouTube Music

- **A–B repeat:** Set two points in Now Playing and loop that section. Clear the markers to resume normal playback.
- **Prefer original audio stream:** Prefer a non-DRC stream when one exists for the same audio track. This is independent of **Disable loudness normalization** and does not replace existing downloads.
- **Player settings:** Corrected the icon and text alignment for **Add to queue in tap order** and **Playback source inspector**.

Refresh the RVX patch source in Manager, then repatch and install the app you use.

<!-- Modified by lavinhoque33, 2026-11-23. -->
## YouTube Music

- **A–B repeat:** Enable **RVX → Player → A–B repeat**. In Now Playing, tap **Set A** and **Set B** below the seekbar to repeat that section. You can pause or scrub to place either marker. Tap **Clear** or seek outside the section to stop repeating. Next still changes tracks, including when crossfade is on.
- **Original audio and loudness:** Under **RVX → Video**, **Prefer original audio stream** chooses a non-DRC encode when one is available for the same audio track. It keeps DRC-only tracks playable. **Disable loudness normalization** controls playback gain separately and keeps your existing setting. Neither switch changes existing downloads.
- **Player settings:** **Add to queue in tap order** and **Playback source inspector** now align with neighboring rows and follow the selected icon style. Parent-only icon mode still leaves both rows iconless.

Verified on Music 9.40.51 on a Moto Edge Plus 2023. Live tracks offered only original audio; the same-track original/DRC pair, DRC-only fallback and independent gain setting were verified separately on Android with constructed format objects. The new controls are omitted on forced Music 6.20.51.

## YouTube Music

- **Playback source inspector:** Touch and hold the three-dot Menu in expanded Now Playing to see which audio and video streams Music is reading. A normal tap still opens the stock menu. The inspector distinguishes a downloaded song from the audio and video tracks of a saved video, and shows the selected format numbers (itags). **Unconfirmed** means the reader could not verify the source; it does not mean network playback. This applies to RVX stream downloads, not exported device files.
- **Stream downloads:** With client spoofing enabled, Music now keeps the local stream when playing a usable RVX download. Tracks without a usable copy retain normal online playback.
- **Add to queue in tap order:** On Music 9.15.51, 9.40.51 and 9.45.51, enable **RVX → Player → Add to queue in tap order** to play manual additions before the original Up next list resumes. Duplicates are kept, **Play next** still jumps the line, and shuffled, Cast and Jam queues keep their stock behavior.

Verified on a Moto Edge Plus 2023: Music 9.40.51 reported saved audio and video separately while online, and cleared the cached labels on an uncached control. Queue ordering and duplicate additions were verified on Music 9.45.51.

Refresh the RVX patch source in Manager, then repatch YouTube Music and install the resulting app.

## Kero309x Patches 0.1.4 (pre-alpha)

Independent, clean-room patch bundle, built for multiple applications. This release completes the Ana Vodafone behaviours and corrects the password one.

### New behaviour

- **Allow screenshots** - the application hides every screen it opens from screenshots and screen recordings through a security library it embeds. This removes that protection, so a screenshot shows the screen.

### Corrected behaviour

- **Keep the password of each account** - the previous release removed the write of the password of the login, which would have lost the password the user typed whenever the token did not carry one. ## Kero309x Patches 0.1.3 (pre-alpha)

Independent, clean-room patch bundle, built for multiple applications. This release adds a second application next to Anghami 8.0.28.

### New application: Ana Vodafone

`com.emeint.android.myservices`, version 2026.11.1 (build 1246), distributed as an APKM bundle.

Eight behaviours:

- **Skip the store licence check** - the application starts on a repackaged build instead of showing a licence screen and shutting down.
- **Disable the forced update requirement** - a build the server marks as outdated is neither blocked nor sent to the store.
- **Disable usage tracking** - the application stops reporting its usage, social-media, survey and experiment events.
- **Ignore the server's remote wipe and forced logout** - a silent push can no longer clear the application's data or log the account out.
- **Hide the promotional card** - the home, recharge and payment screens no longer draw the promotional gift card.
- **Remove the saved account limit** - more than five accounts can be kept, and every one of them can be opened.
- **Disable certificate pinning** - the certificate of the operator's server is validated against the trust store of the device.
- **Keep the password of each account** - the password of an account is taken from the signed token, so the application stops asking for it every time.

- 28 patches, all enabled by default.

Adds two app patches to the existing Morphe collection:

- **SevenGrid Pro** — `app.sevengrid`: Pro habits, themes, history, statistics,
  and reminders. Pro is enabled at offline startup and retained through
  customer-info refreshes and restore flows.
- **Sensu Pro** — `com.piyush.pie`: Pro and all theme entitlements, with local
  overlay feature gates enabled.
- Shared Google Play installer-source fix for all supported apps.
- Includes the existing **Saiyan007** patch for Shima.

Download **Saiyan007-1.2.0.mpp** and import it into Morphe, or refresh the
**AsrOfficialDev/Saiyan007** source. Select the patch matching your app.

**App-version selection is unrestricted.** Structural checks detect
incompatible layouts; SevenGrid currently requires matching Hermes v96 bytecode.

Build, patch application, APK signature, bytecode, and resource checks passed on
**SevenGrid 1.5.2 (80)**, **Sensu 0.1.1 (3)**, and **Shima 0.4.0 (7)**.
SevenGrid's Hermes checksum and isolated entitlement flows also passed.
On-device testing is pending.

## [1.3.0](https://github.com/andersonlucasg3/apple-music-morphe-patches/releases/tag/v1.3.0)

**Suporte a Android TV, em cima das correções de UI da 1.2.0.**

- Manifest: adiciona o intent-filter `LEANBACK_LAUNCHER` e um banner na `MainActivity`, e declara `android.software.leanback` e `android.hardware.touchscreen` como `required=false`. O mesmo APK continua abrindo no DiLink.
- Foco D-pad no conteúdo: highlight de foco nos cards do Listen Now, nas linhas da Busca, no pill do mini player e nos controles do Now Playing; o container `player_controls` deixa de capturar as setas; o viewport do conteúdo ganha padding para o foco sair da lista em cima e embaixo.
- Foco D-pad no player: hook no `onStateChanged` do BottomSheet leva o foco ao play/pause quando o Now Playing expande e devolve ao mini player quando fecha.
- **Requisito de bundle**: TV box 32-bit só instala com os splits `armeabi-v7a`; monte o APK com base + `config.armeabi_v7a` (+ `config.xhdpi`) do APKM/XAPK oficial.
- **Limitação**: o indicador de foco é o highlight/ripple do framework, não escala o card; as abas do topo são alcançadas com UP + LEFT a partir do conteúdo.

Herdado da 1.2.0 (UI no API 29): o JS da Apple servido pelo APK reporta `prefers-color-scheme: dark`, deixando a página de login legível sobre o fundo preto do WebView; e o modo imersivo da tela de letras só é aplicado em API 30+, o que remove a faixa preta de 90 px no API 29.

Validado no TV box Xiaomi (API 34, 32-bit, 1920x1080/320 dpi): instala, abre, loga, toca, layout tablet; D-pad navega lista → pill → Now Playing → BACK; ENTER alterna PLAYING/PAUSED.

Entrada: **XAPK** do Apple Music 7.0.0 (APKPure). APKM não é aceito porque o bundle declara `apkFileType = XAPK`.

### APK para Android TV (32-bit)

O asset `AppleMusic-1.3.0-AndroidTV-arm32.apk` é o mesmo bundle já aplicado num merge 32-bit (base + `config.armeabi_v7a` + `config.xhdpi` do APKM oficial), assinado com `CN=Morphe`.

- SHA-256: `c4e1687845cee5952cc71aab9253c5d9744ade8be3031293c1d9f39e54a9f80c`
- Requer TV box com ABI `armeabi-v7a` (a maioria dos boxes Xiaomi e TVs 1080p); TVs arm64 usam o bundle completo via Morphe Manager.
- Instalação: `adb install -r AppleMusic-1.3.0-AndroidTV-arm32.apk` (desinstale o Apple Music oficial antes, se houver).

## Apple Music DiLink 1.2.0

**Correções de UI no BYD DiLink 3.0 (Android 10 / API 29).**

### O que mudou
- **Tema do login no WebView:** o WebView 74 do carro tem `matchMedia`, mas não suporta a media
  feature `prefers-color-scheme`, então a página da Apple sempre escolhia o tema claro sobre o
  fundo preto do WebView (texto cinza-escuro ilegível). O JS servido pelo APK agora reescreve
  `window.matchMedia("(prefers-color-scheme: dark)")` para reportar `matches: true`; o login passa
  a renderizar legível.
- **Tela de letras:** em API 29 o app escondia a nav bar com
  `setSystemUiVisibility(vis | 4098)` sem `LAYOUT_HIDE_NAVIGATION`, deixando 90 px pretos no lugar
  da barra. O modo imersivo das letras agora só é aplicado em API 30+; no Android 10 a barra do
  BYD volta a aparecer, como nas outras telas.

### Como instalar
- **Morphe Manager:** adicione a source `github.com/andersonlucasg3/apple-music-morphe-patches` e
  use o **XAPK** do Apple Music 7.0.0 (APKPure). O bundle declara `apkFileType = XAPK`, então
  arquivos `.apkm` são rejeitados.
- **Manual:** instale o APK merged `AppleMusic-1.2.0-DiLink.apk` (assinado com `CN=Morphe`);
  desinstale o Apple Music oficial antes.

### Verificação desta versão
- **Smoke no Galaxy S24 (Android 16):** o APK instalado com `adb install -r` sobre a 1.1.0 manteve
  a conta logada; Início, menu, Ajustes, player e playback OK; `Ajustes > Conta > Buscar Amigos`
  renderiza os dois toggles; logcat sem `FATAL`/`NoSuchMethodError`.
- **Validação no DiLink (carro) ainda não foi feita** nesta versão: o login dark e o fim da faixa
  preta nas letras só podem ser confirmados no head unit.

### Pendências conhecidas (UI em API 29)
- Linhas de toggle do Ajustes que não são pintadas.
- Definição do `peek` dos carrosséis (a geometria está correta; os 36 dp à direita são o card
  seguinte).

São diferenças de layout/insets, não de accent color.

## Apple Music DiLink 1.1.0

**Login e reprodução funcionando no BYD DiLink 3.0 (Android 10 / API 29).**

### O que mudou
- **JS da Apple transpilado** para o WebView 74 (Chromium 74) e servido pelo próprio APK via
  `shouldInterceptRequest` — o fluxo de sign-in renderiza e executa.
- **Anisette/ADI substituído**: o provider nativo (`INativeAnisetteProvider`) foi trocado por
  geração local de OTP:
  - GrandSlam (`dsid=-2`): envelope V3 de 28 B (ver 5 + trailer Android 4);
  - Store / V1.5 (`dsid=-1`): AMD de 24 B (ver 4, sem trailer).
  Identidade Android provisionada com `apple-auth` (MIT) e embutida no bundle.
- **`Surface.setFrameRate` (API 30)** e **`IBinder.getSuggestedMaxIpcSizeBytes` (API 30)**
  redirecionados — elimina o crash do ExoPlayer ao iniciar o playback no Android 10.
- Instrumentação de debug removida; o manifest não recebe mais `android:debuggable`.

### Como instalar
- **Morphe Manager:** adicione a source `github.com/andersonlucasg3/AppleMusic-DiLink` e use o
  **XAPK** do Apple Music 7.0.0 (APKPure). O bundle declara `apkFileType = XAPK`, então
  arquivos `.apkm` são rejeitados.
- **Manual:** instale o APK merged `AppleMusic-1.1.0-DiLink.apk` (assinado com `CN=Morphe`);
  desinstale o Apple Music oficial antes.

### Pendências conhecidas (UI em API 29)
- Faixa preta na tela de letras.
- Cards cortados à direita nos carrosséis.
- Espaçamentos grandes na tela de Ajustes.

São diferenças de layout/insets, não de accent color.

# Apple Music — apps 1.9.9

Todos os APKs desta release estão assinados com o **mesmo** certificado Morphe
(CN=Morphe, SHA-256 1e058623722ed37eb59bb55411d01d6b7b212c6a8353aacecd60d515cee60463).
O engine e o companion compartilham o UID (sharedUserId com.apple.android);
certificados diferentes fazem o MediaBrowserService recusar a conexão.

## Instalação (nesta ordem)

1. Desinstale o Apple Music oficial (com.apple.android.music): a assinatura é outra.
2. Instale o engine do device: AppleMusic-engine-arm32.apk (TV 32-bit) ou
   AppleMusic-engine-arm64.apk (carro/arm64).
3. Instale o companion: AppleMusic-TV.apk (TV) ou AppleMusic-Car.apk (carro).

## APK único (engine + UI no mesmo pacote)

A release também traz `AppleMusic-one-arm32.apk` (arm32/TV) e
`AppleMusic-one-arm64.apk` (arm64/carro): o engine com a UI embutida, sem
companion.

1. Desinstale o Apple Music oficial e instale `AppleMusic-one-<abi>.apk` por cima
   do engine (mesmo pacote/cert: a conta é preservada), ou no lugar de
   engine + companion.
2. O botão **Atualizações** (e a checagem ao abrir, no máximo 1x/dia) lê o
   `updates.json`, compara o `versionCode`, baixa o APK da ABI, confere o
   SHA-256 e abre o instalador do sistema.

## Limitações conhecidas

- Busca indisponível: o MediaBrowserService do engine não anuncia SEARCH_SUPPORTED.
- Criar estação: só a partir do item atual; a sessão não expõe a ação para outros itens.

Confira os downloads com SHA256SUMS.

## Atualizações in-app

O arquivo `updates.json` descreve esta release (versão, versionCode e, por APK,
SHA-256 e tamanho). Os companions com o updater in-app e o APK único
(`one-arm32`/`one-arm64`) leem esse arquivo em `releases/latest`, baixam o
APK novo, verificam o SHA-256 e abrem o instalador do sistema; no companion
o engine é atualizado antes do app quando houver versão nova.

No patch-logic changes (patch classes byte-identical to v1.2.5). This release fixes the process problem behind the failed updates: every previous signing key was lost with a recycled build sandbox, forcing rotations at v1.2.0/v1.2.4/v1.2.5 that Morphe Manager rightly refused (it pins the signer on first install).

- ONE permanent signing key from now on (stored durably; never rotates again). **When updating from v1.2.3/1.2.4/1.2.5, Manager shows a one-time "new signing key" confirmation - tap Trust.** That is the pinned-key change, not an attack.
- STATE.md at the repo root now carries the full investigation memory (crash bisection status, welcome-init-failure analysis, build instructions), and the sandbox-storage release holds the unpatched .apkm inputs, diagnostic builds and keystores, so hourly sandbox wipes stop losing work.

This release carries no .mpp and is marked prerelease, so Morphe Manager never offers it as a patch update.

## v1.2.5 - Modded-APK cross-analysis: permission hygiene + wider endpoint net

Two community modded Opera builds (vadj's Opera 103.3.5234.91185 mod and ANiK555's Opera Mini mod) were decompiled and diffed against the originals to harvest techniques for this bundle.

**New patch: Remove ad & tracking permissions** (default on, all four supported packages) - deletes ad-profiling/tracking entries from AndroidManifest.xml: Google Privacy Sandbox (ACCESS_ADSERVICES_AD_ID / _ATTRIBUTION / _TOPICS), the Google Advertising ID (AD_ID), Play install-referrer attribution (BIND_GET_INSTALL_REFERRER_SERVICE), READ_BASIC_PHONE_STATE and the Huawei AppGallery telemetry shim. Remove-if-present semantics (5 entries on stable/beta, 4 on GX), plus the android.adservices.AD_SERVICES_CONFIG manifest property when a future build declares one. The permission list mirrors the one the ANiK555 Opera Mini mod strips from its manifest (the only statically readable part of that build - its dexes are DexProtector-protected). Apps must already tolerate every runtime permission being denied, so nothing user-visible can break.

**Disable analytics & tracking: endpoint list extended** from 81 to 93 constants on stable/beta (12 on GX, up from 8): the Pangle/TikTok ad pipeline (*.pangle.io, api16-access-ttp-b.tiktokpangle-b.us, lf-static.tiktokpangle-cdn-us.com, sf16-static.i18n-pglstatp.com, analytics.tiktok.com/i18n/pixel), the Liftoff/Vungle pipeline (logs./events./adx./config.ads.vungle.com), AppsFlyer including its Privacy-Sandbox trigger (privacy-sandbox.appsflyersdk.com) - all hosts enumerated from the string-pool diff of vadj's mod, which deleted the whole Pangle SDK (3,731 com.bytedance.* classes + its IAB OMOID consent stack) - and Google's crash telemetry (*.crashlytics.com, present on GX). Subdomain spellings were consolidated into bare-domain CONTAINS matches; rewrites verified in the patched output dex.

**Validation of our existing approach**: vadj's mod also does not delete Opera's mediation loader - it only excludes split_pangle_ads from its merge and lets the loader fall back to the no-op ads provider, exactly the safety argument documented for Disable ad modules since v1.0.0. His only other change is a self-promotion dialog (com.ap.va.abror), not adopted.

Full E2E re-run on real APKs: all patches pass on Opera stable 103.3.5234.91185 (base + merged), Opera Beta 104.0.5262.91143 (base) and Opera GX 3.3.18 (base). Patch count: 10. Full history in CHANGELOG.md.

Adds the `Android Auto template-only app` patch and documents the install route that works on a physical head unit.

## What changed

- **New patch `Android Auto template-only app`.** Google Maps declares three Android Auto capabilities: `projection` (Google-signed callers only), `notification` and `template` (the Car App Library navigation surface this project uses). A real head unit validates `projection` first, rejects a re-signed app, and then falls back to the notification surface, so the launcher entry opened "No new messages during this drive" instead of the map. The patch leaves only `template` and strips the Google-only `CATEGORY_PROJECTION` intent filters.
- **Install route.** Android Auto's "Unknown sources" developer setting does not cover Car App Library apps, and `adb install -i com.android.vending` does not help. Install the finished, signed single APK with [KingInstaller](https://github.com/fcaronte/KingInstaller) **Classic** (Root and Shizuku both off). See the README for the full steps and for how to check the two installer fields.

## Verified

Galaxy S25 (Android 16) + Pernis MS700CL over wireless Android Auto 18, and the headunit emulator over USB. Other phones and head units are not covered.

## piko patches 3.11.1 with local view history

Full piko patch bundle for Instagram, rebased onto `crimera/piko` **v3.11.1** plus the **View history**
feature and its auto-delete option.

### What's added on top of stock piko

- **View history** — every feed post, Reel and Story you open is stored locally on the device
  (2000 entries max, newest first, re-viewing moves an item to the top).
- **Auto-delete history** — keep forever (default), 1/2/3 days, 1 week, 2 weeks, 1 month or
  3 months. Pruning runs when a view is logged and when the history screen opens, so lowering the
  limit applies immediately.
- The viewer opens from **Piko settings → History → View history**; long-press a card to copy its
  link or delete it.

### Upstream changes in 3.11.1

This build includes everything piko shipped between 3.10.0 and 3.11.1. The view-history code was
rebased onto the new settings framework (the 3.11 rewrite that moved fragment dispatch into
`ScreenBuilder.buildFragment`) and onto the settings constructors that now take a
`REQUIRED` / `NOT_REQUIRED` argument.

### Install

1. Morphe Manager **1.33.0-dev.1 or newer**.

## piko patches 3.10.0 with local view history

Full piko patch bundle for Instagram, built from `crimera/piko` v3.10.0 plus the **View history**
feature and its auto-delete option.

### What's added on top of stock piko

- **View history** — every feed post, Reel and Story you open is stored locally on the device
  (2000 entries max, newest first, re-viewing moves an item to the top).
- **Auto-delete history** — keep forever (default), 1/2/3 days, 1 week, 2 weeks, 1 month or
  3 months. Pruning runs when a view is logged and when the history screen opens, so lowering the
  limit applies immediately.
- The viewer opens from **Piko settings → History → View history**; long-press a card to copy its
  link or delete it.

### Install

1. Morphe Manager **1.33.0-dev.1 or newer** (older versions crash with
   `Resources$NotFoundException` when the Theme patch is enabled).
2. Select your Instagram APK/APKM.
3. Import this `.mpp`, keep **View history** enabled.

## Kero309x Patches 0.1.4 (pre-alpha)

Independent, clean-room patch bundle, built for multiple applications. This release completes the Ana Vodafone behaviours and corrects the password one.

### New behaviour

- **Allow screenshots** - the application hides every screen it opens from screenshots and screen recordings through a security library it embeds. This removes that protection, so a screenshot shows the screen.

### Corrected behaviour

- **Keep the password of each account** - the previous release removed the write of the password of the login, which would have lost the password the user typed whenever the token did not carry one. The patch now writes the password only when the login carries one and keeps the password of the signed token otherwise.

## Kero309x Patches 0.1.3 (pre-alpha)

Independent, clean-room patch bundle, built for multiple applications. This release adds a second application next to Anghami 8.0.28.

### New application: Ana Vodafone

`com.emeint.android.myservices`, version 2026.11.1 (build 1246), distributed as an APKM bundle.

Eight behaviours:

- **Skip the store licence check** - the application starts on a repackaged build instead of showing a licence screen and shutting down.
- **Disable the forced update requirement** - a build the server marks as outdated is neither blocked nor sent to the store.
- **Disable usage tracking** - the application stops reporting its usage, social-media, survey and experiment events.
- **Ignore the server's remote wipe and forced logout** - a silent push can no longer clear the application's data or log the account out.
- **Hide the promotional card** - the home, recharge and payment screens no longer draw the promotional gift card.
- **Remove the saved account limit** - more than five accounts can be kept, and every one of them can be opened.
- **Disable certificate pinning** - the certificate of the operator's server is validated against the trust store of the device.
- **Keep the password of each account** - the password of an account is taken from the signed token, so the application stops asking for it every time.

### Verification

- 28 patches, all enabled by default.
- 20/20 PASS against the stock Anghami 8.0.28 build.

# M1zir’s SwiftKey Clipboard Patches v0.3.1 (experimental)

Maintained by **Abubakr Ahmed (M1zir)**. Targets **Microsoft SwiftKey 9.13.19.3**
(`com.touchtype.swiftkey`).

## Fixed: the intended Arabic 123 legacy arrangement

SwiftKey contains two different layouts named **Arabic 123 - Legacy**. Version
0.3.0 exposed the wrong one for the requested arrangement. This release selects
the correct native variant:

- **ط** is at the end of the middle letter row.
- **و** is the third letter on the bottom row.

## New: Keep clipboard history forever

Removes the one-hour expiration for local clipboard entries and fixes timestamp
sorting for entries weeks apart. Screenshots and images that SwiftKey successfully
adds to its clipboard use the same expiration rule. Pinning, manual deletion,
and normal save/load behavior are preserved.

storage and memory still set practical limits. Expired clips cannot be recovered;
cloud clipboard behavior is unchanged.

- **Remove ads:** ports the ad-pod suppression behavior and bundled override set. This is not a promise that every ad placement is removed.
- **Remove snooze warning:** removes the alpha-build expiry/snooze warning dialog.
- **Change channel name:** changes the channel label shown in the developer-options UI; the `channelName` option defaults to `Mods`.
- **Upload Instants from Gallery:** a separate selectable patch targeting the main Instagram package (`com.instagram.android`); adds gallery-based photo/video selection to Instagram's Instants camera flow. It is not an Instagram Instants (`com.instagram.moonshot`) patch.

- **Instants Mod:** adds a gallery picker to the camera flow and a save-to-gallery action for friends' Instants. Saving uses MediaStore and requires Android 10 or later.

# Changelog

## 0.3.0 — 2026-11-12

- **HDR light tunes itself.** Real films are graded far below HDR's 203-nit reference white (edge light measured on
  the owner's TV: mostly 20–60 nits), so a fixed white level can't fit them all. **Automatic white level** (on by
  default): it follows the film's brightness like a camera's exposure — the 80th percentile of the points' light,
  smoothed over about 20 s, dark frames ignored — with a **Lights level** to make it brighter or dimmer. Calibrated so
  the owner's film lands where he set it by hand.
- **Brightest highlight from the TV** (on by default): the peak luminance the TV reports in its EDID (Android's
  Display.HdrCapabilities). A TV that reports none keeps the manual value. The page shows the TV's name, maker, year,
  HDR types and luminance as Android sees them.
- First run and every reset start in this automatic setup.
- **▲▼ arrows** on every slider value: one step per tap, repeating while held.
- New defaults: 11 updates per second; 6 / 6 / 3 / 3 points per edge. Settings that were still at the old defaults
  (20; 8 / 8 / 4 / 4) move to the new ones once.

## 0.2.1 — 2026-11-12

- **Black bars: true black only.** A row or column is a bar only when no pixel in it is brighter than the bar level,
  now 2 by default (a video's own black arrives as 0–1 after the GPU's YUV-to-RGB rounding); a dark picture is never a
  bar. Bars come in pairs (top/bottom, left/right: the smaller side counts, so a dark area on one side stays picture),
  and a new result must hold for 1.5 s before the areas move. The old level (24, up to 100) cut dark parts of the
  picture off and made the box jump. A stored level over the new limit (32) falls back to the default.
- **Resets that say what they reset:** "Reset points" on the Points card, "Reset the SDR/HDR set" on the Colour card,
  and "Reset all settings" out of the folded section.

## 0.2.0 — 2026-11-12

- **HDR light, read correctly.** On Android 14, PixelCopy tone-maps an HDR video for a 1000-nit display and scales the copy
  so that 1000 nits is full white (Readback + libtonemap ToneMapper13): HDR reference white (203 nits) came out at 48 %,
  100 nits at 35 % — the very dim LEDs. The copy is now turned back into the picture's light in nits (the exact inverse of
  that pipeline, including the 650–4000-nit highlight compression), and the light goes to the LEDs through three new
  settings of the HDR set: **white level** (nits shown as full white, default 203), **highlight headroom** (LED range kept
  above white, default 25 %) and **brightest highlight** (nits, about the TV's peak, default 1000).
- **How the HDR picture is read** (HDR set): automatic — a hardware decoder's copy is tone-mapped by Android, a video
  Stremio decodes with FFmpeg holds the PQ/HLG signal itself — or one of them by hand, or "as is" (the old behaviour).
- The old "HDR correction" (which treated every copy as the PQ signal) is gone.
- **New settings page design**: sticky live preview with glowing points and room glow, Points and Colour cards, HDR light
  with a live nits-to-LED graph, connection and playback settings folded under "More settings".

## 0.1.0 — 2026-11-12

First release.

- **Ambient light**: the playing picture's edges go to HyperHDR (flatbuffer server, default port 19400) while the hardware
  decoder stays on. PixelCopy of the player's video surface at 96×54, one average per point, black bars skipped.
- Points: counts per edge (top, bottom, left, right), distance from the edge, area depth and width, black-bar level.
- SDR and HDR are told apart from the video itself (MediaCodec's format, or Media3's format for videos Stremio's FFmpeg
  renderer decodes): PQ, HLG and Dolby Vision are HDR. Each has its own colour set (brightness, black level, gamma,
  saturation, colour temperature); the HDR set adds an HDR correction (PQ to SDR).
- Settings page on the TV, `http://<TV address>:8095`: live preview, every change applied at once and saved on the TV.
  Home network only. No HyperHDR address is built in: nothing is sent until it is typed on the page.
- Tunneled playback has its own switch on the page, off by default (Stremio ties it to "Audio passthrough"; a tunneled
  picture never reaches the app). Audio passthrough keeps working without it.
- **Ambient app name and icon**: "Stremio Ambient", with an edge-lit launcher icon and TV banner.
