# YouTube Censor 0.10.1 - simplified settings alpha

The main settings page now has six entries. Timing controls are under **Mute timing**; regex, matching, caption style and troubleshooting are under **Advanced settings**. **Always censor channels** and its override behavior are removed. The main Enable switch applies to all channels except your whitelist.

Whitelist the channel you are viewing with the new **shield +** toolbar action. A checked shield means the channel is exempt; tap it to remove the exception. This works alongside the existing Channel search action and does not require that patch to be selected.

Manage entries under **Settings > Morphe > Player > YouTube Censor > Whitelisted channels**: search, add, edit IDs or readable labels, remove, Save and Cancel. Existing channel exceptions are preserved. Channel-page additions use stable IDs. Audio mute decisions refresh immediately while preserving your own mute and volume choices. No new network request is needed to add an entry.

See and customize the full active word list on Android. Open **Settings > Morphe > Player > YouTube Censor > Censored words and phrases**.

- Search your active default and custom words and phrases.
- Add, edit or remove entries using plain text. No regex required.
- Save commits your edits; Cancel discards them. Restore Defaults is a draft until saved.
- Existing additions, exclusions and literal overrides carry forward. Unchanged default matching families keep their behavior.
- Optional regex is under Advanced settings. The word editor replaces duplicate preset switches; saved word choices are preserved.

Restart YouTube after saving changes to refresh already-loaded caption schedules.

**[Add source to Morphe on Android](https://morphe.software/add-source?github=Cristian2737/YouTube-Censor&name=YouTube%20Censor&app=com.google.android.youtube)** - [Installation guide](https://github.com/Cristian2737/YouTube-Censor#install-on-android)

Select **YouTube Censor** from this bundle alongside your desired upstream patches. This is a full Morphe-derived bundle; avoid applying duplicate stock/fork patches in the same job. Tested with YouTube **21.30.216**, Android 14. For an in-place app update, retain your original package name and signing key.

Update the source in Morphe Manager, then repatch a clean supported YouTube APK with **YouTube Censor** and your existing patches. Updating a patch source alone does not modify an installed app.

Automated suites cover 270 assertions, including channel navigation, preserving search actions, stable IDs, editing labels, Save/Cancel and immediate audio restoration. Host callback checks use Android view doubles. The 0.10.0 editors and live channel toolbar also passed native Android 14 checks alongside all 115 selected patches; the grouped 0.10.1 layout passed a separate native check of all six main entries, timing and advanced pages, followed by the editors and live channel toolbar. The earlier v0.8 runtime passed a phone listening check. Missing or unusable captions still cannot be filtered. No audio recognition, desktop export or project-operated service.

Assets:
- **youtube-censor.mpp** - import into Morphe Manager, not an APK.
- **SHA256SUMS** - SHA-256 integrity checks.
- **youtube-censor-corresponding-source.tar.gz** - complete modified upstream source plus overlay, build scripts and tests.
- **LICENSE / NOTICE** - required source and binary notices; preserved from upstream.

Independent from Morphe, YouTube and ContentAngel. No YouTube APKs or signing keys are distributed.

# immich-media-patches v2.0.1

Morphe patches that make an app's built-in photo picker browse a self-hosted
[Immich](https://immich.app) server — nothing is synced to the device, and the
originals are what get uploaded.

**Supported in this release**

| App | Version | Verified |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `com.discord` | 351.11 - Stable | yes — device, Android 13 |
| `com.tumblr` | 47.0.0.108 | yes — device, Android 13 |

`patches-2.0.1.mpp` — SHA-256: `374551b58eed5447523b741219d06dc31d7378d4e6823d8f96d76b6a0a6534a3`

## Changes in this release

- The patched apps now log their configuration mode at provider start
  (`config: bridge mode …`, `provider ready … mode=bridge`) — previously the init
  order dropped those lines. No functional change over v2.0.0.

## Verified credential-free

Patching **with no options at all** produces APKs with no baked credentials, and on
device: cold picker processes serve the timeline through the Immich app; evicted
originals re-download through it; `am force-stop` on the Immich app does not break the
pickers (the system restarts it on demand to serve the bridge); disabling or
uninstalling the app leaves the picker empty and stable.

## What's new in v2

- **Full gallery.** The picker shows what the Immich app itself shows: local
  (not-yet-backed-up) assets and remote assets interleaved, read from the app's own
  timeline database. Fresh photos appear before backup; backed-up assets deduplicate
  to their remote copy.
- **The Immich app becomes the orchestrator.** When the (forked) Immich app is
  installed and signed in, patched apps take the server URL and session from it — no
  configuration at all, and credentials live in exactly one place.
- **Patch options are optional.** Leave `immichBaseUrl` / `immichApiKey` empty for
  bridge mode, or set them to bake a fallback for devices without the Immich app
  (direct mode, the v1 behaviour).
- Previews are WebP thumbnails; uploads are the untouched originals.

## Using it

```bash
java -jar morphe-desktop-1.15.0-all.jar patch \
  -p patches-2.0.1.mpp \
  -e "Immich photo picker" \
  -o app-patched.apk \
  app.apk
```

Morphe can also fetch this bundle straight from the repository:
`--patches=https://github.com/anoraktrend/immich-media-patches`.

### Bridge mode (recommended)

Build the custom Immich app from the fork:
`https://github.com/anoraktrend/immich-android-bridge`, branch `android-bridge`
(commit `b838c7390`), following `docs/v2-orchestrator.md`. Sign it with **your own
keystore, and sign these patches with the same key** (`--keystore …`) — the bridge is
guarded by a signature-level permission.

### Direct mode

Pass `-O immichBaseUrl=https://immich.example.com -O immichApiKey=…` at patch time.
Works on any device without the Immich app; a read-only API key is enough.

## Notes and honest limitations

- Use **merged APKs** (splits folded in); the patch strips `requiredSplitTypes`.
- Replacing a store install needs a full uninstall (signature change): back up the
  app's data, restore it afterwards, fix ownership and **re-grant runtime
  permissions** — Android keeps grants in system state, not app data.
- Android 11+ fully supported; Android 8–9 works except local-only previews.
- Version pins are exact. Other Discord/Tumblr releases are untested — for other
  apps, see `docs/new-patches.md`.
- Patch your own copies. Discord and Tumblr remain their owners' work; these patches
  are The Unlicense (public domain) and the Immich fork is AGPL-3.0.

Correção experimental para **SwiftKey 9.13.19.3**.

O botão **Mais opções → Reordenar itens** ainda abria o editor original com seis posições na 0.1.0. Agora ele abre **Atalhos da barra**, onde é possível desmarcar itens e salvar uma quantidade menor. O acesso por **Configurações → Personalizar toolbar** permanece disponível.

Exemplo: deixe somente Área de transferência e GIF marcados e salve. A barra terá esses dois atalhos e Mais opções; o patch não completa as seis posições com outros itens.

**Como atualizar:** atualize a fonte no Morphe ou importe o novo `.mpp`, reaplique os três patches ao APK/APKM original 9.13.19.3 e instale o resultado pelo mesmo Morphe usado anteriormente. Depois abra Reordenar itens, desmarque os atalhos e salve.

Validação: 14 testes, incluindo o clique do acesso original e a redução de seis atalhos para dois; aplicação ao APKM original com fingerprints validados; confirmação da nova chamada no DEX emitido; assinatura e alinhamento do APK conferidos. O resultado ainda precisa ser confirmado no aparelho real.

O APK do SwiftKey e as chaves de assinatura não são distribuídos. Esta release contém o bundle `.mpp`, o catálogo e os metadados da fonte.

Primeira versão **experimental** para Microsoft SwiftKey **9.13.19.3**.

- Dois patches de privacidade adaptados do [Hooman](https://github.com/arandomhooman/hoomans-morphe-patches): convite automático de login e telemetria.
- Novo editor em **Configurações → Personalizar toolbar**: selecionar atalhos, ordenar, salvar localmente e restaurar o padrão.
- Distribuição dos ícones pelo layout nativo; Mais opções permanece disponível.

Validação: 12 testes JVM/Android com Robolectric, aplicação ao APKM 9.13.19.3 com fingerprints validados, inspeção do DEX emitido, verificação da assinatura e alinhamento do APK gerado.

**Ainda não validado no aparelho real nem pelo Morphe Manager no Android.** A instalação modificada tem assinatura diferente da oficial. O bundle foi validado com Morphe Desktop 2.1.1 / Patcher 2.3.0.

Esta release distribui somente o código de patches compilado (`.mpp`), sob GPL-3.0. O APK do SwiftKey, seus arquivos decompilados e as chaves de assinatura não são publicados.

- **Fix Redgifs**: Fixes Redgifs videos not loading.
- **Fix load more comments**: Fixes "load more comments" not loading further comments.
- **Fix /s/ links**: Opens Reddit share links (/s/) as the post they point to, from the app and from other apps.
- **Fix media links**: Opens reddit.com/media links as the Reddit-hosted image they wrap.
- **Fix markdown links**: Shows markdown links that Reddit leaves as raw text, such as links to u/name, as links.

# BYD Maps patches v1.95.1

Morphe patch bundle that puts your BYD's state of charge in Google Maps' navigation card.

This repository is a **fork of [nl-morphe-patches](https://gitlab.com/johninnld/nl-morphe-patches)**
(GPL-3.0) with one feature added. The upstream patch set is unchanged and still available from the
upstream source; this fork exists so the BYD patch can be released and versioned on its own.

## What it does

| Where | What you see |
|---|---|
| Android Auto | a chip above the ETA card: `33% → 29%` (charge now → charge at arrival) |
| Phone | the same pair appended to the time-remaining line |

The arrival figure is a linear estimate from the car's own consumption (`range ÷ charge`), clamped
at `0%` when the destination is beyond the remaining range.

Data comes from the **BYD Open Remote** companion app over a local, permission-guarded
`ContentProvider`. Nothing leaves the phone, and the companion is not required for Maps to work —
without it, the chip simply does not appear.

## Requirements

| Item | Requirement |
|---|---|
| Google Maps | **26.44.06.1006895251** (versionCode `1068856906`) — the patch is fingerprint-pinned |
| Companion | [BYD Open Remote](https://github.com/kennyric/byd-open-remote) **1.1.0** or newer |
| Root | not required |
| Google account | works with microG-RE as well as Play Services |

## Install

1. **Companion first.** Install `BYD-Open-Remote.apk` and sign in to your BYD account.
2. **Patch Maps.** In Morphe Manager, add this repository as a source (or import
   `patches-<version>.mpp` from Releases), select *BYD battery in the navigation card*, and patch
   your own copy of Maps 26.44.06. Keep the default *Change package name* option **on** — the
   integration targets `org.ungoogled.android.apps.maps`.
3. **Install the patched APK.** For Android Auto to list it, the installer should be recorded as
   the Play Store: `adb install -i com.android.vending -r maps-byd.apk`, or KingInstaller →
   *Install as king*. Most devices also accept a normal install.
4. **Re-read AA's app list** if the app is missing from *Customize launcher*: force-stop
   `com.google.android.projection.gearhead`, or unplug and replug.

The refresh interval is under **Maps → Settings → Customization → BYD battery refresh**
(Off / 10 / 15 / 30 / 60 minutes). Maps only asks the companion for fresher data while navigating,
and the companion enforces a five-minute floor, so the cloud is not polled in the background.

## What this repository does not contain

Google Maps. The patch applies to a copy of Maps **you already have**; no Google binary is
distributed here, and none should be.

## Licence

GPL-3.0, inherited from upstream. Sources for this fork are in this repository; upstream's are at
[nl-morphe-patches](https://gitlab.com/johninnld/nl-morphe-patches).

## Changes since v1.95.0

- fix(ci): ignore prerelease tags when resolving the stable version [skip ci] (`f7a0543e`)
- fix(byd): back off provider reads when the app is missing or silent (`a0aa1849`)
- chore: advertise v1.95.0 in the Morphe manifest [skip ci] (`ba0052a9`)
Dev pre-release: back off provider reads when byd-open-remote is missing (2 s probe -> refresh interval), plus the arrival-only badge and the BYD battery estimate switch.

Data comes from the **BYD Open Remote** companion app over a local, permission-guarded
`ContentProvider`. Nothing leaves the phone, and the companion is not required for Maps to work —
without it, the chip simply does not appear.

## Requirements

| Item | Requirement |
|---|---|
| Google Maps | **26.44.06.1006895251** (versionCode `1068856906`) — the patch is fingerprint-pinned |
| Companion | [BYD Open Remote](https://github.com/kennyric/byd-open-remote) **1.1.0** or newer |
| Root | not required |
| Google account | works with microG-RE as well as Play Services |

## Install

1. **Companion first.** Install `BYD-Open-Remote.apk` and sign in to your BYD account.
2. **Patch Maps.** In Morphe Manager, add this repository as a source (or import
   `patches-<version>.mpp` from Releases), select *BYD battery in the navigation card*, and patch
   your own copy of Maps 26.44.06. Keep the default *Change package name* option **on** — the
   integration targets `org.ungoogled.android.apps.maps`.
3. **Install the patched APK.** For Android Auto to list it, the installer should be recorded as
   the Play Store: `adb install -i com.android.vending -r maps-byd.apk`, or KingInstaller →
   *Install as king*. Most devices also accept a normal install.
4. **Re-read AA's app list** if the app is missing from *Customize launcher*: force-stop
   `com.google.android.projection.gearhead`, or unplug and replug.

The refresh interval is under **Maps → Settings → Customization → BYD battery refresh**
(Off / 10 / 15 / 30 / 60 minutes). Maps only asks the companion for fresher data while navigating,
and the companion enforces a five-minute floor, so the cloud is not polled in the background.

## What this repository does not contain

Google Maps. The patch applies to a copy of Maps **you already have**; no Google binary is
distributed here, and none should be.

# Richyss Patches 1.0.0

Bundle Morphe pour **Discord Android** qui ajoute le **Richyss Bridge**.

## Contenu

- `patches-1.0.0.mpp` — bundle de patches Morphe (patch « Richyss Bridge » + extension Java).
- `patches-list.json` — index lisible par les outils qui consomment la liste des patches.

## Patch inclus

**Richyss Bridge** : enregistre un `ContentProvider` exporté (`com.discord.richyss.bridge`)
dans le client Discord et initialise son stockage depuis `Application.onCreate()`.
Richyss l'utilise pour vérifier la présence du patch et remettre un payload de Rich Presence.
Aucun token, aucune session, aucun appel réseau.

## Installation

1. Installer [Morphe Manager](https://github.com/MorpheApp).
2. Ajouter la source `https://github.com/ClmentCch/Richees` dans Réglages → Sources.
3. Patcher `com.discord` avec le patch **Richyss Bridge**, puis installer l'APK patché.

## Vérifications

- `./gradlew :patches:build` → `patches-1.0.0.mpp` (extension `extensions/richyss.mpe` incluse).
- `./gradlew :extensions:richyss:test` → **18 tests, 0 échec** (protocole + stockage).
- Bundle non signé : le secret `MORPHE_SIGNING_KEY` n'est pas configuré.

## Limites

- Compatibilité déclarée **expérimentale pour toute version de Discord** : aucune matrice de
  versions n'a pu être validée dans l'environnement de build (APK Discord non disponible).
- Le bridge transporte et conserve le payload ; **l'affichage dans la carte d'activité de Discord**
  demande un patch d'affichage non inclus dans cette version.

# Richyss 1.0.0

Première version publique de **Richyss**, l'application Android native de Custom Rich Presence pour
Discord, accompagnée du bundle de patches Morphe publié sur la branche `main`.

## 📦 Contenu de la release

- `Richyss-1.0.0.apk` — APK release signé (clé `CN=Richyss`, RSA 4096), minifié par R8, **1,6 Mo**.

## ✅ Fonctionnalités

- **Home** : statut d'intégration Discord réel (PackageManager + interrogation du bridge), nombre de
  profils, profil actif, dernière remise, accès rapide aux profils récents, bouton *Créer un RPC*.
- **Mes profils** : créer, modifier, supprimer, dupliquer, activer/désactiver, importer/exporter et
  partager en JSON (SAF), stockage Room.
- **Éditeur RPC** : nom, icône, description, type d'activité, nom d'activité, textes principal et
  secondaire, grande/petite image depuis le téléphone, textes au survol, chrono début/fin,
  jusqu'à 2 boutons libellé + URL. Validation alignée sur le bridge (4096 octets, http(s), 2 boutons).
- **Aperçu live** : carte d'activité Discord recréée, images, textes, chrono vivant, boutons, et
  étiquette explicite « aperçu local » / « livré au bridge ».
- **Presets** : bibliothèque GitHub actualisable sans mise à jour de l'APK, cache local, repli
  intégré, catégories Gaming / Music / Programming / Social / Custom, favoris, import, copie
  éditable, partage JSON.
- **Patch Manager** : version Discord détectée, compatibilité, version et protocole du bridge,
  diagnostic brut, guide d'installation Morphe, envoi du profil actif au bridge.
- **Réglages** : français / anglais instantané, thème sombre/clair/système, dépôt GitHub des presets,
  gestion du stockage, version, vérification des mises à jour GitHub, à propos.

## 🧪 Vérifications effectuées

- `./gradlew :app:testDebugUnitTest` → **42 tests JVM, 0 échec** (JSON, validation, presets, bridge,
  durées, versions, traductions).
- `:app:assembleDebug` et `:app:assembleRelease` → succès.
- APK vérifié avec `apksigner verify --print-certs` (signature `CN=Richyss`), `aapt2 dump badging`
  (`com.richyss.app`, versionName `1.0.0`, targetSdk 36) et inspection du contenu (assets presets
  présents).
- Bundle de patches : `./gradlew :patches:build` → `patches-1.0.0.mpp`, et
  `:extensions:richyss:test` → **12 tests, 0 échec**.

## ⚠️ Limitations

- L'APK **n'a pas été exécuté** sur un appareil ou un émulateur dans l'environnement de build :
  l'interface compile et est couverte par des tests unitaires, mais n'a pas été inspectée
  visuellement.
- **Discord n'affiche pas encore** le payload remis au bridge : le patch d'affichage nécessite des
  fingerprints des classes obfusquées de Discord, non développés ni vérifiés ici. Richyss affiche
  donc « livré au bridge », jamais « publié sur Discord ».
- Les patches Discord sont déclarés **expérimentaux pour toute version** ; aucune matrice de
  versions Discord n'a été validée.
- Aucun token Discord n'est demandé, stocké ou utilisé ; aucun self-bot.

## 📱 Compatibilité Android

- Minimum : **Android 8.0 (API 26)**
- Cible : **API 36**
- ABI : universel (aucune bibliothèque native)
- Permissions : `INTERNET`, `ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE`

# Emisión en segundo plano · 0.3.0-beta.1

Añade un servicio visible de conexión a TV para mantener el motor, el puente y la sesión al bloquear la pantalla o cambiar de app. Se activa únicamente al elegir receptor y muestra una notificación con **Dejar de emitir**. Incluye Google Cast y DLNA/LG.

Protege onPause/onResume únicamente mientras esa Activity emite, sin omitir las llamadas a super. Mantiene CPU y red durante la sesión y libera los recursos al detener, terminar o desconectar; un cierre antiguo no puede detener una emisión nueva. Conserva los cuatro parches y la reparación del servicio DLNA.

Instala el MPP como fuente local y parte del APK/XAPK original completo 4.0.2 con los cuatro parches. Si Android lo solicita, permite notificaciones. Prueba cambiando de app y después bloqueando la pantalla, al menos dos minutos en cada situación; comprueba también que al detener desaparece la notificación.

**Pendiente de prueba física**: no hay móvil conectado y el usuario probará después. Se verifica compilación, manifiesto, DEX y propiedad/cierre de sesión; no se afirma que la pantalla apagada esté ya validada. La estable principal permanece en **0.2.1**.

Instrucciones y límites completos en CAST_PREVIEW.md.

# Versión estable 0.2.1

- Repara la detección DLNA: declara el servicio `DLNACastService` que utiliza la lista de televisores y faltaba en el manifiesto original. La LG 43UK6300PLB con webOS responde y aparece tras la corrección.
- Pausa el reproductor local durante el traspaso a Google Cast, en lugar de liberarlo. La semántica del método se verifica al parchear.
- Amplía el diagnóstico con estado y cierre de la sesión, errores de lectura/escritura y conexiones que no completan una petición. El contador anterior no permitía atribuir los fallos a microcortes.

Validación: actualización instalada con la firma de Morphe, usuario confirma vídeo en la LG y consultas AVTransport muestran reproducción y avance continuo durante más de dos minutos. Prueba de streaming del puente: 42 segundos, 15 listas y 15 fragmentos nuevos. Verificación de APK ARM64 y servicio DLNA interno registrado. El test del manifiesto falla con la 0.2.0 y pasa con la corrección.

La Grundig Android TV no estaba disponible: sigue pendiente comprobar el corte intermitente de Google Cast en ese dispositivo. Esta versión no afirma que ese corte esté ya resuelto.

Actualiza la fuente `adriviciano/morphe-patch-lunar-edge` en Morphe y parte del APK/XAPK original completo de Lunar Edge 4.0.2 con los cuatro parches seleccionados. Desactiva las fuentes beta locales para usar el paquete principal. Se conservan los datos al actualizar con la misma firma de Morphe.

# Prueba de corte Cast: 0.2.1-beta.1

Corrige el traspaso al receptor: pausa el reproductor local en lugar de liberarlo. En la APK 4.0.2, O llama a R y destruye el reproductor; L pausa sin destruirlo. El parche verifica la función original antes de aplicarse.

Añade diagnóstico de estado de sesión y motivo de cierre, y distingue errores al leer del motor, escribir a la TV y conexiones sin petición completa. No modifica timeouts, heartbeat ni el comportamiento del puente HLS. El contador antiguo de fallos no bastaba para atribuir las interrupciones a la red.

Una prueba de 42 segundos verifica que el puente obtiene listas actualizadas y fragmentos nuevos, sin limitarse al contenido cargado inicialmente. La prueba del traspaso detecta la liberación anterior y pasa con la pausa.

Descarga el MPP, añádelo como fuente local y parte del APK/XAPK original completo 4.0.2 con los cuatro parches seleccionados. Emite el mismo vídeo al menos dos minutos con pantalla encendida y app abierta. Si falla, copia el informe desde Diagnóstico de carga. Instrucciones en CAST_PREVIEW.md.

La estable permanece en 0.2.0. Falta validar reproducción prolongada en la TV real; este cambio no se presenta como solución ya confirmada del corte.

No YouTube, X or Instagram APKs are distributed.

## What changed

- **A bare name means the closest works.** "Minecraft" is the game, "Half-Life" the 1998 game, "Assassin's Creed" the 2007 game and the 2016 film. Sequels and spin-offs are named by their own titles; a type word narrows it ("the Minecraft movie"). Franchise names such as "Halo" and "Star Wars" still take their series.
- **"More from this series" in the picker.** The catalog now records which series each work belongs to (from Wikidata), so "Which have you seen?" can list the rest of a franchise: all 42 Resident Evil works, 13 Silent Hill, 9 God of War.
- **"Show once" stays shown.** It is remembered for the post, not for the view that draws it, so a ticking like counter or a late picture verdict no longer covers the post again.
- **Fewer false covers:** everyday words beside a title that is already matched ("No Damage" in a Devil May Cry video), music titles ("ft.", "official video"), a hashtag alone, and numbers in a video's duration no longer match.
- **Better recall:** plain sentences about well-known multi-word titles ("Resident Evil is scary", "Dark Souls is hard") match again, and "Battlefield Games" style titles match the series.
- **Android**
  - The video being watched on YouTube is no longer blacked out or muted when a covered row scrolls under the player.
  - Covers only draw and take taps where their row is visible.
  - YouTube's duration, view-count and button text is removed before matching.

## Known limits

- Some franchise names resolve oddly: "Call of Duty" means only the 2003 game, "Pokémon" only the 1997 anime, "Harry Potter" the books and the 2026 series but not the films.
- The picker does not open for a name that means a single work, so the series list is not offered there.
- Some well-known titles still need a media word nearby ("The Ring", "The Office", "Metal Gear", "Knives Out").
- A game or film is not identified from footage or pictures that carry no text.
- YouTube comments on Android are not covered.
- "Show once" on Android and the YouTube player fix were verified in the demo and on a logged-out emulator, not in X or on a phone.

## What changed

- **Fewer false covers.** Text read from thumbnails is weak evidence now: only clear multi-word titles match from it, so logos, numbers and shouted words ("GEN 5", "ARGO", "NO INTRO") no longer cover a video. In all-caps and headline-case titles a capital letter proves nothing for everyday words. Everyday-word lists for Turkish, Spanish, Portuguese, German, French and Italian. Contests, award shows and variety shows left the catalog (24,609 works).
- **Text beats pictures.** The image model only speaks for pictures that no text identifies, and a post whose own text names something you have seen is not covered because of its picture. The cover's label names the work from the post's own text first.
- **"Which have you seen?"** When a name covers several works (a franchise, or an original and its remake), "I've seen it" opens a picker instead of marking all of them.
- **Android**
  - Covers and loading shades take their colour from the app's own background, not the system setting.
  - Models load when the app opens and verdicts are kept between restarts.
  - Library multi-select.
  - Quoted posts on X are read.
  - Videos inside a post are sampled every 5 seconds.
  - A touch fix for cover buttons in Instagram Reels (from reading the APK; not confirmed in Instagram).
- **Browser:** the cover's colour follows pages that declare a dark scheme only through a meta tag.

## Known limits

- Titles that are everyday words with no media word nearby are not matched ("Dune Was Incredible").
- A thumbnail that shows a single word is not matched from the picture alone.
- A few everyday words missing from the word lists still cause false covers (Vertigo, Scrubs).
- Naming a game or film from footage with no text is still weak.
- YouTube comments on Android are not covered.
- The X quote hook depends on an internal name of X 12.19.1 and fails quietly on other versions.

## What changed

The image title model now keeps its weights in full precision in memory instead of restoring them on every run. Its scores are identical (a difference of 0 on the 87 fixture images in Chrome and Firefox).

| | 0.2.0 | 0.2.1 |
|---|---|---|
| Chrome, one image alone | 403 ms | 175 ms |
| Chrome, per image in a screenful | 203 ms | 171 ms |
| Firefox, one image alone | 629 ms | 448 ms |
| Firefox, per image in a screenful | 502 ms | 426 ms |
| Chrome extension process memory | 481 MB | 991 MB |

The cost is memory: the extension process is now about 1 GB while image scanning is on. Firefox memory was not re-measured.

Native AirPlay integration for the original YouTube 21.30.216 APK (`com.google.android.youtube`), applied in one run alongside the official Morphe YouTube patches, including Spoof video streams.

Fixes:
- Declares the original input package instead of the post-patch Morphe package.
- Applies playback hooks after all selected patches have executed, preserving shared mutable method objects used by other patch finalizers.
- Uses the timestamp format accepted by Morphe source metadata.
- Provides English package information and documentation.

Includes native playback controls, receiver volume, thumbnail display, autoplay and local playback recovery. Seeking may reopen the receiver session. Tested receiver: Hisense 50A6NU. Additional YouTube versions will be supported after their adaptations are completed and tested.

Keep your signing keystore in Morphe to retain APK update compatibility.

# v0.4.4 ? Preserve article-site preferences ON by default

**Hatena Bookmark 5.80 (58000) only.**

The `preserveArticleWebStorage` boolean option under **Preserve article WebView cookies and storage** is now **ON by default**. It was OFF by default in v0.4.3. The owner chose the new default to avoid a confusing extra opt-in.

When enabled, the existing patch suppresses two automatic cleanup calls: `WebViewActivity.onDestroy` clearing all WebView cookies, and `BookmarkApplication.onCreate` starting the WebStorage-clearing thread. The patch code, DEX guards, and behavior of manual data clearing and logout are **unchanged**. Setting the option to OFF restores the original automatic cleanup behavior.

**Privacy implication:** this applies to every article website, not only NHK. Cookies, site preferences, login sessions and tracking data can persist when the option is ON. Users preferring automatic cleanup should disable `preserveArticleWebStorage` explicitly.

Build-generated `patches-list.json` advertises `default: true`. Other patches (native PR hiding, ranking hiding, clone install and in-app ad blocking) are unchanged. NHK-specific end-to-end confirmation remains the owner's real-device validation; v0.4.3 already verified the underlying OFF/ON cookie and WebStorage behavior using an emulator test page.

# v0.4.3 — Opt-in preservation of article-site preferences

Hatena Bookmark **5.80 / versionCode 58000 only**.

Adds a fifth Morphe patch, **Preserve article WebView cookies and storage**. Its `preserveArticleWebStorage` boolean option is **OFF by default**. Enabling it stops the original app from automatically erasing all WebView cookies on article `WebViewActivity.onDestroy()` and from starting the one-purpose WebStorage-clearing thread in `BookmarkApplication.onCreate()`.

This retains **all article sites' cookies and JavaScript storage**, not NHK alone. Login sessions and tracking data may persist longer. Explicit logout and manually requested data clearing are not intercepted or altered. Existing native PR hiding, ranking suppression, side-by-side clone, and article advertising rules are unchanged.

## Why

The owner reproduced this on a real device: after completing the NHK ONE usage and region selection and displaying an article, closing and reopening the article displays the selection again. Original Hatena 5.80 DEX confirms an unconditional `removeAllCookies(null)` on article close and `WebStorage.deleteAllData()` at app startup. This patch does not click, submit, or synthesize any NHK preference or consent value.

## Scope and safety

Two guarded DEX call-site changes only, performed **when the option is true**:
- `WebViewActivity.onDestroy()`: original `registerCount=4`, `insns_size=39`, expected `WebViewViewModel.clearWebViewCookie()V` at code-unit offset `0x23`.
- `BookmarkApplication.onCreate()`: original `registerCount=5`, `insns_size=170`, expected `Thread.start()V` at `0x60`, where the thread's sole runnable calls `WebStorage.deleteAllData()`.

Each target instruction is replaced with `nop`; all other original instructions remain. The patch refuses changed call sites or method layouts. With the option OFF, neither method is touched. The pre-existing regular cache cleanup in `onDestroy` stays intact, as do all direct logout and data-clear APIs.

## Testing and remaining confirmation

- Android DEX bundle **built successfully** and all **five patches applied successfully** to the original 5.80 APK for both OFF and ON. Signed test APKs passed v2/v3 signature verification. DEX inspection confirmed that ON replaces only the two expected destructive invokes with `nop` (`onDestroy` 39→37 code units, `onCreate` 170→168); OFF retains the original calls.
- API 36 / WebView 133 emulator, ordinary HTTP test page with persistent cookie and localStorage: the initial seed reported `SEED_COOKIE_OK_STORAGE_OK` for both options. On article close/reopen, OFF displayed `CHECK_COOKIE_MISSING_STORAGE_PRESENT`, ON displayed `CHECK_COOKIE_PRESENT_STORAGE_PRESENT`.
- Following app process force-stop/restart without closing the article, OFF displayed `CHECK_COOKIE_PRESENT_STORAGE_MISSING`, ON displayed `CHECK_COOKIE_PRESENT_STORAGE_PRESENT`. This independently verifies the startup WebStorage deletion toggle. The OFF cookie can survive force-stop when the article's onDestroy has not run; that is expected and does not contradict the close test.
- Existing ad-block, ranking and native PR patches applied with no failures. Focused regression suite and release validator passed.
- **Final NHK ONE selection preservation must be confirmed by the owner on a real device**; a full NHK selection flow could not be reproduced in the emulator.
- See [investigation and design](NHK_ONE_CONSENT_PERSISTENCE_RESEARCH_DESIGN.md).

Do not enable this option if you expect all sites' cookies and web storage to be removed automatically when the article closes.

# futatabi v0.3.0 — 書き込み・ログイン対応

**対象：ふたったー 3.1.1（versionCode 65）のみ。** Morphe向けパッチバンドル（.mpp）を配布します。改変済み第三者APKは配布しません。

## 新機能

- **あいもげ書き込み対応**：公式PKCEアプリ承認によるログイン導線、新規スレ立て・返信、画像添付（presignで取得したURLへのPUT）、投稿ごとの削除キーと投稿履歴の管理。資格情報・削除キーは端末内のアプリ専用領域へ保存し、Flutterの `kakikomiData` には入れません。期限切れ時の再認証には利用者の操作が必要です。
- **あにまん読み取り＋書き込み対応**：独自の読み取りアダプタと、投稿前チェック `comment.php?preCheck` → 本投稿 `comment.php` → 画像添付 `upload/` の3段階処理に対応。公開HTMLと `main.js` を参考に独自実装しています。
- **拡張ホーム画面**：ランチャーアイコンから独立して起動できます。板別の投稿画面、返信先スレ選択、ログイン・ログアウト導線、投稿履歴を追加しました。
- **めぶきは未対応**。次期 **v0.4.0** での対応を予定しています。

既存の **Block banner ads**、**Clone app**、**Local board bridge** は引き続き既定ONです。素のふたったーの通常のふたば板への投稿処理は変更しません。

## 検証の範囲

**ローカルフィクスチャでのエミュレータE2EはPASS済み**です。認証トークン保護、模擬PKCE開始・callback・code交換、あいもげ新規スレ／返信／画像のpresign→PUT、あにまんの投稿3段階、拡張UIからの返信成功表示を確認しました。使用したコード・トークン・画像投稿先はすべてローカルの模擬環境です。

**実サイトでのログイン・投稿・画像アップロード、および所有者の実機での最終確認は未実施です。** リリースは実サイトでの成功を保証しません。検証結果は [E2E実測報告書](https://github.com/rikunode/futatabi/blob/main/docs/write-flow-v03-e2e-observation-20261123.md) に記録しています。

## インストール上の注意

- **ふたったー3.1.1 XAPKの必要なスプリットを単一APKへマージ**し、そのAPKにMorpheでパッチを適用してください。ベースAPK単体には適用しないでください。
- クローン不要なら適用時に **Clone app** をOFFにできます。クローンの既定パッケージ名は `com.Nanasaki.ftutter.morphe` です。
- 署名やパッケージ名が異なるAPKへの入れ替え・アンインストールにより、既存データが消える場合があります。必要なデータは事前にバックアップしてください。
- 添付した `SHA256SUMS` と配布 `.mpp` のSHA-256を照合してください。

本リポジトリはGPL-3.0。Clone appのMorphe公式由来コードに関する著作権表記・ReVanced由来表記・GPL第7条の追加表示は維持しています。

# futatabi v0.2.0 — あいもげ Bridge搭載

**対象：ふたったー3.1.1（versionCode 65）のみ。** 配布内容はMorphe用パッチバンドル（.mpp）であり、改変済み第三者APKは配布しません。

## 変更点

- **Local board bridge（新規・既定ON）**：非公開ContentProviderを使ってアプリ内の `127.0.0.1:18765` で読み取り専用HTTPサーバーを起動。bind失敗時はBridgeだけ停止して元アプリを起動可能にする設計
- Flutter SharedPreferencesの`flutter.itaList`に**あいもげ**を自動追加。既定板や既存登録は維持し、再起動時の重複を防止
- `api.nijiurachan.net` の公開API（`X-Api-Version: 2026-11-11`）からカタログ・スレ・添付画像を取得し、ふたば形式のShift_JIS HTMLへ安全に変換。長い数字の仮想IDとJPEGサムネイルに対応
- 元画像が動画のときは公式サムネイルを静止画として表示。画像の取得先を制限し、キャッシュ・取得間隔・最大レスポンスサイズを設定
- POSTはHTTP 403、掲示板への投稿や認証処理は実装しない
- **Block banner ads** と **Clone app** は引き続き既定ON。クローンの初期パッケージ名は `com.Nanasaki.ftutter.morphe`

**あにまん対応は次版以降へ延期。** 今回は未実装のため新規ユーザーに自動登録しません。めぶきも無効の受け口のみです。

## 適用方法と注意

- 正確なふたったー3.1.1 XAPKを**必要なスプリット込みの単一APKへマージしてから**Morpheでパッチを適用してください。ベースAPK単体への適用では正常に起動できません。
- クローンが不要ならMorpheのパッチ一覧で **Clone app** をOFFにしてください（CLI: `--disable="Clone app"`）。
- パッケージ名変更や署名鍵の変更により、既存APKへ上書きインストールできない場合があります。アプリ削除時にはそのアプリのデータが消えるため、必要なデータを事前にバックアップしてください。
- 公開されている `SHA256SUMS` とダウンロードした `.mpp` のSHA-256を照合してください。

## 検証

[Androidエミュレータ統合試験の実測報告](https://github.com/rikunode/futatabi/blob/main/docs/bridge-v0.2.0-emulator-gate-20261122.md)

**PASS：** 照合済みXAPKのマージ、3パッチ同時適用・再ビルド、開発署名APKの署名検証（v1/v2/v3）、クローンと元アプリ共存、Providerと18765番待受、板自動登録と永続化・冪等性、あいもげの実APIカタログ・スレ本文・JPEG画像表示、動画添付の静止画プレビュー、POST 403。

**未検証：** 所有者実機でのインストール、バナー非表示の視覚確認、リワード広告による24時間非表示の導線。エミュレータのPASSを実機確認済みとは表現しません。

本ソースはGPL-3.0。Clone app由来の[Morphe公式実装](https://github.com/MorpheApp/morphe-patches/blob/main/patches/src/main/kotlin/app/morphe/patches/all/misc/clone/CloneAppPatch.kt)の著作権・ReVanced由来・GPL第7条の追加表示は保持しています。

# futatabi v0.1.0 — Clone app + banner blocking

**For futatter 3.1.1 only** (`com.Nanasaki.ftutter`, versionCode 65).

This release contains a **Morphe patch bundle (.mpp), not a patched APK**. Use a merged APK of the original split-XAPK release with a compatible Morphe patcher.

Included patches (both **enabled by default**):

- **Block banner ads** — intercepts the two `google_mobile_ads` banner-load methods; does not intentionally change rewarded/interstitial/native/app-open ad code.
- **Clone app** — adapted from Morphe's official Clone app patch, changing the default package name to `com.Nanasaki.ftutter.morphe` for side-by-side installation. Its `updatePermissions` and `updateProviders` options default to true. Cloning is not guaranteed to work with every app.

**Disable cloning** in Morphe by deselecting **Clone app**, or pass `--disable="Clone app"` to Morphe Desktop. The `packageName` option supports an alternate clone identity. Never overwrite an existing installation expecting to preserve data; changes to package identity or signing keys can require uninstalling and will lose that package's app data.

**Verification**: the exact target XAPK and base APK matched the documented SHA-256 hashes. Both patches applied to the **unmerged base APK** with `--unsigned`; patching/rebuilding succeeded and AAPT reported `com.Nanasaki.ftutter.morphe`, with all four provider authorities renamed under the cloned prefix. The patched DEX retained the banner guard and the original rewarded dispatcher. **Signing, installation, real banner removal, rewarded-ad functionality, and clone coexistence remain unverified.** The owner will carry out physical-device checks.

**Bridge status**: NOT included. The Android emulator gate on unmodified futatter failed at adding the localhost board; future ContentProvider/adapters must not proceed without a passing gate. The eventual bridge authority must be based on the active package name to coexist with cloning; runtime interaction has not been tested.

**Upstream license**: Clone app is a derivative of [MorpheApp/morphe-patches](https://github.com/MorpheApp/morphe-patches/blob/main/patches/src/main/kotlin/app/morphe/patches/all/misc/clone/CloneAppPatch.kt), itself derived from ReVanced. GPL-3.0 and the original upstream copyright/Section 7 attribution block are preserved in source. See [README](https://github.com/rikunode/futatabi/blob/main/README.md).

**Verify the bundle before using**: download `SHA256SUMS` alongside the `.mpp` and compare SHA-256.

## Changes

- Add Apple Music 7.0.2 (build 1624) support to **Browse artist albums in Android Auto**.
- Keep the Pixel Camera Immich patch in the same bundle.
- Update the README with both patches and supported Apple Music versions.

## Overview

Gboard Pro **v2.1.1** is a critical update that restores all signature Gboard Pro custom features, introduces a brand-new **Liquid Glass Default App & Package Icon**, and implements full, native **Edge-to-Edge Display Support** across all settings screens and activities.

---

## What's Changed

### 🎨 Brand-New Liquid Glass Default Icon
* **Native Liquid Glass App Icon**: Replaced default legacy icons with the user-selected high-definition Liquid Glass Gboard Pro emblem.
* **Full Multi-Density Support**: Generated crisp, optimized icon assets across all screen densities (`mdpi`, `hdpi`, `xhdpi`, `xxhdpi`, `xxxhdpi`) for both legacy launchers (`ic_app.png`, `ic_app_round.png`) and modern adaptive icon systems (`mipmap_0x7f110002.webp`).
* **Package Icon Integration**: Integrated seamlessly across app launcher, system settings, recents screen, and notification shades.

### 📱 Full Native Edge-to-Edge Support
* **Immersive System Bar Drawing**: Enabled `setDecorFitsSystemWindows(false)` on Android 11+ (API 30+) with fully transparent status bar and navigation bar.
* **Cutout & Notch Compatibility**: Configured `LAYOUT_IN_DISPLAY_CUTOUT_MODE_SHORT_EDGES` for display notches and punch-holes on Android 9+ (API 28+).
* **Smart Inset Padding**: Attached dynamic `OnApplyWindowInsetsListener` to content views to prevent any overlap or clipping with gesture bars, navigation buttons, or camera cutouts.
* **Disabled Contrast Enforcing**: Set `setStatusBarContrastEnforced(false)` and `setNavigationBarContrastEnforced(false)` on Android 10+ (API 29+) to guarantee pure edge-to-edge aesthetics without Android scrim tinting.

### 🔄 Restored Gboard Pro Exclusive Features
* **Material 3 Expressive Themes**:
  * **Blush Lilac**: Signature soft lavender and petal pink pastel palette.
  * **Cotton Candy**: Playful sky blue and pastel magenta palette.
  * **Sunset Peach**: Warm apricot, coral, and terracotta palette.
  * **Fresh Mint**: Refreshing sage, crisp mint, and pine teal palette.
  * **AMOLED Pure Black**: True black `#000000` surface and key background for maximum battery savings on OLED displays.
* **Extended 24-Hour Clipboard Retention**:
  * Unpinned clips retained for up to 24 hours (bypassing Google's 1-hour auto-deletion).
  * 100 recent clip cap with discrete slider selector (1h, 2h, 3h, 6h, 12h, 18h, 24h).
* **Material 3 Expressive About Screen & Live Updater**:
  * Real-time Mbps download speed gauge and update progress indicator.
  * Seamless background checking against `smartworldarafath/Gboard_Pro`.
* **High Refresh Rate & Smooth Transitions**: Enforces 120Hz/144Hz IME window refresh rate for stutter-free fluid typing.

### ⚡ Upstream PixelBoard 1.3.6 Enhancements
* **Candidate Strip Emoji Slot Placement**: Places emoji candidates on the right side of the candidate strip, reserving center slots for speech and predictive completions.
* **Safe Keypress & Cursor Drag Haptic Feedback**: Explicitly passes `FLAG_IGNORE_GLOBAL_SETTING` to guarantee tactile feedback on Honor MagicOS, Huawei EMUI, and devices with system vibration disabled.
* **Screen Rotation Grace Period for Rambler Dictation**: 2500ms grace window with display rotation listener prevents voice session drops during screen rotations and foldable unfolding.
* **Speech Diff Preservation & Microsoft Office Sync**: Retains speech diffs for voice replacements and avoids cursor desynchronization in Microsoft Word/Office apps.
* **Header Minimize Key Positioning**: Places Rambler minimize key next to the close button on the left header position.

1. Download `Gboard_Pro.apk` from the Assets section below.
2. Install directly on your device (Android 10+ supported; no root required).
3. If upgrading from earlier versions, install directly over your existing installation to preserve all custom settings, dictionary data, and clipboard items.
4. Enable **Gboard Pro** in **Settings > System > Languages & input > On-screen keyboard**.

# Gboard Pro v2.1.0

## Summary
Gboard Pro v2.1.0 incorporates the latest upstream PixelBoard v1.3.6 features and enhancements while preserving every Gboard Pro customization, including Material 3 Expressive theme palettes (Blush Lilac, Cotton Candy, Sunset Peach, Fresh Mint), AMOLED Pure Black keyboard styling, the 24-hour extended clipboard with 100-item cap, and the background update system. This release introduces candidate strip emoji slot positioning, safe keypress haptic feedback bypassing OEM vibration restrictions, extended screen rotation grace periods for Rambler voice dictation, speech diff preservation with dedicated Microsoft Word/Office desynchronization protection, launcher icon visibility toggling across all devices, and lowered minimum SDK requirements supporting Android 10 and Android 11.

---

## What's New in v2.1.0

- **Candidate Strip Emoji Slot Placement**: Repositions suggested emoji candidates onto the right side (Slot 2 for a standard 3-slot strip), ensuring raw verbatim text and predictive autocompletions occupy the left and center slots for seamless typing flow.
- **Safe Keypress & Cursor Drag Haptic Feedback**: Explicitly passes `FLAG_IGNORE_GLOBAL_SETTING` (0x1) during keypress and text handle drag haptic feedback, guaranteeing tactile feedback on Honor MagicOS, Huawei EMUI, and devices where system-wide vibration is disabled.
- **Extended Screen Rotation Grace Window for Voice Dictation**: Increases orientation change grace period to 2500ms with a 1000ms baseline delay and tracks display rotation, keeping Rambler voice typing and audio recording active across device flips and folds.
- **Speech Diff Preservation & Microsoft Word / Office Fix**: Retains speech diffs for voice replacements and mid-sentence voice commands, while automatically detecting Microsoft Word and Office apps to prevent cursor desynchronization to (0, 0).
- **Header Minimize Key Positioning**: Places the Rambler minimize key next to the close key on the left side of the header (`key_pos_header_start_extra_key`) with end slot fallback, keeping both Close and Minimize easily accessible.
- **Rambler Stock Policy & Cursor Awareness**: Enforces `jetson_enable_cursor_awareness` in stock phenotype policy for improved voice editing precision and synchronization.
- **AI Writing Tools Connectivity & Limit Enforcement**: Enforces a 2000-word input limit for Proofread and Rewrite, updates candidate threshold to 0.0, enables the proofread supported apps allowlist, and forces v2 landscape layout.
- **Android 10+ (API 29) Minimum SDK Compatibility**: Lowers `minSdkVersion` to API 29, resolving package parser errors and enabling installation on Android 10 and Android 11 devices.
- **Show in App List Unlocked**: Removes Android 10+ OEM restriction locks on the launcher icon toggle, allowing the app icon to be hidden or shown directly in Preferences on all devices.

---

## Preserved Gboard Pro Features

- **Pro Customization Hub**: Dedicated Pro settings screen grouping Appearance, Board UI, and Advanced Settings.
- **Material 3 Dynamic Appearance Palettes**: Complete UI theme support for Blush Lilac (signature light pink showcase look), Cotton Candy, Sunset Peach, Fresh Mint, and Default (System Dynamic).
- **Board UI AMOLED Pure Black**: Dedicated deep pure-black keyboard styling for OLED displays.
- **24-Hour Default Clipboard Retention**: Extended unpinned clipboard retention to 24 hours, raised history limit to 100 clips, discrete slider (1h, 24h, 7d, 30d, Never), and localized pin tips across 83 languages.
- **Material 3 Expressive About & Updater**: Automated 8-hour background update checks, push notification alerts for new versions, live Mbps download speed meter, and direct APK installation.
- **Personal Dictionary**: Seamless integration with user dictionaries and custom shortcuts.

# Gboard Pro v2.0.7

## Summary
Gboard Pro v2.0.7 integrates the latest upstream PixelBoard v1.3.5 stability and server connectivity improvements while preserving every existing Gboard Pro customization, Material 3 Expressive theme palette, AMOLED Pure Black keyboard styling, and background updater system. This release repairs AI Writing Tools server connectivity to eliminate "cannot connect to server" errors, enforces the reliable Gboard Server backend, hardens Direct Boot preference storage against cold boot crashes, refines voice dictation anti-drift logic, and incorporates new interactive UI row components and changelog section styling.

---

## What's New in v2.0.7

- **AI Writing Tools Server Connection Repair**: Enforced the reliable Google Server backend, eliminated timeout and template evaluation failures, and removed "cannot connect to server" errors for Rephrase, Proofreading, and Tone adjustments.
- **Direct Boot & Secure Storage Safety**: Added full user-unlock verification (`UserManager.isUserUnlocked`) and commit-level persistence to prevent crashes and ensure clean flag initialization during cold device reboots before first unlock.
- **Refined V2 Flag Isolation**: Replaced broad wildcard flag matching with an exact V2 flag registry, preventing accidental suppression of stable Writing Tools V1 features.
- **Voice Dictation Speech Diff Preservation**: Preserves speech diffs for voice replacements, word edits in respoken phrases, and mid-sentence cursor placements without overwriting surrounding compositions.
- **Strict Language Policy & Anti-Drift**: Disabled proactive parallel ASR and seamless fallback in Rambler dictation policy to prevent accidental language drift during continuous voice typing.
- **Screen Rotation Grace Window**: 1.5-second grace period across display orientation and size changes, preventing Rambler voice typing sessions from aborting on rotation.
- **Interactive UI Components**: Added support for primary action buttons with animated sync spinners, row badges, and structured changelog section styles in settings.
- **24-Hour Default Clipboard Retention**: Extended unpinned clipboard retention to 24 hours, raised history limit to 100 clips, and preserved localized pin tips across 83 languages.

---

## Preserved Gboard Pro Features

- **Pro Customization Hub**: Top-level Pro screen grouping Appearance, Board UI, and Advanced Settings.
- **Material 3 Dynamic Appearance Palettes**: Complete UI theme support for Blush Lilac (signature light pink showcase look), Cotton Candy, Sunset Peach, Fresh Mint, and Default (System Dynamic).
- **Board UI AMOLED Pure Black**: Dedicated deep pure-black keyboard styling for OLED displays.
- **Material 3 Expressive About & Updater**: Automated 8-hour background update checks, push notification alerts for new versions, live Mbps download speed meter, and direct APK installation.
- **Personal Dictionary**: Seamless integration with user dictionaries and custom shortcuts.

## TikTok Lite 47.8.15

Versión preliminar para `com.zhiliaoapp.musically.go` (470815). Probada con los APK divididos ARM64 de Google Play en un Galaxy A36.

### Cambios desde dev.3

- **Feed** · El filtro cubre dos adaptadores de respuesta y usa las señales del modelo de anuncios. El panel registra cuántas entradas se filtran durante la sesión.
- **Descargas** · El interruptor permite volver al comportamiento original. Con la opción activada, el parche prefiere la fuente de reproducción para las descargas permitidas y conserva la selección original si no hay una fuente limpia disponible.
- **Ajustes del mod** · Pantalla propia con tarjetas de Feed, Descargas y Acerca de, interruptores persistentes y acento rosa de TikTok Lite. Al abrirla desde Ajustes y privacidad adopta el tema de esa pantalla.
- **Accesos** · Tarjeta para abrir el panel desde Ajustes y privacidad, con texto centrado en mayúsculas y negrita. El bundle también incorpora el registro de un acceso rápido en el icono de Android, aún pendiente de validar en el Galaxy.
- **Idiomas** · Sigue la selección de TikTok Lite. Incluye español, inglés, portugués, francés, alemán, italiano, indonesio y japonés, con inglés como respaldo. Se comprobó el cambio entre español e inglés en el dispositivo.
- **Acerca de** · Diálogo con avatar de GitHub, nombre del creador, versión del parche, enlace al proyecto y botón de cierre. En la cuenta de prueba sin iniciar sesión, se verificó que el bloque nativo de Acerca de y sus filas desaparecen de Ajustes y privacidad.
- **Catálogo de Morphe** · Se añade `Open mod settings from profile` como tercer parche del bundle.

### Instalación y pruebas

Aplica `Hide feed ads` a `base.apk`. En otra ejecución aplica `Prefer clean source for video downloads` y `Open mod settings from profile` a `split_df_edit_filter.apk`. Ambos parches del split utilizan la extensión instalada en el APK base. La instalación dividida con Morphe Desktop y ADB es el flujo de pruebas. La instalación completa desde Morphe Manager en una sola operación sigue pendiente.

- **Material 3 Expressive navbar & mini-player:** Split-pill floating dock (`64dp`) with detached circular Search button, progressive backdrop blur, spring physics, and a separate floating mini-player card with swipe-to-skip and pull-up-to-open gestures.

- **Track swipe gestures:** Spring-back swipe gestures across all TIDAL track list binders (`Add to Queue`, `Play Next`, `Toggle Favorite`, `Add to Playlist`, configurable threshold and haptics).
- **Linn Majik DSM Wi-Fi playback *(optional, off by default)*:** Local Wi-Fi OpenHome SSDP discovery inside TIDAL's Devices sheet and Lossless / 24-bit/192 kHz Hi-Res FLAC playback with lossless DASH-FLAC remuxing, queue, hardware volume, and lockscreen controls.

# Changelog

## v0.1.0 (2026-11-22)

Initial standalone Morphe patch bundle for **YouTube `21.46.523`** (`com.google.android.youtube`, versionCode `1561314016`).

### Added

- `Disable Firebase Analytics collection`: disables `Laldk;->a()V` collection toggler and strips `AD_ID`, `AD_ID_NOTIFICATION`, `ACCESS_ADSERVICES_AD_ID`, `ACCESS_ADSERVICES_ATTRIBUTION` permissions from `AndroidManifest.xml`.
- `Bypass consent dialog delay`: skips OneTrust/GDPR consent WebView (`Lvdq;->onUserConsent`) initialization at startup.
- `Allow screenshots and screen recording`: clears `FLAG_SECURE` on player `SurfaceView` (`Laqbl;-><init>` calls `SurfaceView.setSecure(true)`).
- `Disable haptic feedback`: returns `false` from haptic feedback perform calls.
- `Force default playback speed`: hooks `PlaybackSpeedController` to persist speed preference.
- `Bypass forced app update`: returns early from `NewVersionAvailableActivity.onCreate` before `setContentView`.
- `Hide Shorts components`: hooks `ShortsController` to hide shelf/tab/button.

### Technical

- Built with morphe-patcher 2.4.0
- Compatible with Morphe Manager 2.6.0+
- Includes both v2/v3 and v3.1 certificate signatures
- Bundle includes `classes.dex` for Android compatibility via `buildAndroid`
- Custom Innertube endpoint documented via PPG enum (`http://127.0.0.1:8787`)

### Gboard Enhancement Patches Suite

A Morphe/ReVanced bytecode and resource patch suite for Gboard
(`com.google.android.inputmethod.latin`). 89 patches are bundled and every one of
them can be selected on its own or combined in Morphe Manager.

#### ✨ Typing, gestures and input
- **Per-app profiles**: incognito, no suggestions, toolbar order and theme or keyboard
  height per app, with a session override for the app in focus.
- **Swipe Left to Delete**: sliding left anywhere on the keyboard acts as backspace;
  keep holding to delete whole words.
- **Smart bar case swipe**: swipe a suggested word up to capitalize it, down to lowercase it.
- **Spacebar double-tap tab/undo**: double tap the left half of the spacebar to insert a
  tab, or the right half to undo the last edit; the tapped space is swallowed instead of
  committing a second one, so a double space becomes one tab.
- **Punctuation spacing**: a space typed before a period, comma or ellipsis is pulled back
  to sit tight against the word (`Hey ` + `.` commits as `Hey.`), while French `;:!?`
  keep exactly one space before them.
- **English QWERTY Flick Case** (up for uppercase, down
  for lowercase), **Field adaptation** for search, URL, email, password and code fields,
  **Multilingual Suggestion**, **Swipe Down to Dismiss Keyboard**, **Swipeable Custom Top
  Row**, **Cursor trackpad mode**, **Keypress Vibration Intensity Control**,
  **Latin Globe Key Ignore Interval**, **Long-Press Editing Shortcuts**,
  **Backspace Repeat Haptic Feedback** and **Enter Key Tasker Event** (Intent broadcast to
  Tasker, `dev.custom.gboard.ENTER_PRESSED`).

#### 🎨 Themes, keys and visual effects
- **Glide Trail Customization** (fade speed, thickness, tail length, Rainbow RGB and an HSV
  colour wheel), **Gboard Theme Builder**, **Custom Theme** ZIP import and theme packs,
  **Keyboard Icon Packs**, **Frosted Glass**, **Glass Panel**, **Glass Press Effect**,
  **Translucent Bottom Bar**, **Rounded Keyboard Panel**, **Key Shape Selection**,
  **Immersive Keyboard**, **Theme Follows Dark Mode**, **AMOLED Gboard Settings**,
  **AMOLED dark keyboard**, **G Logo on Spacebar**, **Emoji Key On Right** and
  **Change emoji size**.

#### 🎙️ Voice typing
- **Parakeet voice typing** on the phone (no Google server round-trip), plus **Rambler
  voice typing** with **Rambler personal dictionary**, **Rambler contact names**,
  **Rambler custom instructions**, **Rambler cursor-aware editing**, **Rambler app
  context** and **Rambler stop after silence**. Also **Parakeet personal dictionary**,
  **Advanced Voice Typing**, **Use Bluetooth Microphone** and **Enable OCR / Scan Text**.

#### ✍️ Text, suggestions and editing
- **AI Writing Tools** (proofread, rewrite, tone), **Grammar Checker**, **Inline
  Suggestions**, **Enable Inline Autofill Suggestions**, **Simple Calculator**,
  **Close Proactive Suggestions** and **Dictionaries & Predictions** resource versions.

#### 📋 Clipboard, toolbar and quick actions
- **Web Clipboard** with browser sync, **Clipboard Enhancements**, **Clipboard Custom
  Character Limit**, **Quick Insert**, **Top Toolbar Item Count**, **Toolbar Editing
  Buttons**, **Custom Symbols**, **Access Points menu style**, **Incognito Mode Toggle**,
  **FTP Server** and **Floating Web Search**.

#### ⌨️ Layouts
- **iOS QWERTY layout**, **iOS flick layout**, **Enable split keyboard**, **Enable
  accessibility layout**, **Zhuyin Slide Input**, **Zhuyin Bottom Row Key Sizes**,
  **Zhuyin Quick Traditional/Simplified Toggle** and **Emojis, stickers & GIFs Tab Order**.

#### ⚙️ Settings and branding
- **Keyboard Settings** inside Gboard, **Settings Homepage Override**, **Developer
  options** and the Flag Editor, **Backup & Restore**, **Change package name** and
  **Custom branding**.

#### 🔒 Privacy and clean-up
- **Block Trackers**, **Block App Hijacking**, **Stop Remote Updates**, **Stop Background
  Sync**, **Disable Cloud
  Backup**, **Remove Permissions**, **Offline Only**, **Remove Extra Files**, **Disable
  Play Services**, **Remove Translate Limit**, **Key Mapper Watchdog** and **Add Gboard
  Signature Bypass**.

#### 🎯 Supported Gboard versions
- `18.6.3.1002251336-release-arm64-v8a`: all 89 patches.
- `18.5.4.993608717-release-arm64-v8a`: the newer additions, including the per-app
  profiles, swipe, case-swipe and punctuation patches, glass effects and Field adaptation
  (12 patches).
- `18.0.3.954559732-release-arm64-v8a` and `18.0.3`: the three original patches (Glide
  Trail Customization, Backspace Repeat Haptic Feedback, Enter Key Tasker Event).

#### ⚠️ Known limitations

### Gboard Enhancement Patches Suite

#### ✨ Features
- **Glide Trail Customization**: Samsung Keyboard / Good Lock (Keys Cafe) style glide typing trail customization (fade speed, dynamic Rainbow RGB, color wheel, stroke thickness, and tail length decay).

- **AMOLED Gboard Settings**: Pure-black settings rows for Gboard's preference screens.
- **Gboard Theme Builder**: In-app key colour, corner-radius and live preview editor, saved to and applied by the patch runtime.
- **Keyboard Icon Packs**: Imports `.wmicons.zip` packs from storage and overrides key icons.
- **Multilingual Suggestion**: Promotes glide and typing suggestions written in a different script.
- **Morphe Independent Selection**: All patches can be individually enabled or combined together in Morphe Manager.

## Primera versión estable

Compatible con **TikTok Lite 47.8.15** (`com.zhiliaoapp.musically.go`, código 470815).

- **Feed:** filtra anuncios detectados en dos recorridos y muestra un contador por sesión.
- **Descargas:** permite guardar sin marca de agua cuando hay una fuente limpia para una descarga permitida.
- **Ajustes del mod:** panel con interruptores persistentes y ocho idiomas, accesible desde **Ajustes y privacidad** o manteniendo pulsado **Perfil (Yo)**. El gesto se puede desactivar.
- **Apariencia:** el panel sigue el tema de TikTok Lite desde los dos accesos. La corrección se probó en tema claro y oscuro, incluido TikTok Lite claro con Android oscuro.
- **Acerca de:** diálogo del mod con la versión y el enlace al proyecto. En la pantalla nativa se oculta el bloque Acerca de y se conservan las opciones de cuenta.
- **Morphe Manager:** instalación probada por el mantenedor y corrección de tema confirmada en la compilación preliminar dev.33.

Esta release contiene el bundle firmado de parches y su catálogo. El APK original compatible se aporta por separado.
